Abstract

Precise camera control for reshooting dynamic videos is bottlenecked by the severe scarcity of paired multi-view data for non-rigid scenes. We overcome this limitation with a highly scalable self-supervised framework capable of leveraging internet-scale monocular videos. Our core contribution is the generation of pseudo multi-view training triplets, consisting of a source video, a geometric anchor, and a target video. We achieve this by extracting distinct smooth random-walk crop trajectories from a single input video to serve as the source and target views. The anchor is synthetically generated by forward-warping the first frame of the source with a dense tracking field, which effectively simulates the distorted point-cloud inputs expected at inference. Because our independent cropping strategy introduces spatial misalignment and artificial occlusions, the model cannot simply copy information from the current source frame. Instead, it is forced to implicitly learn 4D spatiotemporal structures by actively routing and re-projecting missing high-fidelity textures across distinct times and viewpoints from the source video to reconstruct the target. At inference, our minimally adapted diffusion transformer utilizes a 4D point-cloud derived anchor to achieve state-of-the-art temporal consistency, robust camera control, and high-fidelity novel view synthesis on complex dynamic scenes.

item.title: A Hidden Markov Framework for Physically Interpretable Arc Stability Dynamics in Welding Systems
item.author: Nogay, Hidir Selcuk
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种基于概率状态空间框架和隐马尔可夫模型的电弧焊接稳定性分析方法，通过时频域特征提取捕捉电弧动力学行为。

背景: 电弧焊接表现出强烈的非平稳性和时变行为，使得使用传统基于帧的方法难以可靠地评估电弧稳定性。

目的: 为了解决传统方法在评估电弧稳定性方面的局限性，研究旨在通过时序建模来更准确地捕捉电弧状态的变化。

方法: 将焊接电流信号通过短时傅里叶变换转换为时频域，提取能量、熵和质心等物理描述符构建观测序列，并利用隐马尔可夫模型捕捉时间依赖性。

主要发现: 分析揭示了瞬态、稳定和熄弧三种主要状态；在稳定状态下，频谱能量增加且熵减少，表明变异性降低；推断出的状态序列表现出强时间一致性，具有高状态持续性和低转换率。

结论: 该框架提供了可解释且物理上一致的电弧行为表示，强调了时间建模的重要性，优于静态分类，能够实现更现实的焊接过程稳定性监测。

翻译: Electric arc welding (EAW) exhibits strongly non stationary and temporally evolving behavior, making reliable assessment of arc stability difficult using conventional frame based approaches. In this study, arc dynamics are modeled as a sequence of latent operational regimes within a probabilistic state-space framework. The welding current signal is transformed into a time-frequency domain using Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), and a set of physically meaningful spectral descriptors, including energy, entropy, and centroid, is extracted to construct the observation sequence. A Hidden Markov Model (HMM) is employed to capture temporal dependencies and estimate the evolution of arc states. The analysis reveals three dominant regimes, transient, stable, and extinction, with a clear monotonic increase in spectral energy and a corresponding decrease in entropy, indicating reduced variability under stable conditions. Despite partial overlap in the feature space, the inferred state sequence exhibits strong temporal coherence, supported by high state persistence and low transition rates. These findings highlight the limitations of static classification and emphasize the importance of temporal modeling. The proposed framework provides an interpretable and physically consistent representation of arc behavior, enabling more realistic monitoring and analysis of stability dynamics in welding processes.

Abstract

Electric arc welding (EAW) exhibits strongly non stationary and temporally evolving behavior, making reliable assessment of arc stability difficult using conventional frame based approaches. In this study, arc dynamics are modeled as a sequence of latent operational regimes within a probabilistic state-space framework. The welding current signal is transformed into a time-frequency domain using Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), and a set of physically meaningful spectral descriptors, including energy, entropy, and centroid, is extracted to construct the observation sequence. A Hidden Markov Model (HMM) is employed to capture temporal dependencies and estimate the evolution of arc states. The analysis reveals three dominant regimes, transient, stable, and extinction, with a clear monotonic increase in spectral energy and a corresponding decrease in entropy, indicating reduced variability under stable conditions. Despite partial overlap in the feature space, the inferred state sequence exhibits strong temporal coherence, supported by high state persistence and low transition rates. These findings highlight the limitations of static classification and emphasize the importance of temporal modeling. The proposed framework provides an interpretable and physically consistent representation of arc behavior, enabling more realistic monitoring and analysis of stability dynamics in welding processes.

item.title: Machine Behavior in Relational Moral Dilemmas: Moral Rightness, Predicted Human Behavior, and Model Decisions
item.author: Jiseon Kim, Jea Kwon, Luiz Felipe Vecchietti, Wenchao Dong, Jaehong Kim, Meeyoung Cha
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文通过“吹哨人困境”实验，探讨了大型语言模型在人际情境下的道德决策行为，发现模型决策倾向于遵循道德规范而非预测的人类行为，且缺乏对社会敏感度的考量。

背景: 人类道德判断具有情境依赖性并受人际关系调节。随着大型语言模型（LLMs）日益成为决策支持系统，确定它们是否编码了这些社会细微差别至关重要。

目的: 评估大型语言模型是否编码了社会细微差别，并分析其决策过程。

方法: 使用“吹哨人困境”实验，通过改变犯罪严重程度和关系亲密度两个维度来表征机器行为。研究评估了三个视角：道德正确性、预测的人类行为和自主模型决策。

主要发现: 道德正确性始终保持公平导向，而预测的人类行为随关系亲密度增加显著转向忠诚。关键发现是，模型决策与道德正确性判断一致，而不是它们自己的行为预测。

结论: 大型语言模型的决策优先考虑僵化的规范规则，而不是其内部世界建模中的社会敏感性，这可能导致现实部署中出现重大错位。

翻译: 人类道德判断是情境依赖的，并受人际关系调节。随着大型语言模型（LLMs）日益成为决策支持系统，确定它们是否编码了这些社会细微差别至关重要。我们通过改变两个实验维度：犯罪严重程度和关系亲密度，利用“吹哨人困境”来表征机器行为。我们的研究评估了三个不同的视角：（1）道德正确性，（2）预测的人类行为，和（3）自主模型决策。通过分析推理过程，我们识别出明显的跨视角分歧：虽然道德正确性始终保持公平导向，但预测的人类行为随关系亲密度增加显著转向忠诚。关键的是，模型决策与道德正确性判断一致，而不是它们自己的行为预测。这种不一致表明，大型语言模型的决策优先考虑僵化的规范规则，而不是其内部世界建模中的社会敏感性，这构成了一个差距，可能导致现实部署中出现重大错位。

Abstract

Human moral judgment is context-dependent and modulated by interpersonal relationships. As large language models (LLMs) increasingly function as decision-support systems, determining whether they encode these social nuances is critical. We characterize machine behavior using the Whistleblower's Dilemma by varying two experimental dimensions: crime severity and relational closeness. Our study evaluates three distinct perspectives: (1) moral rightness (prescriptive norms), (2) predicted human behavior (descriptive social expectations), and (3) autonomous model decision-making. By analyzing the reasoning processes, we identify a clear cross-perspective divergence: while moral rightness remains consistently fairness-oriented, predicted human behavior shifts significantly toward loyalty as relational closeness increases. Crucially, model decisions align with moral rightness judgments rather than their own behavioral predictions. This inconsistency suggests that LLM decision-making prioritizes rigid, prescriptive rules over the social sensitivity present in their internal world-modeling, which poses a gap that may lead to significant misalignments in real-world deployments.

item.title: Grounding Video Reasoning in Physical Signals
item.author: Osmanli, Alibay, Cheng, Zixu, Gong, Shaogang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该论文提出了一种用于物理视频理解的基准测试，旨在解决模型在时空定位上的局限性，并评估不同提示词和扰动条件下的模型性能。

背景: 物理视频理解不仅需要正确命名事件，还需要在时间和空间上准确定位事件。现有模型往往能通过文本规律回答问题，但在时空定位上表现不佳。

目的: 引入一个 grounded benchmark，扩展 V-STaR 的评估结构，以更全面地评估物理视频理解能力。

方法: 构建了一个包含四个视频源、六个物理域、三个提示词家族和四种输入条件的基准测试。包含1560个视频片段，将其转换为共享的 grounded event record，并从中衍生查询家族。时空目标在提示词家族间共享，非物理家族使用确定性语义目标。

主要发现: 物理模式整体表现最强，vstar_like 是非物理语义比较的清晰基准，neutral_rstr 是更难的模板控制。提示词家族的鲁棒性是选择性的，扰动增益集中在弱原始情况，空间定位是最弱的。

结论: 视频问答推理基准测试应报告物理 grounded、提示词 aware 和扰动 aware 的诊断，而不仅仅是聚合准确率。

翻译: Physical video understanding requires more than naming an event correctly. A model can answer a question about pouring, sliding, or collision from textual regularities while still failing to localize the event in time or space. We introduce a grounded benchmark for physical video understanding that extends the what--when--where evaluation structure of V-STaR to four video sources, six physics domains, three prompt families (physics, vstar_like, and neutral_rstr), and four input conditions (original, shuffled, ablated, and frame-masked). The benchmark contains 1,560 base video clips from SSV2, YouCook2, HoloAssist, and Roundabout-TAU. Each clip is first converted into a shared grounded event record, and the three query families are derived from that record. Temporal and spatial targets are shared across prompt families, while the non-physics families use deterministic family-appropriate semantic a_what targets derived from the same record. Across models and prompt families, physics remains the strongest regime overall, vstar_like is the clearest non-physics semantic comparison, and neutral_rstr behaves as a harder templated control. Prompt-family robustness is selective rather than universal, perturbation gains cluster in weak original cases, and spatial grounding is the weakest across settings. These results suggest that video Q&A reasoning benchmarks shall report physically grounded, prompt-aware, and perturbation-aware diagnostics alongside aggregate accuracy.

Abstract

Physical video understanding requires more than naming an event correctly. A model can answer a question about pouring, sliding, or collision from textual regularities while still failing to localize the event in time or space. We introduce a grounded benchmark for physical video understanding that extends the what--when--where evaluation structure of V-STaR to four video sources, six physics domains, three prompt families (physics, vstar_like, and neutral_rstr), and four input conditions (original, shuffled, ablated, and frame-masked). The benchmark contains 1,560 base video clips from SSV2, YouCook2, HoloAssist, and Roundabout-TAU. Each clip is first converted into a shared grounded event record, and the three query families are derived from that record. Temporal and spatial targets are shared across prompt families, while the non-physics families use deterministic family-appropriate semantic a_what targets derived from the same record. Across models and prompt families, physics remains the strongest regime overall, vstar_like is the clearest non-physics semantic comparison, and neutral_rstr behaves as a harder templated control. Prompt-family robustness is selective rather than universal, perturbation gains cluster in weak original cases, and spatial grounding is the weakest across settings. These results suggest that video Q&A reasoning benchmarks shall report physically grounded, prompt-aware, and perturbation-aware diagnostics alongside aggregate accuracy.

item.title: Vista4D: Video Reshooting with 4D Point Clouds
item.author: Lin, Kuan Heng, Liu, Zhizheng, Salamanca, Pablo, Kant, Yash, Burgert, Ryan, Xu, Yuancheng, Namekata, Koichi, Zhao, Yiwei, Zhou, Bolei, Goldblum, Micah, Debevec, Paul, Yu, Ning
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 Vista4D 的鲁棒且灵活的视频重拍摄框架，通过 4D 点云表示来重合成场景。

背景: 现有的视频重拍摄方法在处理真实世界动态视频的深度估计伪影方面存在困难，且难以保持内容外观和维持对具有挑战性的新轨迹的精确相机控制。

目的: 解决现有方法在深度估计、内容外观保持和精确相机控制方面的局限性，实现从不同相机轨迹和视角重合成具有相同动态的场景。

方法: 构建基于 4D 的点云表示，结合静态像素分割和 4D 重建，显式保留已见内容并提供丰富的相机信号，并利用重建的多视图动态数据进行训练，以提高对点云伪影的鲁棒性。

主要发现: 在各种视频和相机路径下，该方法相比最先进的基线表现出更好的 4D 一致性、相机控制和视觉质量。

结论: 该方法可以推广到动态场景扩展和 4D 场景重组等现实应用。

翻译: 我们提出了 Vista4D，一个鲁棒且灵活的视频重拍摄框架，将输入视频和目标相机定位在 4D 点云中。具体而言，给定输入视频，我们的方法从不同的相机轨迹和视角重合成具有相同动态的场景。现有的视频重拍摄方法经常在真实世界动态视频的深度估计伪影方面挣扎，同时也未能保持内容外观，并且未能维持对具有挑战性的新轨迹的精确相机控制。我们构建了一个基于 4D 的点云表示，具有静态像素分割和 4D 重建，以显式保留已见内容并提供丰富的相机信号，并使用重建的多视图动态数据进行训练，以提高在现实世界推理期间对点云伪影的鲁棒性。我们的结果显示，在各种视频和相机路径下，与最先进的基线相比，4D 一致性、相机控制和视觉质量有所提高。此外，我们的方法可以推广到动态场景扩展和 4D 场景重组等现实应用。请访问我们的项目页面查看结果、代码和模型：this https URL

Abstract

We present Vista4D, a robust and flexible video reshooting framework that grounds the input video and target cameras in a 4D point cloud. Specifically, given an input video, our method re-synthesizes the scene with the same dynamics from a different camera trajectory and viewpoint. Existing video reshooting methods often struggle with depth estimation artifacts of real-world dynamic videos, while also failing to preserve content appearance and failing to maintain precise camera control for challenging new trajectories. We build a 4D-grounded point cloud representation with static pixel segmentation and 4D reconstruction to explicitly preserve seen content and provide rich camera signals, and we train with reconstructed multiview dynamic data for robustness against point cloud artifacts during real-world inference. Our results demonstrate improved 4D consistency, camera control, and visual quality compared to state-of-the-art baselines under a variety of videos and camera paths. Moreover, our method generalizes to real-world applications such as dynamic scene expansion and 4D scene recomposition. See our project page for results, code, and models: this https URL

item.title: Seeing Without Eyes: 4D Human-Scene Understanding from Wearable IMUs
item.author: Hao-Yu Hsu, Tianhang Cheng, Jing Wen, Alexander G. Schwing, Shenlong Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 IMU-to-4D 的框架，利用可穿戴传感器和大型语言模型实现无视觉的 4D 感知。

背景: 理解人类活动和环境通常依赖视觉感知，但相机在隐私、安全、能源效率和可扩展性方面存在持续挑战。

目的: 探索无需视觉的 4D 感知方法，旨在仅从日常可穿戴传感器重建人类运动和 3D 场景布局。

方法: 引入 IMU-to-4D 框架，重新利用大型语言模型进行非视觉的时空理解，使用耳机、手表或智能手机中的惯性传感器数据。

主要发现: 在多种数据集上，IMU-to-4D 比最先进的级联管道产生更连贯和时序稳定的结果。

结论: 可穿戴运动传感器单独就能支持丰富的 4D 理解。

翻译: 理解人类活动及其周围环境通常依赖于视觉感知，但相机在隐私、安全、能源效率和可扩展性方面存在持续的挑战。我们探索了一种替代方案：无需视觉的 4D 感知。其目标是从日常可穿戴传感器中纯粹重建人类运动和 3D 场景布局。为此，我们介绍了 IMU-to-4D，这是一个重新利用大型语言模型进行人类-场景动态非视觉时空理解的框架。IMU-to-4D 使用来自耳机、手表或智能手机的少量惯性传感器数据，并预测详细的 4D 人类运动以及粗略的场景结构。在多样化的人类-场景数据集上的实验表明，IMU-to-4D 比最先进的级联管道产生更连贯和时序稳定的结果，这表明仅靠可穿戴运动传感器就能支持丰富的 4D 理解。

Abstract

Understanding human activities and their surrounding environments typically relies on visual perception, yet cameras pose persistent challenges in privacy, safety, energy efficiency, and scalability. We explore an alternative: 4D perception without vision. Its goal is to reconstruct human motion and 3D scene layouts purely from everyday wearable sensors. For this we introduce IMU-to-4D, a framework that repurposes large language models for non-visual spatiotemporal understanding of human-scene dynamics. IMU-to-4D uses data from a few inertial sensors from earbuds, watches, or smartphones and predicts detailed 4D human motion together with coarse scene structure. Experiments across diverse human-scene datasets show that IMU-to-4D yields more coherent and temporally stable results than SoTA cascaded pipelines, suggesting wearable motion sensors alone can support rich 4D understanding.

item.title: How Many Visual Levers Drive Urban Perception? Interventional Counterfactuals via Multiple Localised Edits
item.author: Jason Tang, Stephen Law
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 街景感知模型仅能预测属性但缺乏因果解释，本文提出一种基于杠杆的干预反事实框架，通过结构化反事实编辑来解释场景级决策。

背景: 现有的街景感知模型虽然能大规模预测主观属性（如安全性），但仅停留在相关性层面，无法识别具体的视觉变化如何影响人类判断。

目的: 提出一种基于杠杆的干预反事实框架，将场景级可解释性转化为对结构化反事实编辑的受限搜索，以识别导致人类判断改变的视觉变化。

方法: 该框架定义了包含语义概念、空间支持、干预方向和编辑模板的杠杆。通过提示条件图像编辑生成候选编辑，并利用同地保留、局部性、真实性和合理性等有效性检查进行筛选。

主要发现: 在五个城市的五十个场景试点中，框架揭示了基于代理的初步方向模式和仅使用提示编辑时的失败分类法。移动基础设施和物理维护显示出最大的辅助安全变化。

结论: 人类配对判断仍是未来验证的基准。该框架为理解街景模型提供了新的视角，但需要通过人类判断进行进一步验证。

翻译: 街景感知模型能够大规模预测主观属性，如安全性，但它们仍然是相关性的：它们无法识别哪些局部视觉变化可能会改变特定场景的人类判断。我们提出了一种基于杠杆的干预反事实框架，将场景级可解释性重新构建为对结构化反事实编辑的受限搜索。每个杠杆指定了一个语义概念、空间支持、干预方向和受限编辑模板。候选编辑通过提示条件图像编辑生成，并且仅当它们满足同地保留、局部性、真实性和合理性的有效性检查时才被保留。在跨越五个城市的五十个场景的试点中，该框架揭示了基于代理的初步方向模式和仅使用提示编辑时的实际失败分类法，其中移动基础设施和物理维护显示出最大的辅助安全变化。人类配对判断仍是未来验证的基准。

Abstract

Street-view perception models predict subjective attributes such as safety at scale, but remain correlational: they do not identify which localized visual changes would plausibly shift human judgement for a specific scene. We propose a lever-based interventional counterfactual framework that recasts scene-level explainability as a bounded search over structured counterfactual edits. Each lever specifies a semantic concept, spatial support, intervention direction, and constrained edit template. Candidate edits are generated through prompt-conditioned image editing and retained only if they satisfy validity checks for same-place preservation, locality, realism, and plausibility. In a pilot across 50 scenes from five cities, the framework reveals preliminary proxy-based directional patterns and a practical failure taxonomy under prompt-only editing, with Mobility Infrastructure and Physical Maintenance showing the largest auxiliary safety shifts. Human pairwise judgements remain the ground-truth endpoint for future validation.

item.title: A Hybrid Reinforcement and Self-Supervised Learning Aided Benders Decomposition Algorithm
item.author: Agyeman, Bernard T., Li, Zhe, Mitrai, Ilias, Daoutidis, Prodromos
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种混合强化学习和自监督学习框架，用于加速广义Benders分解。

背景: 广义Benders分解是一种求解混合整数非线性规划问题的方法，但传统方法可能计算效率较低。

目的: 加速广义Benders分解的求解过程，提高计算效率。

方法: 该框架包含两部分：一是基于图的强化学习代理，用于确定主问题的整数变量赋值；二是KKT神经网络，通过自监督学习预测子问题的原始对偶解，用于直接构建Benders切割。

主要发现: 在混合整数非线性规划案例研究中，相比经典GBD，求解时间减少了57.5%，且在所有测试实例中均能恢复最优解。

结论: 该框架能有效加速广义Benders分解，在保证最优解的同时显著减少了求解时间。

翻译: 我们提出了一种混合强化和自监督学习框架，用于加速广义Benders分解。在这个框架中，一个基于图的强化学习代理在主问题的二部图表示上运行，并结合验证机制，确定解决主问题的整数变量赋值。这些赋值随后被用作输入到KKT神经网络中，通过自监督训练来预测满足子问题Karush Kuhn Tucker条件的原始对偶解。预测的解被用来直接构建Benders切割。该框架在混合整数非线性规划案例研究中进行了评估，与经典GBD相比，求解时间减少了57.5%，同时在所有测试实例中一致地恢复了最优解。

Abstract

We propose a hybrid reinforcement and self-supervised learning framework for accelerating generalized Benders decomposition (GBD). In this framework, a graph based reinforcement learning agent operates on a bipartite representation of the master problem and, together with a verification mechanism, determines the integer variable assignments that solve the master problem. These assignments are then used as inputs to a KKT informed neural network, trained via self supervision to predict primal dual solutions that approximately satisfy the Karush Kuhn Tucker conditions of the subproblem. The predicted solutions are used to construct Benders cuts directly. The framework is evaluated on a mixed integer nonlinear programming case study, where it achieves a 57.5% reduction in solution time relative to classical GBD while consistently recovering optimal solutions across all test instances.

item.title: GenMatter: Perceiving Physical Objects with Generative Matter Models
item.author: Li, Eric, Dasgupta, Arijit, Friedman, Yoni, Huot, Mathieu, Mansinghka, Vikash, O'Connell, Thomas, Freeman, William T., Tenenbaum, Joshua B.
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于人类视觉感知原理的通用运动场景解释框架，旨在解决现有计算机视觉系统缺乏跨场景统一方法的问题。

背景: 人类能够稳健地检测和分割移动实体，但现有计算机视觉系统缺乏一种能在不同场景下（如随机点、纹理、自然视频）统一工作的方法。

目的: 建立基于人类视觉原则的运动感知通用框架，使其能够在生物视觉成功而现有计算机视觉方法失效的设置中工作。

方法: 提出一种生成模型，通过分层将低级运动线索和高级外观特征分组为粒子，再将粒子分组为独立移动的物理实体。开发了基于并行化块吉布斯采样的硬件加速推理算法。

主要发现: 在二维随机点运动图上捕捉了人类物体感知；在伪装旋转物体数据集上从运动中恢复正确三维结构并实现准确二维物体分割；在自然RGB视频上跟踪构成变形物体的移动三维物质，实现鲁棒的物体级场景理解。

结论: 该工作建立了一个基于人类视觉原则的运动感知通用框架。

翻译: Human visual perception offers valuable insights for understanding computational principles of motion-based scene interpretation. Humans robustly detect and segment moving entities that constitute independently moveable chunks of matter, whether observing sparse moving dots, textured surfaces, or naturalistic scenes. In contrast, existing computer vision systems lack a unified approach that works across these diverse settings. Inspired by principles of human perception, we propose a generative model that hierarchically groups low-level motion cues and high-level appearance features into particles (small Gaussians representing local matter), and groups particles into clusters capturing coherently and independently moveable physical entities. We develop a hardware-accelerated inference algorithm based on parallelized block Gibbs sampling to recover stable particle motion and groupings. Our model operates on different kinds of inputs (random dots, stylized textures, or naturalistic RGB video), enabling it to work across settings where biological vision succeeds but existing computer vision approaches do not. We validate this unified framework across three domains: on 2D random dot kinematograms, our approach captures human object perception including graded uncertainty across ambiguous conditions; on a Gestalt-inspired dataset of camouflaged rotating objects, our approach recovers correct 3D structure from motion and thereby accurate 2D object segmentation; and on naturalistic RGB videos, our model tracks the moving 3D matter that makes up deforming objects, enabling robust object-level scene understanding. This work thus establishes a general framework for motion-based perception grounded in principles of human vision.

Abstract

Human visual perception offers valuable insights for understanding computational principles of motion-based scene interpretation. Humans robustly detect and segment moving entities that constitute independently moveable chunks of matter, whether observing sparse moving dots, textured surfaces, or naturalistic scenes. In contrast, existing computer vision systems lack a unified approach that works across these diverse settings. Inspired by principles of human perception, we propose a generative model that hierarchically groups low-level motion cues and high-level appearance features into particles (small Gaussians representing local matter), and groups particles into clusters capturing coherently and independently moveable physical entities. We develop a hardware-accelerated inference algorithm based on parallelized block Gibbs sampling to recover stable particle motion and groupings. Our model operates on different kinds of inputs (random dots, stylized textures, or naturalistic RGB video), enabling it to work across settings where biological vision succeeds but existing computer vision approaches do not. We validate this unified framework across three domains: on 2D random dot kinematograms, our approach captures human object perception including graded uncertainty across ambiguous conditions; on a Gestalt-inspired dataset of camouflaged rotating objects, our approach recovers correct 3D structure from motion and thereby accurate 2D object segmentation; and on naturalistic RGB videos, our model tracks the moving 3D matter that makes up deforming objects, enabling robust object-level scene understanding. This work thus establishes a general framework for motion-based perception grounded in principles of human vision.

item.title: ReCast: Recasting Learning Signals for Reinforcement Learning in Generative Recommendation
item.author: Zhang, Peiyan, Liu, Hanmo, Tong, Chengxuan, Wu, Yuxia, Guo, Wei, Liu, Yong
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ReCast是一种修复-对比学习信号框架，用于解决稀疏命中生成式推荐中学习信号不可用的问题。

背景: 通用基于群体的强化学习假设采样的展开组是可用的学习信号，但在稀疏命中生成式推荐中，这一假设失效，许多采样的组从未变得可学习。

目的: 提出ReCast框架，通过修复全零组和边界对比更新，构建可学习的优化事件，从而提升模型性能和效率。

方法: ReCast框架首先恢复全零组的最小可学习性，然后用边界聚焦的对比更新替换全组奖励归一化。该方法不改变外部RL框架，仅修改组内信号构建。

主要发现: ReCast在多个任务中一致优于OpenOneRec-RL，Pass@1相对提升最高达36.6%；在匹配预算方面优势巨大，仅需4.1%的展开预算即可达到基线性能；系统层面带来显著增益，减少更新时间16.60倍，降低峰值内存16.5%，提升actor MFU 14.2%。

结论: 对于生成式推荐，关键的强化学习问题不仅是如何分配奖励，更是如何从稀疏、结构化的监督中构建可学习的优化事件。

翻译: Generic group-based RL assumes that sampled rollout groups are already usable learning signals. We show that this assumption breaks down in sparse-hit generative recommendation, where many sampled groups never become learnable at all. We propose ReCast, a repair-then-contrast learning-signal framework that first restores minimal learnability for all-zero groups and then replaces full-group reward normalization with a boundary-focused contrastive update on the strongest positive and the hardest negative. ReCast leaves the outer RL framework unchanged, modifies only within-group signal construction, and partially decouples rollout search width from actor-side update width. Across multiple generative recommendation tasks, ReCast consistently outperforms OpenOneRec-RL, achieving up to 36.6% relative improvement in Pass@1. Its matched-budget advantage is substantially larger: ReCast reaches the baseline's target performance with only 4.1% of the rollout budget, and this advantage widens with model scale. The same design also yields direct system-level gains, reducing actor-side update time by 16.60x, lowering peak allocated memory by 16.5%, and improving actor MFU by 14.2%. Mechanism analysis shows that ReCast mitigates the persistent all-zero / single-hit regime, restores learnability when natural positives are scarce, and converts otherwise wasted rollout budget into more stable policy updates. These results suggest that, for generative recommendation, the decisive RL problem is not only how to assign rewards, but how to construct learnable optimization events from sparse, structured supervision.

Abstract

Generic group-based RL assumes that sampled rollout groups are already usable learning signals. We show that this assumption breaks down in sparse-hit generative recommendation, where many sampled groups never become learnable at all. We propose ReCast, a repair-then-contrast learning-signal framework that first restores minimal learnability for all-zero groups and then replaces full-group reward normalization with a boundary-focused contrastive update on the strongest positive and the hardest negative. ReCast leaves the outer RL framework unchanged, modifies only within-group signal construction, and partially decouples rollout search width from actor-side update width. Across multiple generative recommendation tasks, ReCast consistently outperforms OpenOneRec-RL, achieving up to 36.6% relative improvement in Pass@1. Its matched-budget advantage is substantially larger: ReCast reaches the baseline's target performance with only 4.1% of the rollout budget, and this advantage widens with model scale. The same design also yields direct system-level gains, reducing actor-side update time by 16.60x, lowering peak allocated memory by 16.5%, and improving actor MFU by 14.2%. Mechanism analysis shows that ReCast mitigates the persistent all-zero / single-hit regime, restores learnability when natural positives are scarce, and converts otherwise wasted rollout budget into more stable policy updates. These results suggest that, for generative recommendation, the decisive RL problem is not only how to assign rewards, but how to construct learnable optimization events from sparse, structured supervision.

item.title: Unlocking Optical Prior: Spectrum-Guided Knowledge Transfer for SAR Generalized Category Discovery
item.author: Xia, Jingyuan, Hu, Ruikang, Li, Ye, Yang, Zhixiong, Lan, Xu, Lu, Zhejun
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于模态差异曲线的跨模态先验转移框架，用于解决光学先验与SAR图像不兼容的问题。

背景: 广义类别发现（GCD）在标签稀缺的SAR领域有潜力，但受限于光学大模型先验与SAR图像的跨模态不兼容，且现有方法缺乏反映成像特性的归纳偏置。

目的: 解决光学先验与SAR图像跨模态不兼容的问题，有效将光学先验转移到SAR域。

方法: 提出模态差异曲线（MDC）建模跨模态差异，构建MDC引导的跨模态先验转移（MCPT）框架。该框架包含自适应频率分词（AFT）和频率感知专家细化（FER）模块，并利用对比学习对齐特征。

主要发现: 频域差异建模能够更有效地将光学先验适应到SAR图像中，在多个主流数据集上取得了最先进的性能。

结论: 该方法通过成对预训练学到的优越SAR特征表示能力，能有效应用于下游单模态SAR-GCD任务。

翻译: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) holds significant promise for the label-scarce Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) domain, yet its efficacy is severely constrained by the cross-modal incompatibility between the inherent optical prior of the Large Vision Models (LVMs) and SAR imagery. Existing domain adaptation methods often lack an inductive bias that reflects imaging characteristics, consequently failing to effectively transfer optical prior into the SAR domain. To address this issue, the Modal Discrepancy Curve (MDC) is introduced to model cross-modal discrepancy as a structured frequency-domain descriptor derived from spectral energy distributions. Leveraging this formulation, we propose the MDC-guided Cross-modal Prior Transfer (MCPT) framework, a pre-training paradigm that operates on paired optical-SAR data. Within this framework, Adaptive Frequency Tokenization (AFT) converts the MDC into learnable tokens, and Frequency-aware Expert Refinement (FER) performs band-wise discrepancy-aware feature refinement using these tokens. Based on the refined representations, contrastive learning aligns refined embeddings across modalities and internalizes the adaptation pattern. Ultimately, the superior SAR feature representation capability learned during paired pre-training is applied to downstream single-modal SAR-GCD tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across multiple mainstream datasets, indicating that frequency-domain discrepancy modeling enables more effective adaptation of optical prior to SAR imagery.

Abstract

Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) holds significant promise for the label-scarce Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) domain, yet its efficacy is severely constrained by the cross-modal incompatibility between the inherent optical prior of the Large Vision Models (LVMs) and SAR imagery. Existing domain adaptation methods often lack an inductive bias that reflects imaging characteristics, consequently failing to effectively transfer optical prior into the SAR domain. To address this issue, the Modal Discrepancy Curve (MDC) is introduced to model cross-modal discrepancy as a structured frequency-domain descriptor derived from spectral energy distributions. Leveraging this formulation, we propose the MDC-guided Cross-modal Prior Transfer (MCPT) framework, a pre-training paradigm that operates on paired optical-SAR data. Within this framework, Adaptive Frequency Tokenization (AFT) converts the MDC into learnable tokens, and Frequency-aware Expert Refinement (FER) performs band-wise discrepancy-aware feature refinement using these tokens. Based on the refined representations, contrastive learning aligns refined embeddings across modalities and internalizes the adaptation pattern. Ultimately, the superior SAR feature representation capability learned during paired pre-training is applied to downstream single-modal SAR-GCD tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across multiple mainstream datasets, indicating that frequency-domain discrepancy modeling enables more effective adaptation of optical prior to SAR imagery.

item.title: Uni-Encoder Meets Multi-Encoders: Representation Before Fusion for Brain Tumor Segmentation with Missing Modalities
item.author: Song, Peibo, Xue, Xiaotian, Zhang, Jinshuo, Wang, Zihao, Liu, Jinhua, Fu, Shujun, Bao, Fangxun, Yeo, Si Yong
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 UniME 的两阶段异构方法，用于在多模态 MRI 缺失的情况下进行脑肿瘤分割。

背景: 多模态 MRI 提供互补信息，但临床扫描经常缺少一种或多种模态，导致分割性能下降。

目的: 提出一种两阶段异构方法，解决脑肿瘤分割中缺失模态的问题，并平衡细粒度结构捕获、跨模态互补建模和可用模态利用之间的权衡。

方法: 采用两阶段异构架构。第一阶段使用单个 ViT Uni-Encoder 和掩码图像建模进行预训练，建立对缺失模态鲁棒的统一表示。第二阶段添加模态特定的 CNN Multi-Encoders 提取高分辨率、多尺度和细粒度特征，并与全局表示融合以进行精确分割。

主要发现: 在 BraTS 2023 和 BraTS 2024 数据集上的实验表明，UniME 在不完整的多模态场景下优于先前的方法。

结论: UniME 在处理缺失模态的脑肿瘤分割任务中表现出了优越的性能。

翻译: 多模态 MRI 为脑肿瘤分割提供了互补信息，但临床扫描经常缺少一种或多种模态，这会降低分割性能。在本文中，我们提出了 UniME（Uni-Encoder Meets Multi-Encoders），这是一种用于脑肿瘤分割的两阶段异构方法，用于解决细粒度结构捕获、跨模态互补建模和可用模态利用之间的权衡。其思想是通过两阶段异构架构将表示学习与分割解耦。第一阶段使用单个 ViT Uni-Encoder 和掩码图像建模进行预训练，以建立对缺失模态具有鲁棒性的统一表示。第二阶段添加模态特定的 CNN Multi-Encoders 以提取高分辨率、多尺度和细粒度特征。我们将这些特征与全局表示融合以产生精确的分割。在 BraTS 2023 和 BraTS 2024 上的实验表明，UniME 在不完整的多模态场景下优于先前的方法。代码可在该 https URL 获取。

Abstract

Multimodal MRI offers complementary information for brain tumor segmentation, but clinical scans often lack one or more modalities, which degrades segmentation performance. In this paper, we propose UniME (Uni-Encoder Meets Multi-Encoders), a two-stage heterogeneous method for brain tumor segmentation with missing modalities that reconciles the trade-offs among fine-grained structure capture, cross-modal complementarity modeling, and exploitation of available modalities. The idea is to decouple representation learning from segmentation via a two-stage heterogeneous architecture. Stage 1 pretrains a single ViT Uni-Encoder with masked image modeling to establish a unified representation robust to missing modalities. Stage 2 adds modality-specific CNN Multi-Encoders to extract high-resolution, multi-scale, fine-grained features. We fuse these features with the global representation to produce precise segmentations. Experiments on BraTS 2023 and BraTS 2024 show that UniME outperforms previous methods under incomplete multi-modal scenarios. The code is available at this https URL

item.title: Advancing automatic speech recognition using feature fusion with self-supervised learning features: A case study on Fearless Steps Apollo corpus
item.author: Chen, Szu-Jui, Hansen, John H. L.
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究了自监督学习模型的融合，提出了一种新的深度交叉注意力融合方法，以提升自然场景下的语音识别性能。

背景: 自监督学习模型在下游语音任务中表现优于传统手工特征，且研究涉及了FS APOLLO资源和CHiME-6数据集。

目的: 研究SSL模型的融合，利用其个体优势并优化提取特征，以改进自然场景下的语音识别模型，并促进FS APOLLO社区资源的创建。

方法: 引入了新的深度交叉注意力融合方法，并分析了FS Challenge Phase-4语料库和CHiME-6数据集。

主要发现: 之前提出的特征细化损失和融合方法在FSC Phase-4语料库上效果不佳。

结论: 提出的方案在词错误率上实现了绝对提升1.1%，为FS APOLLO社区资源提供了有效的元数据创建。

翻译: 使用自监督学习模型显著提高了下游语音任务的性能，超越了传统手工特征的能力。本研究调查了自监督学习模型的融合，旨在利用它们的个体优势并优化提取的特征，以实现自然场景下的改进语音识别模型。我们的研究调查了大规模自然化的Fearless Steps (FS) APOLLO资源，特别关注FS Challenge (FSC) Phase-4语料库，提供了该数据集的首次分析。此外，我们纳入了CHiME-6数据集，以评估不同自然化语音场景下的性能。在探索之前提出的特征细化损失和融合方法时，我们发现这些方法在FSC Phase-4语料库上效果较差。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种新颖的深度交叉注意力融合方法，旨在提升性能，特别是针对FSC Phase-4语料库。我们的目标是促进更优越的FS APOLLO社区资源的创建，以满足不同学科研究人员的多样化需求。提出的解决方案在词错误率上实现了绝对1.1%的提升，为大规模FS APOLLO社区资源提供了有效的元数据创建。

Abstract

Using self-supervised learning (SSL) models has significantly improved performance for downstream speech tasks, surpassing the capabilities of traditional hand-crafted features. This study investigates the amalgamation of SSL models, with the aim to leverage both their individual strengths and refine extracted features to achieve improved speech recognition models for naturalistic scenarios. Our research investigates the massive naturalistic Fearless Steps (FS) APOLLO resource, with particular focus on the FS Challenge (FSC) Phase-4 corpus, providing the inaugural analysis of this dataset. Additionally, we incorporate the CHiME-6 dataset to evaluate performance across diverse naturalistic speech scenarios. While exploring previously proposed Feature Refinement Loss and fusion methods, we found these methods to be less effective on the FSC Phase-4 corpus. To address this, we introduce a novel deep cross-attention (DCA) fusion method, designed to elevate performance, especially for the FSC Phase-4 corpus. Our objective is to foster creation of superior FS APOLLO community resources, catering to the diverse needs of researchers across various disciplines. The proposed solution achieves an absolute +1.1% improvement in WER, providing effective meta-data creation for the massive FS APOLLO community resource.

item.title: Towards Temporal Compositional Reasoning in Long-Form Sports Videos
item.author: Cao, Siyu, Zhang, Lu, Zeng, Ruizhe, Liu, Zhi-yong
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对体育视频长时域推理难题，提出了SportsTime基准数据集和Chain-of-Time Reasoning方法。

背景: 体育视频涉及复杂动态的人类活动，尽管多模态大模型发展迅速，但在长时域推理中仍难以定位稀疏的时间证据并整合进行回答。

目的: 解决对分散时间证据监督不足，以及缺乏要求模型识别、定位和证明时间证据的方法这两个限制因素。

方法: 引入SportsTime基准数据集，包含大量问答对和逐步时间证据标注；提出CoTR方法，训练时采用时间奖励GRPO，推理时采用锚点观察推断的证据寻求循环。

主要发现: SportsTime作为基准具有实用性，CoTR方法在时间组合推理和逐步定位质量上持续优于强基线模型。

结论: CoTR能有效提升模型在体育视频中的长时域推理能力。

翻译: 体育视频是多模态理解的一个具有挑战性的领域，因为它涉及复杂和动态的人类活动。尽管多模态大模型取得了快速进步，但体育视频中的长时域推理仍然困难，因为回答问题需要定位稀疏的时间证据并将其整合到推理中。我们将这一限制归因于两个紧密耦合的因素：对分散时间证据的监督不足，以及缺乏要求模型识别、定位和证明时间证据的方法。为了解决这些差距，我们介绍了SportsTime，这是一个用于长形式体育视频理解的大规模基准，包含14000多个开放式问答对和50000多个逐步时间证据标注。基于SportsTime，我们提出了链式时间推理CoTR，它将推理视为时间锚定证据组合的过程。具体来说，在训练期间，CoTR引入了时间奖励GRPO以鼓励时间锚定的推理。在推理期间，它采用锚点观察推断的证据寻求循环，在产生最终答案之前迭代地定位、验证和组合时间证据。实验证明了SportsTime作为基准的实用性以及CoTR的有效性，与强基线模型相比，它持续提高了时间组合推理和逐步定位质量。

Abstract

Sports videos are a challenging domain for multimodal understanding because they involve complex and dynamic human activities. Despite rapid progress in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), long-horizon reasoning in sports videos remains difficult, as answering questions requires both locating temporally sparse evidence and integrating it into reasoning. We attribute this limitation to two closely coupled factors: insufficient supervision over temporally dispersed evidence, and the lack of methods that require models to identify, localize, and justify temporal evidence. To address these gaps, we introduce SportsTime, a large-scale benchmark for long-form sports video understanding, comprising 14K+ open-ended QA pairs and 50K+ step-wise temporal evidence annotations. Building on SportsTime, we propose Chain-of-Time Reasoning (CoTR), which treats reasoning as a process of temporally grounded evidence composition. Specifically, during training, CoTR introduces a temporal-reward GRPO to encourage temporally grounded reasoning. During inference, it employs an anchor-observe-infer evidence-seeking loop to iteratively localize, verify, and compose temporal evidence before producing the final answer. Experiments demonstrate the usefulness of SportsTime as a benchmark and the effectiveness of CoTR, which consistently improves temporal compositional reasoning and step-wise grounding quality over strong MLLM baselines.

item.title: FILTR: Extracting Topological Features from Pretrained 3D Models
item.author: Martinez, Louis, Ovsjanikov, Maks
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为FILTR的框架，用于从3D点云编码器中提取拓扑信息，并提出了合成基准DONUT。该方法通过Transformer解码器将持久性图生成视为集合预测任务，实现了从原始点云中数据驱动的拓扑特征提取。

背景: 3D点云编码器在几何或语义任务上表现强大，而拓扑描述符能提供形状的多尺度结构总结。现有研究主要关注几何或语义任务，较少涉及拓扑信息的提取。

目的: 探讨能否从3D编码器产生的特征中推导出拓扑信息，并实现从原始点云中数据驱动的持久性图提取。

方法: 提出了DONUT合成基准和FILTR框架。FILTR利用Transformer解码器，将持久性图生成视为集合预测任务，直接从冻结的编码器预测持久性图。

主要发现: 现有的3D编码器仅保留有限的拓扑信号。FILTR能够利用这些编码器产生的信息来近似持久性图，成功实现了拓扑信息的提取。

结论: FILTR框架能够有效地利用现有编码器的特征来近似持久性图，通过高效的可学习前馈机制，首次实现了从原始点云中数据驱动的拓扑信息提取。

翻译: Recent advances in pretraining 3D point cloud encoders (e.g., Point-BERT, Point-MAE) have produced powerful models, whose abilities are typically evaluated on geometric or semantic tasks. At the same time, topological descriptors have been shown to provide informative summaries of a shape's multiscale structure. In this paper we pose the question whether topological information can be derived from features produced by 3D encoders. To address this question, we first introduce DONUT, a synthetic benchmark with controlled topological complexity, and propose FILTR (Filtration Transformer), a learnable framework to predict persistence diagrams directly from frozen encoders. FILTR adapts a transformer decoder to treat diagram generation as a set prediction task. Our analysis on DONUT reveals that existing encoders retain only limited global topological signals, yet FILTR successfully leverages information produced by these encoders to approximate persistence diagrams. Our approach enables, for the first time, data-driven extraction of persistence diagrams from raw point clouds through an efficient learnable feed-forward mechanism.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决如何从预训练的 3D 模型中提取拓扑特征的问题。目前的预训练模型主要关注几何特征，往往忽略了形状的拓扑结构。提取这些特征对于提升模型对物体形状的理解能力至关重要，从而能更好地完成三维形状分类和分割等任务。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Recent advances in pretraining 3D point cloud encoders (e.g., Point-BERT, Point-MAE) have produced powerful models, whose abilities are typically evaluated on geometric or semantic tasks. At the same time, topological descriptors have been shown to provide informative summaries of a shape's multiscale structure. In this paper we pose the question whether topological information can be derived from features produced by 3D encoders. To address this question, we first introduce DONUT, a synthetic benchmark with controlled topological complexity, and propose FILTR (Filtration Transformer), a learnable framework to predict persistence diagrams directly from frozen encoders. FILTR adapts a transformer decoder to treat diagram generation as a set prediction task. Our analysis on DONUT reveals that existing encoders retain only limited global topological signals, yet FILTR successfully leverages information produced by these encoders to approximate persistence diagrams. Our approach enables, for the first time, data-driven extraction of persistence diagrams from raw point clouds through an efficient learnable feed-forward mechanism.

item.title: One Shot Learning for Edge Detection on Point Clouds
item.author: Tu, Zhikun, Zhang, Yuhe, Jia, Yiou, Li, Kang, Cohen-Or, Daniel
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于单次学习的点云边缘提取方法，通过学习目标点云的特定数据分布，设计轻量级网络OSFENet，实现高效边缘提取。

背景: 不同扫描仪具有独特的特征和采样误差分布，在混合数据集上训练网络效果不如在单一扫描仪数据上训练有效。

目的: 为了解决跨扫描仪数据分布差异导致的训练效果不佳问题，提出一种单次学习方法，以在目标点云的特定数据分布上实现边缘提取。

方法: 提出了轻量级网络OSFENet，采用基于过滤KNN的表面块表示来支持单次学习框架，并引入RBF_DoS模块，该模块集成了基于径向基函数的表面块描述符。

主要发现: 在ABC数据集上与7个基线模型进行对比分析，证明了该方法的优势；在包含室内场景S3DIS和室外场景Semantic3D、UrbanBIS等真实扫描数据集上验证了其实用性。

结论: 该方法通过学习特定数据分布，在边缘提取任务上取得了优于基于通用数据分布训练的网络的性能，并验证了其在多种真实场景下的有效性。

翻译: 每个扫描仪都具有独特的特征，并表现出不同的采样误差分布。在包含来自不同扫描仪数据的集上训练网络，不如在特定于单个扫描仪的数据上训练有效。因此，我们提出了一种新颖的单次学习方法，允许在点云上进行边缘提取，通过学习目标点云的特定数据分布，从而实现比在通用数据分布上训练的网络更好的结果。更具体地说，我们介绍了如何通过设计基于过滤KNN的表面块表示来训练名为OSFENet的轻量级网络，该表示支持单次学习框架。此外，我们引入了一个RBF_DoS模块，它集成了基于径向基函数的表面块描述符，这对点云上的边缘提取非常有益。所提出的OSFENet的优势通过在ABC数据集上与7个基线模型进行对比分析得到证明，其实用性通过包括室内场景如S3DIS数据集和室外场景如Semantic3D数据集和UrbanBIS数据集在内的各种真实扫描数据集的结果得到验证。

深度解读

Abstract

Each scanner possesses its unique characteristics and exhibits its distinct sampling error distribution. Training a network on a dataset that includes data collected from different scanners is less effective than training it on data specific to a single scanner. Therefore, we present a novel one-shot learning method allowing for edge extraction on point clouds, by learning the specific data distribution of the target point cloud, and thus achieve superior results compared to networks that were trained on general data distributions. More specifically, we present how to train a lightweight network named OSFENet (One-Shot edge Feature Extraction Network), by designing a filtered-KNN-based surface patch representation that supports a one-shot learning framework. Additionally, we introduce an RBF_DoS module, which integrates Radial Basis Function-based Descriptor of the Surface patch, highly beneficial for the edge extraction on point clouds. The advantage of the proposed OSFENet is demonstrated through comparative analyses against 7 baselines on the ABC dataset, and its practical utility is validated by results across diverse real-scanned datasets, including indoor scenes like S3DIS dataset, and outdoor scenes such as the Semantic3D dataset and UrbanBIS dataset.

item.title: Selective Contrastive Learning For Gloss Free Sign Language Translation
item.author: Lai, Changhao, Zhao, Rui, Zhong, Xuewen, Su, Jinsong, Chen, Yidong
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种选择性对比学习策略，用于解决手语翻译中随机负样本噪声大的问题。

背景: 手语翻译存在视觉与文本模态不匹配的挑战。现有系统使用CLIP类预训练，但随机批次对比学习存在批次依赖性强、易引入噪声的问题。

目的: 解决随机负样本对有效对齐贡献不足的问题，提升手语翻译系统的性能。

方法: 提出SCL-SLT方法，引入配对选择策略。通过分析相似度轨迹对负样本进行评分，并利用课程学习构建批次，逐步引入更具挑战性的负样本。

主要发现: 分析表明，大多数随机负样本在训练过程中并未被有效推开，相似度往往不降低，说明它们对有效对齐信息量不足。

结论: 该方法通过筛选高质量负样本，减少了噪声影响，增强了对比监督信号，从而改善了跨模态对齐效果。

翻译: Sign language translation (SLT) converts continuous sign videos into spoken-language text, yet it remains challenging due to the intrinsic modality mismatch between visual signs and written text, particularly in gloss-free settings. Recent SLT systems increasingly adopt CLIP-like Vision-Language pretraining (VLP) for cross-modal alignment, but the random in-batch contrast provides few, batch-dependent negatives and may mislabel semantically similar (or even identical) pairs as negatives, introducing noisy and potentially inconsistent alignment supervision. In this work, we first conduct a preliminary trajectory-based analysis that tracks negative video-text similarity over training. The results show that only a small subset of negatives exhibits the desired behavior of being consistently pushed away, while the remaining negatives display heterogeneous and often non-decreasing similarity dynamics, suggesting that random in-batch negatives are frequently uninformative for effective alignment. Inspired by this, we propose Selective Contrastive Learning for SLT (SCL-SLT) with a Pair Selection (PS) strategy. PS scores candidate negatives using similarity dynamics from reference checkpoints and constructs mini-batches via a curriculum that progressively emphasizes more challenging negatives, thereby strengthening contrastive supervision while reducing the influence of noisy or semantically invalid negatives.

Abstract

Sign language translation (SLT) converts continuous sign videos into spoken-language text, yet it remains challenging due to the intrinsic modality mismatch between visual signs and written text, particularly in gloss-free settings. Recent SLT systems increasingly adopt CLIP-like Vision-Language pretraining (VLP) for cross-modal alignment, but the random in-batch contrast provides few, batch-dependent negatives and may mislabel semantically similar (or even identical) pairs as negatives, introducing noisy and potentially inconsistent alignment supervision. In this work, we first conduct a preliminary trajectory-based analysis that tracks negative video-text similarity over training. The results show that only a small subset of negatives exhibits the desired behavior of being consistently pushed away, while the remaining negatives display heterogeneous and often non-decreasing similarity dynamics, suggesting that random in-batch negatives are frequently uninformative for effective alignment. Inspired by this, we propose Selective Contrastive Learning for SLT (SCL-SLT) with a Pair Selection (PS) strategy. PS scores candidate negatives using similarity dynamics from reference checkpoints and constructs mini-batches via a curriculum that progressively emphasizes more challenging negatives, thereby strengthening contrastive supervision while reducing the influence of noisy or semantically invalid negatives.

item.title: Holo360D: A Large-Scale Real-World Dataset with Continuous Trajectories for Advancing Panoramic 3D Reconstruction and Beyond
item.author: Ou, Jing, Cao, Zidong, Ren, Yinrui, Li, Zhuoxiao, Zhu, Jinjing, Hua, Tongyan, Zhang, Shuai, Xiong, Hui, Zhao, Wufan
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出Holo360D数据集，旨在解决全景3D重建中的数据集缺失问题。

背景: 现有前馈3D重建模型在全景图上因球形畸变导致性能下降；现有全景数据集轨迹不连续，阻碍多视图重建发展。

目的: 发布Holo360D数据集，包含连续全景序列、高完整性深度图、点云和网格，建立新基准。

方法: 使用3D激光扫描仪和360相机采集数据；通过在线和离线SLAM系统处理；提出后处理管道（几何去噪、网格孔洞填充、区域重网格化）；在数据集上微调模型建立基准。

主要发现: Holo360D是首个提供连续全景序列和高完整性深度图的大规模数据集；微调策略提供关键见解。

结论: Holo360D提供优越的训练信号，是推进全景3D重建模型的全面基准；数据集和代码将公开发布。

翻译: 虽然前馈3D重建模型发展迅速，但在全景图上仍因球形畸变导致性能下降。此外，现有的全景3D数据集大多使用固定在离散位置的360相机采集，导致轨迹不连续。这些限制严重阻碍了全景前馈3D重建的发展，特别是在多视图设置中。本文提出了Holo360D，一个包含109,495张全景图及其配准点云、网格和相机姿态的综合数据集。据我们所知，Holo360D是首个提供连续全景序列和高完整性深度图的大规模数据集。原始数据最初使用3D激光扫描仪与360相机耦合采集。随后，原始数据通过在线和离线SLAM系统进行处理。此外，为了提高3D数据质量，提出了一种针对360数据集的后处理管道，包括几何去噪、网格孔洞填充和区域特定重网格化。最后，通过在Holo360D上微调3D重建模型，建立了新基准，提供了关于有效微调策略的关键见解。结果表明，Holo360D提供了优越的训练信号，并为推进全景3D重建模型提供了全面基准。数据集和代码将公开发布。

深度解读

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 发布了一个名为 Holo360D 的大规模真实世界数据集，包含连续轨迹，用于推进全景 3D 重建。

Abstract

While feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have advanced rapidly, they still exhibit degraded performance on panoramas due to spherical distortions. Moreover, existing panoramic 3D datasets are predominantly collected with 360 cameras fixed at discrete locations, resulting in discontinuous trajectories. These limitations critically hinder the development of panoramic feed-forward 3D reconstruction, especially for the multi-view setting. In this paper, we present Holo360D, a comprehensive dataset containing 109,495 panoramas paired with registered point clouds, meshes, and aligned camera poses. To our knowledge, Holo360D is the first large-scale dataset that provides continuous panoramic sequences with accurately aligned high-completeness depth maps. The raw data are initially collected using a 3D laser scanner coupled with a 360 camera. Subsequently, the raw data are processed with both online and offline SLAM systems. Furthermore, to enhance the 3D data quality, a post-processing pipeline tailored for the 360 dataset is proposed, including geometry denoising, mesh hole filling, and region-specific remeshing. Finally, we establish a new benchmark by fine-tuning 3D reconstruction models on Holo360D, providing key insights into effective fine-tuning strategies. Our results demonstrate that Holo360D delivers superior training signals and provides a comprehensive benchmark for advancing panoramic 3D reconstruction models. Datasets and Code will be made publicly available.

item.title: AdapTime: Enabling Adaptive Temporal Reasoning in Large Language Models
item.author: Deng, Yimin, Wang, Yejing, Lin, Zhenxi, Fu, Zichuan, Zhao, Guoshuai, Xu, Derong, Zheng, Yefeng, Zhao, Xiangyu, Wu, Xian, Zhu, Li, Qian, Xueming
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 AdapTime 的自适应时间推理方法，通过动态执行推理步骤来增强大语言模型的时间推理能力。

背景: 大语言模型在一般知识问答中表现出了强大的推理能力，但在处理时间信息方面仍然有限。现有的方法通常涉及外部工具或手动验证，并且针对特定场景进行定制，导致泛化能力差。此外，这些方法对所有问题应用固定的流程，忽略了不同类型的时间问题需要不同的推理策略这一事实，这导致了对简单案例的不必要处理和对复杂案例的推理不足。

目的: 解决现有方法泛化能力差、对不同类型时间问题处理不当的问题，提升大语言模型的时间推理能力。

方法: AdapTime 方法。该方法根据输入上下文动态执行推理步骤。具体包括三个时间推理动作：重新表述、重写和审查，并由 LLM 规划器引导推理过程。该方法无需外部支持即可与最先进的大语言模型无缝集成。

主要发现: AdapTime 显著增强了大语言模型的时间推理能力。广泛的实验证明了我们方法的有效性。

结论: AdapTime 是一种有效的自适应时间推理方法，无需外部支持即可显著提升大语言模型的时间推理能力。

翻译: 大语言模型在一般知识问答中表现出了强大的推理能力。然而，它们处理时间信息的能力仍然有限。为了解决这一局限性，现有的方法通常涉及外部工具或手动验证，并且针对特定场景进行定制，导致泛化能力差。此外，这些方法对所有问题应用固定的流程，忽略了不同类型的时间问题需要不同的推理策略这一事实，这导致了对简单案例的不必要处理和对复杂案例的推理不足。为此，我们提出了 AdapTime，这是一种自适应的时间推理方法，根据输入上下文动态执行推理步骤。具体而言，它涉及三个时间推理动作：重新表述、重写和审查，并由 LLM 规划器引导推理过程。AdapTime 与最先进的大语言模型无缝集成，并且在不依赖外部支持的情况下显著增强了它们的时间推理能力。广泛的实验证明了我们方法的有效性。

Abstract

Large language models have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities in general knowledge question answering. However, their ability to handle temporal information remains limited. To address this limitation, existing approaches often involve external tools or manual verification and are tailored to specific scenarios, leading to poor generalizability. Moreover, these methods apply a fixed pipeline to all questions, overlooking the fact that different types of temporal questions require distinct reasoning strategies, which leads to unnecessary processing for simple cases and inadequate reasoning for complex ones. To this end, we propose AdapTime, an adaptive temporal reasoning method that dynamically executes reasoning steps based on the input context. Specifically, it involves three temporal reasoning actions: reformulate, rewrite and review, with an LLM planner guiding the reasoning process. AdapTime integrates seamlessly with state-of-the-art LLMs and significantly enhances their temporal reasoning capabilities without relying on external support. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

item.title: Graph Neural Ordinary Differential Equations for Power System Identification
item.author: Wolf, Hannes M. H., Hans, Christian A.
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种消息传递图神经ODE（MPG-NODEs），用于识别具有异质节点动力学和边耦合的电力系统。

背景: 随着分布式能源的发展，电网复杂性增加，物理建模困难；同时数据可用性促进了数据驱动建模；图NODEs通过结构归纳偏置改善了泛化能力。

目的: 开发一种能够识别具有异质节点动力学和边耦合的耦合系统的模型。

方法: 采用图NODEs并引入新思想，开发MPG-NODEs。该方法包含推断未测量状态潜在表示的架构、处理异质性的局部节点和边嵌入，以及用于分段常数控制输入的自回归方案。

主要发现: 在IEEE 9节点系统上的案例研究表明，MPG-NODE提供了更灵活的框架，具有迁移学习选项，允许添加或移除线路和单元而无需重新训练。

结论: MPG-NODE在电力系统电压和频率动力学识别方面表现良好，相比单体NODE具有更好的灵活性和迁移学习能力。

翻译: With the shift towards decentralized energy generation, the increasing complexity of power systems renders physics-based modeling challenging. At the same time the growing amount of available measurement data opens the door for obtaining models in a data-driven manner. A modern method to do so are neural ordinary differential equations (NODEs), offering a framework for continuous time system identification. Recent extensions, so called graph NODEs impose a structural inductive bias that has the potential to improve generalization of the learned representation. In this work, we employ graph NODEs and extend them with novel ideas to develop message-passing graph NODEs (MPG-NODEs) for identification of coupled systems with heterogeneous node dynamics and edge couplings. This encompasses state-of-the-art machine learning architectures to infer latent representations of unmeasured states from past measurements, local node and edge embeddings to account for heterogeneity as well as an autoregressive scheme to allow for piecewise constant control inputs. We apply MPG-NODEs to identify voltage and frequency dynamics of power systems and compare them to a monolith NODE under identical measurement assumptions. Our case study on the IEEE 9-bus system indicates that the proposed MPG-NODE offers a much more flexible framework with transfer learning options that allow to add or remove powerlines and units with little to no retraining.

Abstract

With the shift towards decentralized energy generation, the increasing complexity of power systems renders physics-based modeling challenging. At the same time the growing amount of available measurement data opens the door for obtaining models in a data-driven manner. A modern method to do so are neural ordinary differential equations (NODEs), offering a framework for continuous time system identification. Recent extensions, so called graph NODEs impose a structural inductive bias that has the potential to improve generalization of the learned representation. In this work, we employ graph NODEs and extend them with novel ideas to develop message-passing graph NODEs (MPG-NODEs) for identification of coupled systems with heterogeneous node dynamics and edge couplings. This encompasses state-of-the-art machine learning architectures to infer latent representations of unmeasured states from past measurements, local node and edge embeddings to account for heterogeneity as well as an autoregressive scheme to allow for piecewise constant control inputs. We apply MPG-NODEs to identify voltage and frequency dynamics of power systems and compare them to a monolith NODE under identical measurement assumptions. Our case study on the IEEE 9-bus system indicates that the proposed MPG-NODE offers a much more flexible framework with transfer learning options that allow to add or remove powerlines and units with little to no retraining.

item.title: R$^3$-SQL: Ranking Reward and Resampling for Text-to-SQL
item.author: Han, Hojae, Jeong, Yeonseok, Hwang, Seung-won, Yao, Zhewei, He, Yuxiong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: R3-SQL 是一个用于 Text-to-SQL 的框架，通过统一奖励和重采样机制解决评分不一致和召回率问题。

背景: 现有 Text-to-SQL 系统在生成多个候选 SQL 并排序时，存在对功能等价 SQL 评分不一致，以及当正确 SQL 缺失时无法恢复的问题。

目的: 提出一种名为 R3-SQL 的框架，旨在解决评分不一致和候选池召回率低的问题。

方法: 1. 按执行结果分组候选 SQL 并对组进行排序以保证一致性。2. 结合组间成对偏好和基于最佳组排名及大小的点状效用来评分。3. 引入智能体重采样机制，在正确 SQL 可能缺失时选择性重采样。

主要发现: 在 BIRD-dev 数据集上达到 75.03 的执行准确率，是已知模型规模方法中的新 SOTA，并在五个基准测试中持续提升。

结论: R3-SQL 通过统一奖励和重采样有效解决了评分不一致和召回率问题，取得了优异的性能。

翻译: 现代文本到 SQL 系统生成多个候选 SQL 查询并对其进行排名以判断最终预测。然而，现有方法面临两个限制。首先，尽管执行结果相同，它们经常对功能等价的 SQL 查询评分不一致。其次，当候选池中缺少正确的 SQL 时，排名无法恢复。我们提出了 R3-SQL，一个通过排名和重采样的统一奖励来解决这两个问题的文本到 SQL 框架。R3-SQL 首先按执行结果对候选者进行分组，并对组进行排名以保证一致性。为了对每组进行评分，它结合了组间的成对偏好和来自最佳组排名和大小的点状效用，捕捉相对偏好、一致性和候选质量。为了提高候选者召回率，R3-SQL 引入了智能体重采样，它评估生成的候选者池，并在正确 SQL 可能缺失时进行选择性重采样。R3-SQL 在 BIRD-dev 上实现了 75.03 的执行准确率，这是使用已知模型规模的方法中的新 SOTA，并在五个基准测试中持续提升。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Modern Text-to-SQL systems generate multiple candidate SQL queries and rank them to judge a final prediction. However, existing methods face two limitations. First, they often score functionally equivalent SQL queries inconsistently despite identical execution results. Second, ranking cannot recover when the correct SQL is absent from the candidate pool. We propose R$^3$-SQL, a Text-to-SQL framework that addresses both issues through unified reward for ranking and resampling. R$^3$-SQL first groups candidates by execution result and ranks groups for consistency. To score each group, it combines a pairwise preference across groups with a pointwise utility from the best group rank and size, capturing relative preference, consistency, and candidate quality. To improve candidate recall, R$^3$-SQL introduces agentic resampling, which judges the generated candidate pool and selectively resamples when the correct SQL is likely absent. R$^3$-SQL achieves 75.03 execution accuracy on BIRD-dev, a new state of the art among methods using models with disclosed sizes, with consistent gains across five benchmarks.

item.title: SpatialFusion: Endowing Unified Image Generation with Intrinsic 3D Geometric Awareness
item.author: Haiyi Qiu, Kaihang Pan, Jiacheng Li, Juncheng Li, Siliang Tang, Yueting Zhuang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出SpatialFusion框架，通过引入3D几何感知能力提升统一图像生成模型在空间感知任务中的表现。

背景: 统一图像生成模型利用多模态大语言模型进行语义理解，利用扩散模型进行图像生成，但在空间感知任务中存在内在的空间理解缺乏和生成过程中缺乏显式几何引导的局限性。

目的: 提出一种名为SpatialFusion的新框架，将3D几何感知能力内化到统一图像生成模型中。

方法: 采用混合Transformer架构，在多模态大语言模型中增加并行空间Transformer以增强3D几何建模能力。空间Transformer通过共享自注意力机制，从丰富的语义上下文中推导目标图像的度量深度图。然后将这些显式几何骨架通过专门的深度适配器注入扩散模型主干，为空间连贯的图像生成提供精确的空间约束。采用渐进式两阶段训练策略。

主要发现: 在空间感知基准测试中显著提升了性能，特别是优于GPT-4o等领先模型。在文本到图像生成和图像编辑场景中均实现了泛化性能提升，同时保持可忽略的推理开销。

结论: SpatialFusion框架有效解决了现有模型在空间感知任务中的局限性，通过引入3D几何感知和显式几何引导，实现了高质量的空间连贯图像生成。

翻译: 近期的统一图像生成模型通过利用多模态大语言模型进行语义理解和利用扩散模型进行图像生成，取得了显著成功。然而，由于缺乏内在的空间理解以及在生成过程中缺乏显式的几何引导，这些模型在空间感知任务中仍存在根本性的局限性。在本文中，我们提出了SpatialFusion，这是一个新颖的框架，将3D几何感知内化到统一图像生成模型中。具体而言，我们首先采用混合Transformer架构，通过并行空间Transformer增强多模态大语言模型的3D几何建模能力。通过与多模态大语言模型共享自注意力机制，空间Transformer学习从丰富的语义上下文中推导目标图像的度量深度图。然后，通过专门的深度适配器将这些显式几何骨架注入扩散模型主干，为空间连贯的图像生成提供精确的空间约束。通过渐进式两阶段训练策略，SpatialFusion显著提升了在空间感知基准测试中的性能，特别是优于GPT-4o等领先模型。此外，它在文本到图像生成和图像编辑场景中均实现了泛化性能提升，同时保持可忽略的推理开销。
