item.title: PRISM: Refracting the Entangled User Behavior Space for E-Commerce Search
item.author: Haoqian Zhang, Ziyuan Yang, Yi Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 PRISM 的电商搜索行为预测框架，通过显式建模用户偏好与物品相关性之间的交互，解决行为信号纠缠和语义错位问题。

背景: 电商搜索系统通常假设用户偏好和物品相关性是稳定且独立的信号。然而，用户交互受到曝光机制、反馈循环和语义匹配的共同影响，导致行为信号纠缠且动态漂移，从而限制了下游排序模型的鲁棒性。

目的: 为了解决偏好估计和相关性建模中的混淆效应和语义错位问题，提高下游排序模型的鲁棒性。

方法: 提出了 PRISM 框架。它包含偏好修正模块，在相关性感知约束下迭代优化用户偏好；引入基于大语言模型的语义锚定机制，利用正负原型校准相关性表示；以及偏好条件证据路由模块，自适应聚合多源行为信号。

主要发现: 在两个公开的电商基准数据集上的大量实验表明，PRISM 持续优于强基线模型。

结论: 显式建模用户偏好与物品相关性之间的交互对于构建鲁棒且语义基础坚实的搜索行为模型是有效的。

翻译: E-commerce search systems rely on modeling user behavior to estimate item relevance and user preference, which are typically assumed to be stable and independently learnable signals. However, in practice, user interactions are jointly shaped by exposure mechanisms, feedback loops, and semantic matching, leading to entangled and dynamically drifting behavioral signals. As a result, both preference estimation and relevance modeling suffer from confounding effects and semantic misalignment, which limits the robustness of downstream ranking models. To address this issue, we propose PRISM, a Preference-Relevance Interaction Semantic Modeling framework for e-commerce search behavior prediction. PRISM explicitly models the interaction between user preference and item relevance rather than treating them as independent components. Specifically, it introduces a preference rectification module to iteratively refine user preference under relevance-aware constraints, improving robustness against behavioral confounding. To ensure semantic consistency, we further incorporate a large language model (LLM)-driven semantic anchoring mechanism that leverages positive and negative prototypes to calibrate relevance representations. Finally, a preference-conditioned evidence routing module adaptively aggregates multi-source behavioral signals, enabling context-aware and preference-aligned relevance estimation. Extensive experiments on two public e-commerce benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM consistently outperforms strong baselines, validating the effectiveness of explicitly modeling preference-relevance interaction for robust and semantically grounded search behavior modeling.

Abstract

E-commerce search systems rely on modeling user behavior to estimate item relevance and user preference, which are typically assumed to be stable and independently learnable signals. However, in practice, user interactions are jointly shaped by exposure mechanisms, feedback loops, and semantic matching, leading to entangled and dynamically drifting behavioral signals. As a result, both preference estimation and relevance modeling suffer from confounding effects and semantic misalignment, which limits the robustness of downstream ranking models. To address this issue, we propose PRISM, a Preference-Relevance Interaction Semantic Modeling framework for e-commerce search behavior prediction. PRISM explicitly models the interaction between user preference and item relevance rather than treating them as independent components. Specifically, it introduces a preference rectification module to iteratively refine user preference under relevance-aware constraints, improving robustness against behavioral confounding. To ensure semantic consistency, we further incorporate a large language model (LLM)-driven semantic anchoring mechanism that leverages positive and negative prototypes to calibrate relevance representations. Finally, a preference-conditioned evidence routing module adaptively aggregates multi-source behavioral signals, enabling context-aware and preference-aligned relevance estimation. Extensive experiments on two public e-commerce benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM consistently outperforms strong baselines, validating the effectiveness of explicitly modeling preference-relevance interaction for robust and semantically grounded search behavior modeling.

item.title: DCGL: Dual-Channel Graph Learning with Large Language Models for Knowledge-Aware Recommendation
item.author: Xinchi Zou, Tongzhenzhi Su, Jianjun Li, Yuan Fu, Chang Liu, Zhiying Deng, Zhiwei Shen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为DCGL的框架，通过双通道架构、多级对比学习和动态融合机制，解决了现有KG和LLM融合方法在语义建模、融合方式和交互频率考虑上的不足。

背景: 知识图谱（KG）在推荐系统中能有效捕获潜在的项目关系，结合大语言模型（LLM）增强了语义理解并缓解了知识稀疏问题。然而，当前的KG和LLM方法仍面临三大主要局限性。

目的: 解决现有KG和LLM方法在隐式语义关系建模、ID与LLM嵌入融合方式以及用户-项目交互频率考虑方面的不足。

方法: 提出了双通道图学习（DCGL）框架，包含三个关键创新：1) 双通道架构，结构上分离语义信息和用户行为模式；2) 多级对比学习机制，通过视图内对比增强鲁棒性并桥接视图间差距；3) 动态融合机制，根据交互频率自适应平衡语义泛化和行为特异性。

主要发现: 在四个真实数据集上的广泛实验表明，DCGL始终优于最先进的方法，在稀疏场景下取得了显著改进，同时保持了活跃用户的精度。

结论: DCGL框架有效解决了现有方法的局限性，在推荐任务中表现优异，代码已开源。

翻译: 知识图谱（KG）已被证明在推荐系统中非常有效，能够捕获潜在的项目关系，而最近结合大语言模型（LLM）进一步增强了语义理解并解决了知识稀疏问题。然而，当前的基于KG和LLM的方法仍面临三个主要局限性：1) 对显式KG链接之外的隐式语义关系建模不足；2) ID和LLM嵌入的单通道融合次优，往往导致信号干扰和表示模糊；3) 在推荐策略中对用户-项目交互频率变化的考虑不足。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了双通道图学习（DCGL）框架，具有三个关键创新：1) 双通道架构，结构上分离丰富的语义信息和用户行为模式，防止早期干扰；2) 多级对比学习机制，通过视图内对比增强对KG噪声的鲁棒性，并通过视图间对齐桥接通道间的语义差距；3) 动态融合机制，根据交互频率自适应平衡语义泛化和行为特异性，解决了级联局限性。在四个真实数据集上的广泛实验表明，DCGL始终优于最先进的方法，在稀疏场景下产生显著改进，同时保持活跃用户的精度。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/XinchiZou/DCGL 获取。

Abstract

Knowledge Graphs (KGs) have proven highly effective for recommendation systems by capturing latent item relationships, while recent integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) has further enhanced semantic understanding and addressed knowledge sparsity issues. Nevertheless, current KG-and-LLM-based methods still face three main limitations: 1) inadequate modeling of implicit semantic relationships beyond explicit KG links; 2) suboptimal single-channel fusion of ID and LLM embeddings, which often leads to signal interference and blurred representations; and 3) insufficient consideration of user-item interaction frequency variations in recommendation strategies. To address these challenges, we propose the Dual-Channel Graph Learning (DCGL) framework, featuring three key innovations: 1) a dual-channel architecture that structurally decouples rich semantic information from user behavioral patterns, preventing early interference; 2) a multi-level contrastive learning mechanism that enhances robustness against KG noise through intra-view contrasts and bridges semantic gaps between channels via inter-view alignment; and 3) a dynamic fusion mechanism that adaptively balances semantic generalization and behavioral specificity based on interaction frequency, resolving the cascading limitation. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets show that DCGL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, yielding substantial improvements in sparse scenarios while maintaining precision for active users. Our code is available at https://github.com/XinchiZou/DCGL.

item.title: RCoT-Seg: Reinforced Chain-of-Thought for Video Reasoning and Segmentation
item.author: Junwei Wen, Deshui Miao, Guangming Lu, Xin Li, Wenjie Pei
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 RCoT-Seg 的视频推理分割框架，通过将时间推理与空间感知分离来提升分割性能。

背景: 现有基于多模态大语言模型的方法在关键帧选择上存在局限性，导致时间理解不足和定位脆弱。

目的: 解决现有方法在复杂多目标场景中定位脆弱的问题，增强整体时间理解和分割性能。

方法: 提出 RCoT-Seg 框架，分为时间视频推理和关键帧目标感知两个阶段。TVR 阶段利用代理模块进行关键帧生成与自评估；KTP 阶段使用 SAM2 方法进行分割与掩码传播。

主要发现: 实验结果表明，RCoT-Seg 在空间精度和帧间一致性上表现优异，性能优于现有方法。

结论: RCoT-Seg 显式分离了时间推理与空间感知，有效解决了关键帧选择和分割定位问题，实验验证了其有效性。

翻译: Video Reasoning Segmentation (VRS) 旨在根据传达人类意图和时间逻辑的隐式指令，对视频中的目标对象进行分割。现有的基于多模态大语言模型的方法在通过简单采样或辅助多模态大语言模型选择帧后，使用 [SEG] 标记预测掩码，其中有限的监督和帧-语言相似性规则往往导致范围狭窄的关键帧选择，削弱了整体时间理解，并在复杂的多目标场景中导致定位脆弱。为了解决这些问题，我们介绍了 RCoT-Seg，一个思维链视频框架，它将 VRS 分解为时间视频推理（TVR）和关键帧目标感知（KTP），显式地将时间推理与空间感知分离。具体来说，在 TVR 阶段，提出了一种代理关键帧选择模块，使用精心策划的 CoT 起始语料库初始化，并在任务对齐的奖励下通过 GRPO 进行优化，以通过自评估生成和重新选择关键帧，加强时刻定位和时间推理。在 KTP 阶段，RCoT-Seg 在选定帧上执行高分辨率分割，并使用基于 SAM2 的方法沿序列传播掩码，替换启发式采样和外部选择器，同时提高空间精度和帧间一致性。广泛的实验结果表明，所提出的 RCoT-Seg 相比最先进的方法取得了有竞争力的性能。代码和模型将在 https://github.com/Victor-wjw/RCoT-Seg 上公开发布。

Abstract

Video Reasoning Segmentation (VRS) aims to segment target objects in videos based on implicit instructions that convey human intent and temporal logic. Existing MLLM-based methods predict masks with a [SEG] token after selecting frames via simple sampling or an auxiliary MLLM, where limited supervision and frame-language similarity rules often yield narrow-scope keyframe choices that weaken holistic temporal understanding and lead to brittle localization in complex multi-object scenes. To address these issues, we introduce RCoT-Seg, a video-of-thought framework that factorizes VRS into temporal video reasoning (TVR) and keyframe target perception (KTP), explicitly separating temporal reasoning from spatial perception. Specifically, in the TVR stage, an agentic keyframe selection module, initialized with a curated CoT-start corpus and refined by GRPO under task-aligned rewards, is proposed to generate and reselect the keyframe through self-evaluation, strengthening moment localization and temporal reasoning. In the KTP stage, RCoT-Seg performs high-resolution segmentation on the selected frame and propagates masks with SAM2-based methods across the sequence, replacing heuristic sampling and external selectors while improving spatial precision and inter-frame consistency. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed RCoT-Seg achieves favorable performance against the state-of-the-art methods. The code and models will be publicly released at https://github.com/Victor-wjw/RCoT-Seg.

item.title: UniD-Shift: Towards Unified Semantic Segmentation via Interpretable Share-Private Multimodal Decomposition
item.author: Shuai Zhang, Zhecheng Shi, Zhuxiao Li, Jing Ou, Tengxi Wang, Yuan Liu, Wufan Zhao
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种统一的 2D-3D 语义分割框架，通过分解共享和私有特征空间来融合多模态信息。

背景: 大规模 3D 点云语义分割对自动驾驶和城市数字孪生至关重要，但激光雷达稀疏采样和图像观测的几何畸变阻碍了跨模态对齐和融合。

目的: 构建一个统一的 2D-3D 语义分割框架，利用 2D 和 3D 特征的共性语义。

方法: 结合基于 SAM 的视觉编码器和基于 SPTNet 的几何编码器提取互补特征；将特征显式分解为共享和私有子空间；使用轻量级注意力融合模块聚合共享特征；采用正则化训练目标确保语义对齐和子空间独立性。

主要发现: 在 SemanticKITTI 和 nuScenes 数据集上，相比代表性多模态基线，分割精度得到一致提升，且计算效率具有竞争力；在 nuScenes 跨域评估中表现出对分布偏移的稳定性能和强大的泛化能力。

结论: 该方法在保持计算效率的同时提高了分割精度，并具备良好的跨域泛化能力，代码已公开。

翻译: 大规模 3D 点云的语义分割对于自动驾驶和城市数字孪生等应用至关重要。然而，激光雷达的稀疏采样模式和图像观测中依赖视角的几何畸变使得跨模态对齐变得复杂，并阻碍了稳定的融合。受相机拍摄的 2D 图像是 3D 世界表示这一事实的启发，我们认识到从 2D 和 3D 分割中学习的特征共享一些共同的语义，而其他方面则保持模态特定性。这一见解促使我们提出一个用于联合 2D-3D 语义分割的统一多模态框架。我们将基于 SAM 的视觉编码器与基于 SPTNet 的几何编码器相结合，以提取互补的语义和几何表示。来自两种模态的显式分解为共享和私有子空间，其中共享组件总结两个领域共有的语义因素，而私有组件保留每个模态独有的属性。一个轻量级的基于注意力的融合模块将共享特征聚合为一致的多模态表示，一个正则化的训练目标确保语义对齐和子空间独立性。在 SemanticKITTI 和 nuScenes 基准上的实验表明，与代表性的多模态基线相比，分割精度得到一致提升，并伴随具有竞争力的计算效率。在 nuScenes 美国-新加坡上的跨域评估显示，在分布偏移下性能稳定，证明了强大的泛化能力。实现代码可在以下地址公开获取：https://github.com/shuaizhang69/UniD-SHIFT。

Abstract

Semantic segmentation of large-scale 3D point clouds is crucial for applications such as autonomous driving and urban digital twins. However, the sparse sampling pattern of LiDAR and the view-dependent geometric distortion in image observations complicate cross-modal alignment and hinder stable fusion. Inspired by the fact that 2D images captured by cameras are representations of the 3D world, we recognize that the features learned from 2D and 3D segmentation share some common semantics, while other aspects remain modality-specific. This insight motivates a unified multimodal framework for joint 2D-3D semantic segmentation. We combine a SAM-based vision encoder with a SPTNet-based geometric encoder to extract complementary semantic and geometric representations. The resulting features from both modalities are explicitly decomposed into shared and private subspaces, where the shared components summarize semantic factors common to both domains, and the private components preserve properties that are unique to each modality. A lightweight attention-based fusion module aggregates the shared features into a consistent cross-modal representation, and a regularized training objective ensures both semantic alignment and subspace independence. Experiments on the SemanticKITTI and nuScenes benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in segmentation accuracy over representative multimodal baselines, accompanied by competitive computational efficiency. Cross-domain evaluation on nuScenes USA-Singapore shows stable performance under distribution shifts, demonstrating strong generalization. The implementation code is publicly available at: https://github.com/shuaizhang69/UniD-Shift.

item.title: Emergent Symbolic Structure in Health Foundation Models: Extraction, Alignment, and Cross-Modal Transfer
item.author: Gajendra Katuwal, Advait Koparkar, Salar Abbaspourazad, Anshuman Mishra, Sarvesh Kirthivasan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出一种后训练框架，通过分解冻结嵌入为可解释符号来对齐嵌入空间，实现跨模态知识转移。

背景: 可穿戴传感器健康基础模型难以解释其编码内容及训练后跨模态转移知识。

目的: 提出一种无需重新训练的框架，利用符号对齐嵌入空间以解决解释性和跨模态转移问题。

方法: 提出后训练框架，将冻结嵌入分解为可解释符号以对齐嵌入空间。在三个用于PPG和加速度计数据的健康基础模型上评估，这些模型在约20M分钟未标记数据和约172K参与者数据上预训练，并在30K受试者的保留队列上分析。

主要发现: 提取的符号与健康状况和生理属性选择性相关，且在模态和架构间部分共享；通过符号进行跨模态转移保留了超过95%的域内性能，且在有限配对数据下饱和。

结论: 健康基础模型的嵌入包含一种跨模态共享的可解释符号组织，支持无需联合训练的跨域转移。

翻译: Health foundation models (FMs) learn useful representations from wearable sensors, but interpreting what they encode and transferring that knowledge across modalities after training remains difficult. We present a post-training framework that decomposes frozen embeddings into interpretable directions, referred to as symbols, and use these symbols to align the embedding spaces without retraining. We evaluate the framework on three FMs for photoplethysmography (PPG) and accelerometer data, independently pretrained on ~20M minutes of unlabeled data from ~172K participants, and analyzed on a held-out cohort of 30K subjects. We find that extracted symbols associate selectively with health conditions and physiological attributes, and these associations are partially shared across modalities and architectures. Cross-modal transfer via symbols retains more than 95% of in-domain performance, is nearly symmetric across domain directions, and saturates with limited paired data, together indicating that alignment recovers a shared low-dimensional subspace rich in physiological information. Overall, these results suggest that health FM embeddings contain an interpretable symbolic organization that is shared across modalities and supports cross-domain transfer without joint training.

Abstract

Health foundation models (FMs) learn useful representations from wearable sensors, but interpreting what they encode and transferring that knowledge across modalities after training remains difficult. We present a post-training framework that decomposes frozen embeddings into interpretable directions, referred to as symbols, and use these symbols to align the embedding spaces without retraining. We evaluate the framework on three FMs for photoplethysmography (PPG) and accelerometer data, independently pretrained on ~20M minutes of unlabeled data from ~172K participants, and analyzed on a held-out cohort of 30K subjects. We find that extracted symbols associate selectively with health conditions and physiological attributes, and these associations are partially shared across modalities and architectures. Cross-modal transfer via symbols retains more than 95% of in-domain performance, is nearly symmetric across domain directions, and saturates with limited paired data, together indicating that alignment recovers a shared low-dimensional subspace rich in physiological information. Overall, these results suggest that health FM embeddings contain an interpretable symbolic organization that is shared across modalities and supports cross-domain transfer without joint training.

item.title: The Proxy Presumption: From Semantic Embeddings to Valid Social Measures
item.author: Baishi Li, Ta Yu, Kelvin J. L. Koa, Ke-Wei Huang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: NLP 正成为计算社会科学的主要工具，但面临代理假设挑战。本文提出构念有效性协议（CVP）和反事实中性化方法，旨在解决嵌入表示中的混淆问题，将启发式代理转化为科学有效的测量工具。

背景: 自然语言处理正在成为计算社会科学的主要工具，研究人员使用嵌入来测量新颖性、创造力和偏见等潜在构念。

目的: 为了弥合语义嵌入与有效社会度量之间的差距，解决代理假设带来的有效性挑战。

方法: 引入构念有效性协议（CVP），结合因果表示学习和心理测量学；提出反事实中性化方法，利用大语言模型减少嵌入空间中的混淆。

主要发现: 提供了包含区分、增量和预测有效性测试的标准有效性套件，为社区提供了一套工具包，能够将启发式代理转化为稳健且科学上合理的仪器。

结论: 通过提供标准化的有效性套件和反事实中性化方法，该工作有助于将不严谨的代理指标转化为科学上可辩护的测量工具。

翻译: 自然语言处理正迅速演变为计算社会科学的主要工具，研究人员越来越多地使用嵌入来测量新颖性、创造力和偏见等潜在构念。然而，这一过渡面临一个根本的有效性挑战：“代理假设”，即依赖几何属性作为社会概念的直接度量。我们认为，如果没有明确的验证，无监督表示仍然是目标构念和主题、风格和作者等混淆属性的纠缠混合体。为了弥合语义嵌入与有效社会度量之间的差距，我们引入了构念有效性协议。借鉴因果表示学习和心理测量学，CVP 提供了从概念化到定量验证的严格流程。我们进一步提出了反事实中性化，这是一种使用大语言模型减少嵌入空间中混淆的新方法。通过提供标准化的有效性套件——包括区分、增量和预测有效性的测试——这项工作为社区提供了一套工具包，将启发式代理转化为稳健、科学上合理的仪器。

Abstract

Natural Language Processing is rapidly evolving into a primary instrument for Computational Social Science, with researchers increasingly using embeddings to measure latent constructs such as novelty, creativity, and bias. However, this transition faces a fundamental validity challenge: the ''Proxy Presumption,'' or the reliance on geometric properties (e.g., cosine distance) as direct measures of social concepts. We argue that without explicit validation, unsupervised representations remain entangled mixtures of the target construct ($C$) and confounding attributes ($Z$) like topic, style, and authorship. To bridge the gap between semantic embeddings and valid social measures, we introduce the Construct Validity Protocol (CVP). Drawing on causal representation learning and psychometrics, the CVP offers a rigorous pipeline from conceptualization to quantitative verification. We further propose Counterfactual Neutralization, a novel method using LLMs to reduce confounding in embedding space. By providing a standardized Validity Suite -- including tests for discriminant, incremental, and predictive validity -- this work offers the community a toolkit to transform heuristic proxies into robust, scientifically defensible instruments.

item.title: Sparse Autoencoders as Plug-and-Play Firewalls for Adversarial Attack Detection in VLMs
item.author: Wang, Hao, Sun, Yiqun, Wei, Pengfei, Hsieh, Lawrence B., Kawahara, Daisuke
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于稀疏自编码器的轻量级对抗性攻击检测框架 SAEgis，用于提升视觉语言模型的安全性。

背景: 视觉语言模型发展迅速并被广泛应用，但其安全性受到的关注较少，且对对抗性攻击高度脆弱，存在风险。

目的: 探索一种无需额外对抗训练且开销最小的机制来检测 VLM 中的对抗性攻击，以提高系统的安全性。

方法: 将稀疏自编码器模块插入预训练的 VLM 中，利用标准重构目标进行训练，使模型学习到的稀疏潜在特征能够捕获攻击相关信号。

主要发现: 学习到的特征可以可靠地分类输入图像是否被扰动，即使在未见过的样本上也能表现良好；在跨域泛化方面优于现有基线；结合多层信号能提高鲁棒性和稳定性。

结论: SAEgis 是首个探索 SAE 作为 VLM 对抗性攻击检测可插拔机制的工作，具有实用价值，能有效提升现实世界 VLM 系统的安全性。

翻译: Vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly and are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, especially with the rise of agent-based systems. However, their safety has received relatively limited attention. Even the latest proprietary and open-weight VLMs remain highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks, leaving downstream applications exposed to significant risks. In this work, we propose a novel and lightweight adversarial attack detection framework based on sparse autoencoders (SAEs), termed SAEgis. By inserting an SAE module into a pretrained VLM and training it with standard reconstruction objectives, we find that the learned sparse latent features naturally capture attack-relevant signals. These features enable reliable classification of whether an input image has been adversarially perturbed, even for previously unseen samples. Extensive experiments show that SAEgis achieves strong performance across in-domain, cross-domain, and cross-attack settings, with particularly large improvements in cross-domain generalization compared to existing baselines. In addition, combining signals from multiple layers further improves robustness and stability. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to explore SAE as a plug-and-play mechanism for adversarial attack detection in VLMs. Our method requires no additional adversarial training, introduces minimal overhead, and provides a practical approach for improving the safety of real-world VLM systems.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决视觉语言模型中对抗性攻击的检测问题。这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？unknown。

Abstract

Vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly and are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, especially with the rise of agent-based systems. However, their safety has received relatively limited attention. Even the latest proprietary and open-weight VLMs remain highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks, leaving downstream applications exposed to significant risks. In this work, we propose a novel and lightweight adversarial attack detection framework based on sparse autoencoders (SAEs), termed SAEgis. By inserting an SAE module into a pretrained VLM and training it with standard reconstruction objectives, we find that the learned sparse latent features naturally capture attack-relevant signals. These features enable reliable classification of whether an input image has been adversarially perturbed, even for previously unseen samples. Extensive experiments show that SAEgis achieves strong performance across in-domain, cross-domain, and cross-attack settings, with particularly large improvements in cross-domain generalization compared to existing baselines. In addition, combining signals from multiple layers further improves robustness and stability. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to explore SAE as a plug-and-play mechanism for adversarial attack detection in VLMs. Our method requires no additional adversarial training, introduces minimal overhead, and provides a practical approach for improving the safety of real-world VLM systems.

item.title: A Unified Framework for the Detection and Classification of Fatty Pancreas in Ultrasound Images
item.author: Ioan-Tudor-Alexandru Anghel, Ciprian-Mihai Ceausescu, Elena Dana Nedelcu, Elena Raluca Stirban, Camelia Croitoru, Despina Ungureanu, Ana Maria Palan, Gabriela Pop
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于超声图像的脂肪胰腺自动分类框架。

背景: 非酒精性脂肪胰腺病（NAFPD）是一种诊断不足的疾病，与代谢综合征、胰岛素抵抗和胰腺癌风险增加有关。目前的诊断依赖于临床医生对超声图像的主观视觉评估。

目的: 开发一个端到端的框架，用于自动从腹部超声图像中分类正常胰腺与脂肪胰腺。

方法: 使用基于TransUNet的分割架构（ResNet编码器和Transformer瓶颈）来勾勒胰腺和脾静脉，随后进行解剖学引导的补丁提取和成对纹理比较。分割模型通过肝脏分割任务的特定领域迁移学习进行初始化。特征工程通过比较静脉周围脂肪与胰腺实质的回声强度来模拟临床推理。

主要发现: 在包含214张腹部超声图像和107个专家标注病例的临床数据集上进行了验证。SVM（RBF核）在五折交叉验证中的平均准确率为89.7%，F1分数为0.898；无监督K-Means基线达到87.8%的准确率。这表明所提出的特征能够捕获相关的临床信号，即使在没有标记训练数据的情况下也是如此。

结论: 这是第一个使用分割引导的纹理分析从超声图像进行脂肪胰腺分类的端到端自动化框架。

翻译: 非酒精性脂肪胰腺病（NAFPD）是一种诊断不足的疾病，与代谢综合征、胰岛素抵抗和胰腺癌风险增加有关。诊断通常依赖于临床医生对超声图像的主观视觉评估。我们提出了一种从腹部超声图像自动分类正常胰腺与脂肪胰腺的端到端框架。该方法采用基于TransUNet的分割架构，结合ResNet编码器和Transformer瓶颈来勾勒胰腺和脾静脉，随后进行解剖学引导的补丁提取，并通过成对纹理比较进行患者级分类。特征工程通过比较静脉周围脂肪与胰腺实质的回声强度来模拟临床推理，为分类提供可解释的信号。分割模型通过肝脏分割任务的特定领域迁移学习进行初始化。我们在包含214张腹部超声图像和107个专家标注病例的临床数据集上，使用五折交叉验证验证了整个流程。SVM（RBF核）实现了平均交叉验证准确率89.7%和F1分数0.898，而无监督K-Means基线达到了87.8%的准确率，证明了所提出的特征能够捕获相关的临床信号，即使在没有标记训练数据的情况下也是如此。据我们所知，这是第一个使用分割引导的纹理分析从超声图像进行脂肪胰腺分类的端到端自动化框架。

Abstract

Non-alcoholic fatty pancreas disease (NAFPD) is an underdiagnosed condition associated with metabolic syndrome, insulin resistance, and increased risk of pancreatic cancer. Diagnosis typically relies on subjective visual assessment of ultrasound images by clinicians. We propose an end-to-end framework for automatically classifying normal versus fatty pancreas from abdominal ultrasound images. Our method employs a TransUNet-based segmentation architecture with a ResNet encoder and transformer bottleneck to delineate the pancreas and the splenic vein, followed by anatomically-guided patch extraction and patient-level classification through pairwise texture comparison. The feature engineering mimics clinical reasoning by comparing the echogenicity of peri-venous fat to the pancreatic parenchyma, providing an interpretable signal for classification. The segmentation models are initialized via domain-specific transfer learning from a liver segmentation task. We validate the full pipeline on a clinical dataset of 214 abdominal ultrasound images with 107 expert-labeled cases using 5-fold cross-validation. SVM with RBF kernel achieves a mean cross-validated accuracy of 89.7\%\,$\pm$\,1.8\% and F1 of 0.898\,$\pm$\,0.019, while the unsupervised K-Means baseline reaches 87.8\% accuracy, demonstrating that the proposed features capture the relevant clinical signal even without labeled training data. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end automated framework for fatty pancreas classification from ultrasound using segmentation-guided texture analysis.

item.title: Transfer Learning Across Fast- and Full-Simulation Domains in High-Energy Physics
item.author: Matthias Schott, Lucie Flek
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了高能物理中快速模拟与完全模拟数据集之间的迁移学习，发现预训练模型在多个任务中表现优异且所需数据量更少。

背景: 高能物理中的机器学习模型通常在模拟数据上训练，完全模拟样本计算成本高昂，而快速模拟虽然统计量大但真实感较低。

目的: 系统研究快速模拟与完全模拟数据集之间的迁移学习，在真实的LHC环境中评估预训练模型的效果。

方法: 使用密集神经网络、图神经网络和基于Transformer的架构，在ATLAS风格的快速模拟上进行预训练，然后适配到CMS风格的快速模拟和完全模拟的ATLAS开放数据中。任务包括信号背景分类、夸克胶子喷注标记和缺失横能重建。

主要发现: 预训练模型在所有任务中均优于独立训练的基线模型，且显著减少了目标域所需的训练数据量，通常将所需统计量减少约一半。

结论: 快速模拟可以用于学习鲁棒、可复用的表示，这激励了将训练好的模型作为可复用的科学资产进行发布。

翻译: 高能物理中的机器学习模型通常在模拟数据上训练，其中完全模拟样本计算成本高昂，而快速模拟在降低真实感的情况下提供了大量统计数据。在这项工作中，我们在真实的LHC环境中系统研究了快速模拟与完全模拟数据集之间的迁移学习。我们考虑了三个代表性任务，信号背景分类、夸克胶子喷注标记和缺失横能重建，使用密集神经网络、图神经网络和基于Transformer的架构。模型在ATLAS风格的快速模拟上进行预训练，并适配到CMS风格的快速模拟和完全模拟的ATLAS开放数据中。在所有任务中，预训练模型始终优于独立训练的基线模型，并且需要显著更少的目标域训练数据，通常将所需统计量减少约一半。这些结果表明，快速模拟可以用于学习鲁棒、可复用的表示，并激励将训练好的模型作为大型基础模型之外的可复用科学资产进行发布。

Abstract

Machine-learning models in high-energy physics are often trained on simulated data, where fully simulated samples are computationally expensive while fast simulation provides large statistics at reduced realism. In this work, we systematically study transfer learning between fast-simulated and fully simulated datasets in a realistic LHC environment. We consider three representative tasks, signal-background classification, quark-gluon jet tagging, and missing transverse energy reconstruction, using dense neural networks, graph neural networks, and transformer-based architectures. Models are pretrained on ATLAS-like fast simulation and adapted to CMS-like fast simulation and to fully simulated ATLAS Open Data. Across all tasks, pretrained models consistently outperform independently trained baselines and require significantly less target-domain training data, typically reducing the needed statistics by about a factor of two. These results demonstrate that fast simulation can be used to learn robust, reusable representations and motivate publishing trained models as reusable scientific assets beyond large foundation models.

item.title: PathPainter: Transferring the Generalization Ability of Image Generation Models to Embodied Navigation
item.author: Yijin Wang, Yuru Tian, Xijie Huang, Weiqi Gai, Mo Zhu, Xin Zhou, Yuze Wu, Fei Gao
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种利用鸟瞰图图像作为全局先验的导航系统，通过图像生成模型解析人类意图并生成通行性掩码，结合跨视角定位技术解决里程计漂移问题，并在无人机平台上验证了其长距离导航能力。

背景: 鸟瞰图图像已被证明能为导航提供有价值的全局先验信息，但如何充分利用这些信息并在执行过程中可靠地使用它们仍面临两个关键挑战。

目的: 提出一种利用鸟瞰图图像作为全局先验的导航系统，旨在解决如何充分利用全局信息和在执行过程中可靠使用信息的问题。

方法: 系统采用图像生成模型从自然语言中解析人类意图、识别目标并生成通行性掩码；在执行阶段引入跨视角定位技术，将机器人里程计与鸟瞰图地图对齐，以缓解传统里程计的长期漂移。

主要发现: 在无人机平台上进行了广泛实验，仅使用常规局部运动规划器，无人机成功完成了160米的外部长距离导航任务。

结论: 这项工作展示了基础模型的世界理解能力可以转移到具身导航中，使机器人能够受益于现有图像生成模型的强大泛化能力。

翻译: 鸟瞰图图像已被广泛证明能为导航提供有价值的先验信息。鉴于此类视图提供的全局信息，仍存在两个关键挑战：如何充分利用这些信息以及如何在执行过程中可靠地使用它们。在本文中，我们提出了一种使用鸟瞰图图像作为全局先验的导航系统，该系统专为地面和近地面机器人平台设计。该系统采用图像生成模型从自然语言中解析人类意图，识别目标目的地，并生成通行性掩码。在执行过程中，我们引入了跨视角定位技术，将机器人的里程计与鸟瞰图地图对齐，并缓解了传统里程计中的长期漂移问题。我们进行了广泛的基准实验来评估所提出的方法，并在无人机平台上进一步验证了该方法。仅使用常规局部运动规划器，无人机成功完成了160米的外部长距离导航任务。这项工作展示了基础模型的世界理解能力如何转移到具身导航中，使机器人能够受益于现有图像生成模型的强大泛化能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出了一种方法，将图像生成模型的泛化能力应用到具身导航任务中。

Abstract

Bird's-eye-view (BEV) images have been widely demonstrated to provide valuable prior information for navigation. Given the global information provided by such views, two key challenges remain: how to fully exploit this information and how to reliably use it during execution. In this paper, we propose a navigation system that uses BEV images as global priors and is designed for ground and near-ground robotic platforms. The system employs an image generation model to interpret human intent from natural language, identify the target destination, and generate traversability masks. During execution, we introduce cross-view localization to align the robot's odometry with the BEV map and mitigate long-term drift in conventional odometry. We conduct extensive benchmark experiments to evaluate the proposed method and further validate it on a UAV platform. Using only a conventional local motion planner, the UAV successfully completes a 160-meter outdoor long-range navigation task. This work demonstrates how the world-understanding capabilities of foundation models can be transferred to embodied navigation, enabling robots to benefit from the strong generalization ability of existing image generation models.

item.title: InterLV-Search: Benchmarking Interleaved Multimodal Agentic Search
item.author: Hou, Bohan, Gu, Jiuning, Guo, Jiayan, Dang, Ronghao, Leng, Sicong, Li, Xin, Song, Xuemeng, Yang, Jianfei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 介绍了一个名为 InterLV-Search 的基准测试，用于评估交错语言-视觉智能体搜索，包含多级样本和工具支持。

背景: 现有的多模态智能体搜索基准测试通常将视觉证据局限于输入或仅作为答案终点，而非交错搜索轨迹的一部分。

目的: 构建一个能够评估交错语言-视觉智能体搜索的基准测试，通过反复使用文本和视觉证据来引导后续搜索。

方法: 包含三个级别的样本：主动视觉证据寻求、受控离线交错多模态搜索和开放网络交错多模态搜索。包含多模态多分支样本。使用自动化管道和机器主导、人工监督的开放网络管道构建数据。提供了 InterLV-Agent 用于标准化工具使用、轨迹记录和评估。

主要发现: 当前系统在解决交错多模态搜索方面仍有很大差距，最佳模型的整体准确率低于 50%，主要挑战在于视觉证据寻求、搜索控制和多模态证据集成。

结论: InterLV-Search 基准测试揭示了当前多模态智能体在交错搜索任务中的局限性，并提供了数据集和评估代码以供研究。

翻译: 现有的多模态智能体搜索基准测试评估多模态搜索和视觉浏览，但视觉证据要么局限于输入，要么仅作为答案终点，而非交错搜索轨迹的一部分。我们介绍了 InterLV-Search，一个用于交错语言-视觉智能体搜索的基准测试，其中文本和视觉证据被反复用于引导后续搜索。它包含 2061 个示例，分为三个级别：主动视觉证据寻求、受控离线交错多模态搜索和开放网络交错多模态搜索。除了现有基准测试外，它还包括多模态多分支样本，涉及在证据搜索期间对多个实体进行比较。我们使用自动化管道构建了第 1 级和第 2 级，并使用机器主导、人工监督的开放网络管道构建了第 3 级。我们还提供了 InterLV-Agent，用于标准化工具使用、轨迹记录和评估。在专有和开源多模态智能体上的实验表明，当前系统距离解决交错多模态搜索还很远，最佳模型的整体准确率低于 50%，突显了视觉证据寻求、搜索控制和多模态证据集成方面的挑战。我们在此处 URL 发布基准测试数据和评估代码。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Existing benchmarks for multimodal agentic search evaluate multimodal search and visual browsing, but visual evidence is either confined to the input or treated as an answer endpoint rather than part of an interleaved search trajectory. We introduce \textbf{InterLV-Search}, a benchmark for Interleaved Language-Vision Agentic Search, in which textual and visual evidence is repeatedly used to condition later search. It contains 2,061 examples across three levels: active visual evidence seeking, controlled offline interleaved multimodal search, and open-web interleaved multimodal search. Beyond existing benchmarks, it also includes multimodal multi-branch samples that involve comparison between multiple entities during the evidence search. We construct Level 1 and Level 2 with automated pipelines and Level 3 with a machine-led, human-supervised open-web pipeline. We further provide InterLV-Agent for standardized tool use, trajectory logging, and evaluation. Experiments on proprietary and open-source multimodal agents show that current systems remain far from solving interleaved multimodal search, with the best model below 50% overall accuracy, highlighting challenges in visual evidence seeking, search control, and multimodal evidence integration. We release the benchmark data and evaluation code at this https URL

item.title: Mind the Gap: Geometrically Accurate Generative Reconstruction from Disjoint Views
item.author: Grzegorz Wilczynski, Mikołaj Zielinski, Bartosz Świrta, Dominik Belter, Przemysław Spurek
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出GLADOS框架以解决从非重叠视图进行3D重建的难题。

背景: 现有3D视觉系统严重依赖视觉重叠，但在分布式群集机器人或众包数据收集等场景中，往往无法捕获重叠视角。

目的: 引入从非重叠视图进行生成式重建的新范式，建立数据集并提出评估指标。

方法: 提出GLADOS框架，包含生成式桥接、鲁棒粗略3D重建和迭代上下文扩展与一致性优化三个阶段。

主要发现: 现有最先进方法在零重叠场景下彻底失败，产生不连贯几何结构或语义不一致的重建。

结论: GLADOS是架构无关的框架，能够无缝集成生成、重建和修复领域的未来进展。

翻译: 3D视觉系统严重依赖视觉重叠，但在分布式群集机器人或众包数据收集等现实场景中，往往无法捕获重叠视角。本文引入从非重叠视图进行生成式重建的新范式，建立数据集并提出评估指标。基准测试显示现有方法在零重叠场景下彻底失败。为此提出GLADOS框架，通过生成式桥接、鲁棒粗略3D重建和迭代上下文扩展与一致性优化三个阶段，解决重建问题。GLADOS是一个架构无关的框架，能够无缝集成生成、重建和修复方面的未来进展。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

3D vision systems are fundamentally constrained by their reliance on visual overlap: reconstruction methods require it for geometric alignment, while generative models use it to enforce multi-view consistency. This limitation is particularly acute in real-world scenarios such as distributed swarm robotics or crowd-sourced data collection, where capturing overlapping perspectives, both in terms of spatial and appearance overlap, is often impossible. We introduce Generative Reconstruction from Disjoint Views as a new paradigm, establish a comprehensive dataset, and propose specialized evaluation metrics for zero-overlap scenarios. Our benchmarking demonstrates that existing state-of-the-art methods fail catastrophically on this task, producing disconnected geometries or semantically incoherent reconstructions. To address these limitations, we propose GLADOS, a general, modular framework that operates through three stages: (1) Generative Bridging, where foundation models synthesize intermediate perspectives to connect disjoint inputs; (2) Robust Coarse 3D Reconstruction, that establish coarse geometric scaffold via global alignment which absorbs local contradictions from generative process; and (3) Iterative Context Expansion and Consistency Optimization to fill missing regions and unify the reconstruction. As an architectureagnostic framework, GLADOS enables seamless integration of future advances in generation, reconstruction, and inpainting. The source code is available at: https://github.com/gwilczynski95/GLADOS.

item.title: VIMCAN: Visual-Inertial 3D Human Pose Estimation with Hybrid Mamba-Cross-Attention Network
item.author: Zepeng Yang, Junxuan Bai, Hao Li, Ju Dai, Junjun Pan, Yongfeng Yin, Bin Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 VIMCAN 的混合架构，用于多模态 3D 人体姿态估计，结合了 Mamba 和 Cross-Attention 的优势。

背景: 深度学习提升了多模态 3D 人体姿态估计的准确性，但现有的 SOTA 方法基于 Transformer，计算复杂度高，难以实现长序列的实时处理。

目的: 为了解决现有方法在长序列实时处理上的不足，以及 Mamba 在多模态空间依赖建模上的局限，提出一种高效且准确的新方法。

方法: 提出 VIMCAN 混合架构，利用 Mamba 进行高效的时间序列建模，利用 Cross-Attention 进行空间依赖提取，并结合 RGB 关键点和可穿戴 IMU 数据进行视觉-惯性融合。

主要发现: 在 TotalCapture 和 3DPW 数据集上取得了卓越的准确性，平均关节位置误差分别为 17.2 mm 和 45.3 mm。

结论: VIMCAN 在准确率上优于之前的 Transformer 基础和其他 SOTA 方法，并且能在消费级硬件上支持超过每秒 60 帧的实时推理。

翻译: 深度学习的快速发展显著提高了多模态 3D 人体姿态估计的准确性。然而，最先进的 HPE 流程仍然依赖 Transformer，其二次复杂度使得长序列的实时处理变得不切实际。Mamba 通过选择性状态空间建模解决了这个问题，实现了高效的序列处理，而不会牺牲表示能力。然而，它在多模态设置中难以捕捉复杂的空间依赖关系。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 VIMCAN，这是一种混合架构，将 Mamba 的高效序列建模与 Cross-Attention 的空间推理相结合，并在 RGB 关键点和可穿戴 IMU 数据之间执行鲁棒的视觉-惯性融合和人体姿态估计。通过利用 Mamba 的动态参数化进行时间建模，利用 Attention 进行空间依赖提取，VIMCAN 实现了卓越的准确性，在 TotalCapture 上的平均关节位置误差为 17.2 mm，在 3DPW 上为 45.3 mm。VIMCAN 优于之前的基于 Transformer 的和其他 SOTA 方法，同时在消费级硬件上支持每秒超过 60 帧的实时推理。源代码可在 GitHub 上获得。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

The rapid advances in deep learning have significantly enhanced the accuracy of multimodal 3D human pose estimation (HPE). However, the state-of-the-art (SOTA) HPE pipelines still rely on Transformers, whose quadratic complexity makes real-time processing for long sequences impractical. Mamba addresses this issue through selective state-space modeling, enabling efficient sequence processing without sacrificing representational power. Nevertheless, it struggles to capture complex spatial dependencies in multimodal settings. To bridge this gap, we propose VIMCAN, a hybrid architecture that combines the efficient sequence modeling of Mamba with the spatial reasoning of Cross-Attention, and performs robust visual-inertial fusion and human pose estimation between RGB keypoints and wearable IMU data. By leveraging Mamba's dynamic parameterization for temporal modeling and Attention for spatial dependency extraction, VIMCAN achieves superior accuracy, with mean per-joint position errors (MPJPE) of 17.2 mm on TotalCapture and 45.3 mm on 3DPW. VIMCAN outperforms prior Transformer-based and other SOTA approaches while supporting real-time inference at over 60 frames per second on consumer-grade hardware. The source code is available on GitHub.

item.title: Beyond Distribution Estimation: Simplex Anchored Structural Inference Towards Universal Semi-Supervised Learning
item.author: Yaxin Hou, Jun Ma, Hanyang Li, Bo Han, Jie Yu, Yuheng Jia
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种通用半监督学习方法，通过关注表示层面的结构推理来避免分布估计，并提出了Simplex Anchored Graph-state Equipartition (SAGE)方法。

背景: 半监督学习在现实场景中面临挑战，因为标记数据稀缺且未标记数据分布未知。现有方法通常依赖伪标签，但往往假设未标记数据分布均匀或需要足够标记数据来估计，导致错误伪标签和表示混淆。

目的: 为了解决现有方法在未知分布下的局限性，作者提出了通用半监督学习范式，旨在通过关注表示层面的结构推理来绕过分布估计，从而提高模型性能。

方法: 提出了Simplex Anchored Graph-state Equipartition (SAGE)方法，捕获高阶样本依赖关系以建立结构共识。同时使用满足单纯形等角紧框架的向量作为坐标框架来指导类间表示分离。还引入了基于分布无关指标的权重策略和辅助分支来隔离错误伪标签。

主要发现: 表示中捕获的样本间关系比伪标签更可靠。SAGE方法在五个标准基准上 consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods，平均准确率提升8.52%。

结论: SAGE方法在多个数据集上表现优异，显著优于现有最先进的方法。

翻译: 半监督学习在现实场景中面临重大挑战，即标记数据稀缺且未标记数据遵循未知、任意的分布。我们将这一关键但尚未充分探索的范式形式化为通用半监督学习。现有方法通常通过伪标签利用未标记数据。然而，它们往往依赖于未标记数据分布均匀的理想化假设，或者需要足够的标记数据来估计它。在UniSSL设置中，这种依赖关系导致大量错误的伪标签，从而引发表示混淆。幸运的是，我们观察到表示捕获的样本间关系比伪标签更可靠。利用这一见解，我们将重点转移到表示级别的结构推理上，以绕过分布估计。因此，我们提出了单纯形锚定图态等分法，它捕获高阶样本依赖关系以建立结构共识，从而指导表示学习。同时，为了减轻表示混淆，我们使用满足单纯形等角紧框架的向量作为坐标框架，以指导类间表示分离。最后，我们引入了一种基于分布无关指标的权重策略，以优先考虑可靠的伪标签，并引入了一个辅助分支来隔离潜在的错误伪标签。在五个标准基准上的评估表明，SAGE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods，平均准确率提升8.52%。

Abstract

Semi-supervised learning faces significant challenges in realistic scenarios where labeled data is scarce and unlabeled data follows unknown, arbitrary distributions. We formalize this critical yet under-explored paradigm as Universal Semi-supervised Learning (UniSSL). Existing methods typically leverage unlabeled data via pseudo-labeling. However, they often rely on the idealized assumption of a uniform unlabeled data distribution or require sufficient labeled data to estimate it. In the UniSSL setting, such dependencies lead to numerous erroneous pseudo-labels, thereby triggering representation confusion. Fortunately, we observe that inter-sample relations captured by representations are more reliable than pseudo-labels. Leveraging this insight, we shift our focus to representation-level structural inference to bypass distribution estimation. Accordingly, we propose Simplex Anchored Graph-state Equipartition (SAGE), which captures high-order inter-sample dependencies to establish structural consensus for guiding representation learning. Meanwhile, to mitigate representation confusion, we employ vectors that satisfy a simplex equiangular tight frame to serve as a coordinate frame for guiding inter-class representation separation. Finally, we introduce a weighting strategy based on distribution-agnostic metrics to prioritize reliable pseudo-labels and an auxiliary branch to isolate potentially erroneous pseudo-labels. Evaluations on five standard benchmarks show that SAGE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with an average accuracy gain of \textbf{8.52\%}.

item.title: Response-G1: Explicit Scene Graph Modeling for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
item.author: Ke Ma, Jiaqi Tang, Bin Guo, Xueting Han, Ruonan Xu, Qingfeng He, Ziheng Wang, Xu Wang, Qifeng Chen, Zhiwen Yu, Yunhao Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Response-G1 是一个用于主动流媒体视频理解的新框架，通过场景图建立视觉证据与查询响应条件的明确对齐，实现更准确的响应时机决策。

背景: 现有方法在主动流媒体视频理解任务中表现不佳，因为它们对视觉证据的建模是隐式的且与查询无关。

目的: 提出一种名为 Response-G1 的新框架，通过场景图建立累积视频证据与查询预期响应条件之间的明确、结构化对齐。

方法: 该框架包含三个无需微调的阶段：在线查询引导的场景图生成、基于记忆的语义相关历史场景图检索，以及用于逐帧“静默/响应”决策的检索增强触发提示。

主要发现: 在标准基准测试中，该方法在主动和反应任务中均表现出优越性，验证了显式场景图建模和检索在流媒体视频理解中的优势。

结论: Response-G1 实现了更可解释和准确的响应时机决策，验证了显式场景图建模的优势。

翻译: 主动流媒体视频理解要求 Video-LLMs 在视频展开过程中决定何时响应，现有方法往往在这方面表现不佳，因为它们对视觉证据的建模是隐式的且与查询无关。我们引入了 Response-G1，这是一个新颖的框架，通过场景图在累积的视频证据和查询的预期响应条件之间建立了明确、结构化的对齐。该框架在三个无需微调的阶段运行：（1）从流式剪辑中在线查询引导的场景图生成；（2）基于记忆的检索最语义相关的历史场景图；（3）用于逐帧“静默/响应”决策的检索增强触发提示。通过在共享的图表示中同时对证据和条件进行建模，Response-G1 实现了更可解释和准确的响应时机决策。在标准基准测试上的实验结果证明了该方法在主动和反应任务中的优越性，验证了显式场景图建模和检索在流媒体视频理解中的优势。

Abstract

Proactive streaming video understanding requires Video-LLMs to decide when to respond as a video unfolds, a task where existing methods often fall short due to their implicit, query-agnostic modeling of visual evidence. We introduce Response-G1, a novel framework that establishes explicit, structured alignment between the accumulated video evidence and the query's expected response conditions via scene graphs. The framework operates in three fine-tuning-free stages: (1) online query-guided scene graph generation from streaming clips; (2) memory-based retrieval of the most semantically relevant historical scene graphs; and (3) retrieval-augmented trigger prompting for per-frame "silence/response" decisions.By grounding both evidence and conditions in a shared graph representation, Response-G1 achieves more interpretable and accurate response timing decisions. Experimental results on established benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our method in both proactive and reactive tasks, validating the advantage of explicit scene graph modeling and retrieval in streaming video understanding.

item.title: Beyond Defenses: Manifold-Aligned Regularization for Intrinsic 3D Point Cloud Robustness
item.author: Pedro Alonso, Chongshou Li, Tianrui Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 Manifold-Aligned Point Recognition (MAPR) 的框架，通过正则化潜在几何结构来提高点云识别的鲁棒性。

背景: 尽管点云鲁棒性领域取得了进展，现有方法主要依赖数据增强或防御机制，却忽略了对抗脆弱性的几何根本原因。

目的: 本文假设 3D 网络的对抗脆弱性源于模型学习的潜在几何与底层表面的内在几何之间的流形错位。

方法: 引入 Manifold-Aligned Point Recognition (MAPR) 框架，通过在内在扰动下对齐预测来正则化潜在几何。该方法为每个点云添加捕捉局部曲率和扩散结构的内在特征，并应用一致性损失以保持对内在几何保真扰动的不变性。

主要发现: 小的几何保真扰动会导致特征空间中不成比例的扭曲，揭示了潜在几何与内在几何之间的错位。

结论: MAPR 在 ModelNet40 和 ScanObjectNN 数据集上实现了显著的鲁棒性提升，无需对抗训练或额外数据。

翻译: 尽管点云鲁棒性取得了显著进展，现有方法主要依靠数据增强或防御机制来提高性能，却忽视了对抗脆弱性的几何根本原因。我们假设，3D 网络中的对抗脆弱性源于模型学习的潜在几何与底层表面的内在几何之间的流形错位。沿输入流形的小的、几何保真的扰动通常会在特征空间中引起不成比例的扭曲，揭示了潜在几何与内在几何之间的错位。我们通过开发 3D 鲁棒性的几何解释，将经典对抗理论与点云的内在结构联系起来，从而形式化这一现象。受此分析启发，我们提出了 Manifold-Aligned Point Recognition (MAPR)，这是一个通过在内在扰动下对齐预测来正则化潜在几何的框架。MAPR 为每个点云添加捕捉局部曲率和扩散结构的内在特征，并应用一致性损失以保持对内在几何保真扰动的不变性。在不依赖对抗训练或额外数据的情况下，MAPR 在 ModelNet40 和 ScanObjectNN 数据集上的多种对抗攻击中持续提高了鲁棒性，在 ModelNet40 和 ScanObjectNN 上分别实现了平均 +20.02% 和 +8.58% 的鲁棒性增益。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决的是3D点云在对抗性攻击下的鲁棒性问题，特别是针对点云内在几何特征的防御。这个问题非常重要，因为3D点云广泛应用于自动驾驶、机器人等现实场景，其鲁棒性直接关系到系统的安全性和可靠性，防止模型被恶意攻击或受噪声干扰。

Abstract

Despite extensive progress in point cloud robustness, existing methods primarily improve performance through augmentation or defense mechanisms, while overlooking the geometric root cause of adversarial fragility. We hypothesize that adversarial vulnerability in 3D networks arises from a manifold misalignment between the latent geometry learned by the model and the intrinsic geometry of the underlying surface. Small, geometry-preserving perturbations along the input manifold often induce disproportionate distortions in feature space, revealing a misalignment between latent and intrinsic geometries. We formalize this phenomenon by developing a geometric interpretation of 3D robustness that links classical adversarial theory to the intrinsic structure of point clouds. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce Manifold-Aligned Point Recognition (MAPR), a framework that regularizes the latent geometry by aligning predictions across intrinsic perturbations. MAPR augments each point cloud with intrinsic features capturing local curvature and diffusion structure, and applies a consistency loss that preserves invariance to intrinsic, geometry-preserving perturbations. Without relying on adversarial training or additional data, MAPR consistently improves robustness across multiple adversarial attacks on both the ModelNet40 and ScanObjectNN datasets, achieving average robustness gains of +20.02% and +8.58% on ModelNet40 and ScanObjectNN, respectively.

item.title: A Refined Generalization Analysis for Extreme Multi-class Supervised Contrastive Representation Learning
item.author: Nong Minh Hieu, Antoine Ledent
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 对比表示学习在实践中成功但理论复杂度不明。现有方法假设独立同分布且在极端多类设置下界限悲观。本文提出新估计量，在温和假设下实现了与类别数同阶的样本复杂度。

背景: 对比表示学习在多个领域成功，但理论样本复杂度理解不足。现有分析假设数据独立同分布，而实际数据存在依赖性。

目的: 解决现有方法在极端多类设置下样本复杂度界限过于悲观的问题，特别是针对长尾分布场景。

方法: 改进了界限证明，提出了一种新的估计量来捕捉风险跨类别的集中度。

主要发现: 在温和假设下，样本复杂度与类别数同阶，且优于依赖于最稀有类概率的旧方法。

结论: 该方法在极端多类学习场景（尤其是长尾分布）中提供了更紧的界限，且样本复杂度与类别数同阶。

翻译: 对比表示学习在多个机器学习领域取得了显著的实证成功，但其理论样本复杂度仍然理解不足。现有的分析通常假设输入元组是独立同分布的，这一假设在大多数实际设置中被违反，因为对比元组是从有限的标记数据池中构建的，从而在元组之间产生了依赖性。虽然最近的一项工作使用U-Statistics分析了这种学习设置，但其中使用的技术要求每个类别的风险均匀集中，使得超额风险界限的阶数为 $ρ_{ext{min}}^{-{1}/{2}}$，其中 $ρ_{ext{min}}$ 表示最稀有类别的概率。在存在许多对总体人口风险贡献最小的尾部类别的极端多类设置中，这种依赖关系可能过于悲观。我们的贡献有两点。首先，我们在之前的工作基础上进行了改进，证明了样本复杂度与类别数 $R$ 同阶的界限，而与类别分布无关。此外，我们制定了一种不同的估计量，捕捉风险跨类别的集中度，从而在极端多类学习场景中实现了更紧的界限，特别是在类别分布为长尾的情况下。在类别分布的温和假设下，由此产生的样本复杂度为 $ext{O}(k)$，其中 $k$ 是每个元组的样本数。

深度解读

Abstract

Contrastive Representation Learning (CRL) has achieved strong empirical success in multiple machine learning disciplines, yet its theoretical sample complexity remains poorly understood. Existing analyses usually assume that input tuples are identically and independently distributed, an assumption violated in most practical settings where contrastive tuples are constructed from a finite pool of labeled data, inducing dependencies among tuples. While one recent work analyzed this learning setting using U-Statistics to estimate the population risk, the techniques used therein require the risk of each class to concentrate uniformly, making excess risk bounds scale in the order of $ρ_{\min}^{-{1}/{2}}$ where $ρ_{\min}$ denotes the probability of the rarest class. Such a dependency can be overly pessimistic in the extreme multiclass settings where there are many tail classes which contribute minimally to the overall population risk. Our contributions are two-fold. Firstly, we improve upon the previous work and prove a bound with a sample complexity of the same order as the number of classes $R$, regardless of the distribution over classes. Furthermore, we formulate a different estimator that captures the concentration of the risk \textit{across classes}, enabling sharper bounds in extreme multi-class learning scenarios, especially where class distributions are long-tailed. Under mild assumptions on the class distributions, the resulting sample complexity is $\mathcal{O}(k)$ where $k$ is the number of samples per tuple.

item.title: FS-I2P:A Hierarchical Focus-Sweep Registration Network with Dynamically Allocated Depth
item.author: Zhixin Cheng, Yujia Chen, Xujing Tao, Bohao Liao, Xiaotian Yin, Baoqun Yin, Tianzhu Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对图像到点云配准中的视角变化、跨模态差异和重复纹理问题，提出一种基于SSM框架的“聚焦-扫描”范式及分层交互模块和动态层分配策略，在RGB-D Scenes V2和7-Scenes数据集上实现了最先进的性能。

背景: 图像到点云配准面临视角变化、跨模态差异和重复纹理的挑战，导致尺度模糊和错误的对应关系。

目的: 解决现有无检测方法在跨层注意力漂移和尺度内不一致方面的问题，以实现精确配准。

方法: 提出基于SSM框架的“聚焦-扫描”范式，开发分层聚焦-扫描交互模块以增强多级跨模态特征关联，并引入动态层分配策略自适应确定迭代深度。

主要发现: 在RGB-D Scenes V2和7-Scenes数据集上的大量实验和消融研究证明，该方法达到了最先进的性能。

结论: 该方法在配准任务中表现优异，优于现有技术。

翻译: 图像到点云配准经常受到视角变化、跨模态差异和重复纹理的挑战，这会导致尺度模糊，从而导致错误的对应关系。最近的无检测方法通过利用多尺度特征和基于transformer的交互来缓解这一问题。然而，它们仍然受到跨层注意力漂移和尺度内不一致的影响，阻碍了精确配准。受人类行为启发，我们提出了一种“聚焦-扫描”范式，并在基于SSM的框架内开发了一个分层聚焦-扫描交互模块，以增强多级跨模态特征关联。此外，我们引入了一种动态层分配策略，自适应地确定迭代深度，以更好地利用几何约束并提高匹配鲁棒性。在两个基准数据集RGB-D Scenes V2和7-Scenes上的大量实验和消融研究证明，我们的方法实现了最先进的性能。

Abstract

Image-to-point cloud registration is often challenged by viewpoint changes, cross-modal discrepancies, and repetitive textures, which induce scale ambiguity and consequently lead to erroneous correspondences. Recent detection-free methods alleviate this issue by leveraging multi-scale features and transformer-based interactions. However, they still suffer from attention drift across layers and intra-scale inconsistencies, hindering precise registration. Inspired by human behavior, we propose a ``Focus--Sweep'' paradigm and develop a Hierarchical Focus--Sweep Interaction Module within an SSM-based framework to enhance multi-level cross-modal feature association. In addition, we introduce a Dynamic Layer Allocation Strategy that adaptively determines the iteration depth to better exploit geometric constraints and improve matching robustness. Extensive experiments and ablations on two benchmarks, RGB-D Scenes V2 and 7-Scenes, demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance.

item.title: EggHand: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Egocentric Hand Pose Forecasting
item.author: Jaeyoung Choi, Hyeondong Kim, Yujin Kim, Daehee Park
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 EggHand 的框架，用于从第一人称视频中预测未来的 3D 手部姿态序列。

背景: 从第一人称视频中预测未来的 3D 手部姿态对于理解人类意图和实现 AR/VR 辅助、人机交互等应用至关重要。然而，由于手部运动受复杂意图驱动、具有高度灵巧的关节运动，且受自身运动引起的剧烈视角变化影响，该任务极具挑战性。

目的: 引入 EggHand 框架，统一多模态语义推理与动态运动建模，克服通用视觉编码器在自身运动下的脆弱性，实现无需依赖身体姿态或外部跟踪的联合推理。

方法: 该方法结合了来自视觉-语言-动作模型的动作解码器（捕捉手部运动的有序时间动态）和第一人称视频文本编码器（提供从大规模第一人称视频中学习的视角感知上下文信息）。

主要发现: 在 EgoExo4D 数据集上的实验表明，EggHand 在预测准确率上取得了新的最先进水平，在剧烈自身运动下保持鲁棒性，并且能够通过基于语言的提示实现可控预测。

结论: EggHand 成功实现了对运动、上下文和高层意图的联合推理，无需依赖身体姿态或外部跟踪，为第一人称手部姿态预测提供了新的解决方案。

翻译: Forecasting future 3D hand pose sequences from egocentric video is essential for understanding human intention and enabling embodied applications such as AR/VR assistance and human-robot interaction. However, this task remains a highly challenging problem because egocentric hand motion is driven by complex human intent, exhibits highly dexterous articulations, and is observed under drastic viewpoint shifts induced by ego-motion. In this work, we introduce EggHand, a foundation-model-based framework for egocentric hand pose forecasting that unifies multimodal semantic reasoning with dynamic motion modeling. Our approach couples an action decoder from a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model, which captures the structured temporal dynamics of hand motion, with an egocentric video-text encoder that provides viewpoint-aware contextual information learned from large-scale first-person video. Together, these components overcome the brittleness of generic visual encoders under ego-motion and enable joint reasoning over motion, context, and high-level intent-without relying on body pose or external tracking. Experiments on the EgoExo4D dataset show that EggHand sets a new state of the art in forecasting accuracy, remains robust under severe ego-motion, and further enables controllable prediction via language-based task prompts.

item.title: Spatiotemporal Trust Evaluation for Collaborator Selection via Customized GNN-Mamba
item.author: Botao Zhu, Xianbin Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 协作任务中基于时空依赖的信任评估与协作者选择

背景: 协作任务的完成依赖于可信协作者的有效选择。准确评估信任度需要结合历史协作洞察和特定任务背景下的资源能力评估。然而，多样化的信任视角和设备间复杂的时空依赖关系使得准确信任评估极具挑战性。

目的: 提出一种定制的图神经网络与Mamba结合的模型，以解决信任评估中的时空依赖和多样化视角问题，从而实现准确的信任评估和协作者选择。

方法: 提出了一种定制的图神经网络Mamba（GM）模型。该模型利用GNN进行空间信任融合，利用基于Mamba的模型捕获设备信任的短期波动和长期演化，并引入任务特定的资源信任以反映设备在不同任务条件下的实际能力。

主要发现: 实验结果表明，所提出的GM模型在信任评估的准确性和稳定性方面均优于基线方法。

结论: GM模型能有效处理复杂的时空依赖和多样化信任视角，显著提升了信任评估的性能。

翻译: 协作任务的顺利完成依赖于可信协作者的有效选择。为了准确评估潜在协作者的可信度，有必要结合其历史协作的洞察力以及特定任务背景下的资源能力评估。然而，多样化的信任视角的存在，以及设备之间复杂的时空依赖关系，使得准确信任评估变得尤为困难。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种用于信任评估和协作者选择的定制化图神经网络Mamba（GM）模型。在该模型中，图神经网络模型利用从历史协作中提取的设备间空间依赖性进行空间信任融合，而基于Mamba的时序模型则捕获设备信任的短期波动和长期演化。此外，还引入了任务特定的资源信任，以反映设备在不同任务条件下的实际能力。实验结果表明，所提出的GM模型在信任评估的准确性和稳定性方面均优于基线方法。

Abstract

The successful completion of collaborative tasks relies on the effective selection of trustworthy collaborators. To accurately evaluate the trustworthiness of potential collaborators, it is necessary to combine insights from their past collaborations with assessments of their resource capabilities under specific task contexts. However, the coexistence of diverse trust perspectives, along with complex spatiotemporal dependencies among devices, makes accurate trust evaluation particularly challenging. To address these challenges, we propose a customized Graph Neural Network (GNN)-Mamba (GM) model for trust evaluation and collaborator selection. In this model, the GNN model performs spatial trust fusion by leveraging inter-device spatial dependencies extracted from historical collaborations, while the Mamba-based temporal model captures both short-term fluctuations and long-term evolution of device trust. In addition, task-specific resource trust is incorporated to reflect the practical capabilities of devices under varying task conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed GM model outperforms baseline approaches in terms of the accuracy and stability of trust evaluation.

item.title: Structured Coupling for Flow Matching
item.author: Xavier Sumba, Carles Balsells-Rodas, Yingzhen Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为结构化耦合流匹配（SCFM）的框架，通过结合流匹配和潜在变量模型，在保持生成质量的同时学习可解释的潜在结构。

背景: 标准流匹配扩展性好但依赖无结构源分布，限制了学习可解释的潜在结构的能力；而潜在变量模型能捕获结构但往往牺牲生成质量。

目的: 桥接标准流匹配和潜在变量模型之间的差距，提出一种既能学习结构又能保持生成质量的框架。

方法: 引入结构化潜在变量和外部噪声到源分布中，利用共享的时间依赖识别网络进行潜在变量模型的变分推断和中间时刻流速度估计，联合学习结构化先验和连续传输映射。

主要发现: SCFM促进了无监督的潜在表示学习，适用于聚类、解耦和下游任务，且样本质量与标准流匹配相当。

结论: 有意义的结构可以在不牺牲生成保真度的情况下被学习。

翻译: 标准流匹配扩展性好但通常依赖无结构的源分布，限制了其学习可解释的潜在结构的能力。相比之下，潜在变量模型能捕获结构但往往牺牲生成质量。我们通过提出结构化耦合流匹配（SCFM）来弥合这一差距，这是一个将流匹配与结构化潜在表示学习相结合的合作框架。通过在源中引入结构化潜在变量和外部噪声，SCFM联合学习结构化先验（通过潜在变量建模）和连续传输映射（通过流匹配）。它使用共享的时间依赖识别网络来进行潜在变量模型的变分推断和中间时刻流速度估计。这产生了一个结构化信息丰富但无条件、无模拟的流模型，其中潜在变量模型也可以辅助流采样。实验上，SCFM促进了聚类、解耦和下游任务的无监督潜在表示学习，同时在样本质量上与流匹配保持竞争力，表明有意义的结构可以在不牺牲生成保真度的情况下被学习。

Abstract

Standard flow matching scales well but typically relies on an unstructured source distribution, limiting its ability to learn interpretable latent structure. Latent-variable models, by contrast, capture structure but often sacrifice generative quality. We bridge this gap by proposing Structured Coupling for Flow Matching (SCFM), a cooperative framework that augments flow matching with structured latent representation learning. By introducing structured latent variables and exogenous noise into the source, SCFM jointly learns a structured prior (via latent variable modeling) and a continuous transport map (via flow matching). It uses a shared time-dependent recognition network for both latent variable model variational inference and intermediate-time flow velocity estimation. This yields a structurally informed yet unconditional, simulation-free flow model, where the latent variable model can also assist flow sampling. Empirically, SCFM facilitates unsupervised latent representation learning for clustering, disentanglement and downstream tasks, while remaining competitive with flow matching in sample quality, showing that meaningful structure can be learned without sacrificing generative fidelity.

item.title: Selectivity- and Activity-Aware Catalyst Descriptors for CO$_2$ Hydrogenation on Alloy Nanocatalysts using Machine-Learned Force Fields
item.author: Prajwal Pisal, Ondřej Krejčí, Patrick Rinke
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 吸附能分布是描述合金催化剂性能的有力工具，但以往方法未充分解决晶面贡献问题。本文提出了一种更新的晶面分辨框架，用于预测催化活性和选择性。

背景: 吸附能分布在高熵合金和传统合金纳米晶体催化剂中应用广泛，能更全面地代表纳米颗粒表面，加速异质催化剂的设计与发现。

目的: 解决以往方法未能充分解决特定晶面贡献的问题，从而提高对催化活性和选择性的预测能力。

方法: 使用基于 Open Catalyst Project 数据训练的通用机器学习力场，计算了 226 种金属、二元和三元合金的吸附能，覆盖了 2626 个不同表面上的 140 万个吸附位点。利用统计和无监督学习技术分析特定晶面的 AED。

主要发现: 识别出了高活性和甲醇选择性晶面。揭示了结构与催化性能指标（如活性和选择性）之间的关系。

结论: 提出了一套合金成分及其表面取向，用于实验验证以实现高选择性的二氧化碳加氢。该方法为理解结构-性能关系提供了见解。

翻译: 吸附能分布已成为高熵合金和传统合金纳米晶体催化剂性能的有力描述符。通过考虑不同的吸附位点和晶面，AED 更全面地代表纳米颗粒表面，并加速了异质催化剂的设计与发现。然而，以往方法未能充分解决特定晶面的贡献，限制了预测活性和选择性的能力。本文介绍了一种更新的晶面分辨框架，用于预测催化活性，并洞察 C1 产品的选择性。利用基于 Open Catalyst Project 数据的通用机器学习力场，计算了 226 种金属、二元和三元合金的吸附能，覆盖了 2626 个不同表面上的 140 万个吸附位点。通过统计和无监督学习技术分析特定晶面的 AED，识别出高活性和甲醇选择性晶面。该方法揭示了结构与催化性能指标之间的关系，并提出了用于实验验证的合金成分和表面取向。

Abstract

Adsorption energy distributions (AEDs) have emerged as a powerful and increasingly adopted descriptor for catalytic performance in high-entropy alloys and, more recently, in conventional metallic alloy nanocrystal catalysts. By accounting for diverse adsorption sites and crystallographic facets, AEDs more fully represent nanoparticle-based catalytic surfaces and show strong promise for accelerating rational design and discovery of heterogeneous catalysts, especially for CO$_2$ hydrogenation. However, previous approaches have not sufficiently resolved facet-specific contributions, despite the catalytic significance and prevalence of certain Miller planes in nanoscale catalysts, limiting their applicability in predicting activity and selectivity. Here, we introduce an updated facet-resolved framework for predicting catalytic activity, which also enables insight into selectivity toward C1 products. Universal machine-learned force fields trained on Open Catalyst Project data were employed to compute adsorption energetics across 226 experimentally observed metals, binary alloys, and ternary alloys, encompassing 1.4 million adsorption sites on 2,626 crystallographically distinct surfaces. Using statistical and unsupervised learning techniques, we analyzed facet-specific AEDs to identify highly active and methanol-selective facets. Our approach provides insight into the relationship between structure and catalytic performance metrics like activity and selectivity, and presents a set of alloy compositions and their respective surface orientations for experimental validation toward highly selective CO$_2$ hydrogenation.

item.title: Offline-Online Hierarchical 3D Global Relocalization With Synthetic LiDAR Sensing and Descriptor-Space Retrieval
item.author: Jiahua Ren, Kai Shen, Muhua Zhang, Lei Ma
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出一种离线在线分层框架，通过解耦搜索空间解决大规模空间中的3D全局重定位问题，实现了高效且精确的位姿估计。

背景: 3D全局重定位是移动机器人的关键能力，但在大规模空间中，现有方法因巨大的位姿搜索空间和高计算开销导致在线重定位时间过长。

目的: 解决大规模空间中现有方法在线重定位时间长的问题，提高计算效率。

方法: 提出离线在线分层框架。离线阶段在网格地图中模拟激光雷达扫描生成候选位置和几何描述符索引。在线阶段通过全局检索获得粗略位姿估计，随后进行点云配准输出精确的6自由度位姿估计。

主要发现: 在真实环境中，该方法平均重定位时间为3秒，平均定位精度为8厘米。相比现有方法，计算效率提高了数量级，且保持了相当的重定位精度。

结论: 该方法在保持重定位精度的同时，显著提高了计算效率，实现了高效的全局重定位。

翻译: 3D全局重定位是移动机器人在实际应用中的关键能力之一。然而，在大规模空间中，由于巨大的位姿搜索空间和高计算开销，现有方法往往面临漫长的在线重定位时间。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了一种离线在线分层框架，解耦了搜索空间。在离线阶段，通过在网格地图中模拟激光雷达扫描，在地图中生成候选位置及其对应的几何描述符索引。在在线阶段，首先通过全局检索获得粗略位姿估计，随后进行点云配准以输出精确的6自由度位姿估计。真实世界实验表明，所提出的方法在3D环境中实现了平均3秒的重定位时间和平均8厘米的定位精度。与现有的全局重定位方法相比，所提出的方法在计算效率上实现了数量级的提升，同时提供了相当的重定位精度。

Abstract

3D global relocalization is one of the key capabilities for mobile robots in practical applications. However, in large scale spaces, existing methods often suffer from prolonged online relocalization time due to factors such as the massive pose search space and high computational overhead. To address these issues, this paper proposes an offline-online hierarchical framework that decouples the search space. In the offline phase, candidate positions and their corresponding geometric descriptor indices are generated in the map by simulating LiDAR scans within the grid map. In the online phase, a coarse pose estimate is first obtained via global retrieval, followed by point cloud registration to output precise 6-DoF pose estimates. Real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves an average relocalization time of 3 s and an average localization accuracy of 8 cm in 3D environments. Compared with existing global relocalization methods, the proposed method achieves an order-of-magnitude improvement in computational efficiency while delivering comparable relocalization accuracy.

item.title: TextLDM: Language Modeling with Continuous Latent Diffusion
item.author: Jiang, Jiaxiu, Ren, Jingjing, Li, Wenbo, Wang, Bo, Sun, Haoze, Yang, Yijun, Liu, Jianhui, Zhang, Yanbing, Zheng, Shenghe, Zhang, Yuan, Huang, Haoyang, Duan, Nan, Zuo, Wangmeng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了 TextLDM，将视觉扩散模型应用于文本生成，旨在实现生成与理解的单一架构。

背景: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) 已统一图像和视频生成，下一步是将其应用于语言建模。

目的: 将视觉潜在扩散方法转移到文本生成，并解决获得高质量连续文本表示的挑战。

方法: 使用基于 Transformer 的 VAE 将离散标记映射到连续潜在空间，通过表示对齐（REPA）使用预训练语言模型增强特征，并使用标准 DiT 在潜在空间执行流匹配。

主要发现: 仅靠重建保真度不足以获得高质量表示；通过 REPA 对齐潜在特征对下游生成质量至关重要；TextLDM 显著优于先前的扩散语言模型，并在相同设置下匹配 GPT-2。

结论: 视觉 DiT 方法有效转移到语言，为多模态生成与理解的统一扩散架构迈出了 concrete 步伐。

翻译: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) trained with flow matching in a VAE latent space have unified visual generation across images and videos. A natural next step toward a single architecture for both generation (visual synthesis) and understanding (text generation) is to apply this framework to language modeling. We propose TextLDM, which transfers the visual latent diffusion recipe to text generation with minimal architectural modification. A Transformer-based VAE maps discrete tokens to continuous latents, enhanced by Representation Alignment (REPA) with a frozen pretrained language model to produce representations effective for conditional denoising. A standard DiT then performs flow matching in this latent space, identical in architecture to its visual counterpart. The central challenge we address is obtaining high-quality continuous text representations: we find that reconstruction fidelity alone is insufficient, and that aligning latent features with a pretrained language model via REPA is critical for downstream generation quality. Trained from scratch on OpenWebText2, TextLDM substantially outperforms prior diffusion language models and matches GPT-2 under the same settings. Our results establish that the visual DiT recipe transfers effectively to language, taking a concrete step toward unified diffusion architectures for multimodal generation and understanding.

item.title: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Renal Lesion Stratification in CT
item.author: Hartmut Häntze, Sarah de Boer, Myrthe Buser, Alessa Hering, Bram van Ginneken, Mathias Prokop, Jawed Nawabi, Sebastian Ziegelmayer, Lisa Adams, Keno Bressem
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了开源医学基础模型在CT肾脏病变分类任务中的表现，特别是在数据稀缺的临床场景下的迁移能力。

背景: 随着开源医学基础模型的普及，其在数据稀缺的临床分类任务中的迁移能力成为关键问题。CT肾脏病变分类领域受限于训练数据，对模型的通用性有较高要求。

目的: 通过基准测试评估医学基础模型在CT肾脏病变六分类任务中的性能，并比较其与从头训练的模型及手工特征分类器的优劣。

方法: 选取三个医学基础模型，采用冻结特征探测协议，与手工放射组学分类器和从头训练的3D ResNet-50进行对比。使用包含2854个病变的训练集和来自癌症影像档案的234个病变的外部测试集进行模型训练和评估。

主要发现: 1. 基础模型性能与从头训练的ResNet相当，且大幅降低硬件需求；2. 传统放射组学方法显著优于所有深度学习方法。

结论: 当前通用型基础模型嵌入特征尚未捕捉到驱动组织亚型判别所需的细粒度纹理和形状异质性。尽管基础模型在数据稀缺场景有潜力，但在肾脏病变分层任务中未超越现有模型，放射组学仍是当前最先进的方法。

翻译: 开源医学基础模型的迅速普及提出了一个实际问题：它们的预训练表示在临床相关但数据稀缺的分类任务中表现如何？特别是在CT肾脏病变分类中，向更大通用性的推进是有意义的，因为该领域受到固有的训练数据有限的限制。我们通过在这个特定任务上对三个医学基础模型进行基准测试来解决这个问题。这个六类问题涵盖了囊肿和透明细胞肾细胞癌等常见实体，以及罕见亚型。使用冻结特征探测协议，我们将FM嵌入与手工放射组学分类器和从头训练的3D ResNet-50进行了比较。模型在包含2854个病变的复合数据集上训练，并在来自癌症影像档案的234个病变的外部测试集上进行评估。我们的结果揭示了两个关键发现。首先，FM性能与从头训练的ResNet相当，同时大幅降低了硬件需求，在特征提取后仅需几秒钟的CPU时间。然而，传统的放射组学基线显著优于所有深度学习方法，达到了0.88的AUC（所有p值小于等于0.002）。这表明当前的通用型FM嵌入尚未捕捉到驱动组织亚型判别的细粒度纹理和形状异质性。尽管它们在数据稀缺的环境中具有潜力，但医学FMs并未超越肾脏病变分层的既定模型，使放射组学成为当前的最先进方法。

深度解读

Abstract

The rapid proliferation of open-source medical foundation models (FMs) raises a practical question: how well do their pre-trained representations transfer to clinically relevant but data-scarce classification tasks? Particularly in CT-based renal lesion classification, a push toward greater generalizability would be meaningful, as the field is constrained by inherently limited training data. We addressed this through a benchmark of three medical FMs on this specific task. This six-class problem spans common entities like cysts and clear cell renal cell carcinoma, alongside rare subtypes. Using a frozen feature-probing protocol, we compared FM embeddings against a handcrafted radiomics classifier and a 3D ResNet-50 trained from scratch. Models were trained on a composite dataset of 2,854 lesions and evaluated on an external test set of 234 lesions from The Cancer Imaging Archive. Our results reveal two key findings. First, FM performance (AUC 0.70-0.77) matched the from-scratch ResNet (AUC 0.72) while drastically reducing hardware demand, requiring only seconds on a CPU after feature extraction. However, the conventional radiomics baseline significantly outperformed all deep learning approaches, achieving an AUC of 0.88 (all p $\leq$ 0.002). This suggests that current generalist FM embeddings do not yet capture the fine-grained texture and shape heterogeneity driving histological subtype discrimination. Despite their potential in data-scarce settings, medical FMs did not surpass established models for renal lesion stratification, leaving radiomics as the current state-of-the-art.

item.title: Rethinking State Tracking in Recurrent Models Through Error Control Dynamics
item.author: Chung, Jiwan, Choi, Heechan, Kim, Seon Joo
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了递归架构中的状态跟踪问题，指出除了表达能力外，误差控制同样关键。研究发现仿射递归网络无法在保持状态表示后修正误差，导致跟踪能力受限。

背景: 现有的递归架构状态跟踪理论主要关注表达能力，即固定架构是否能理论上实现一组符号转换规则。

目的: 作者认为误差控制同样重要，旨在通过理论证明和实验验证仿射递归网络在状态跟踪方面的局限性。

方法: 通过理论证明仿射递归网络无法在保持状态表示后修正误差，并在分组状态跟踪任务中进行实验验证，分析跟踪崩溃的预测性。

主要发现: 1. 仿射递归网络一旦保持状态表示，就无法沿着状态分离方向修正误差。2. 实际的仿射跟踪器学习的是受累积误差影响的有限时间解。3. 跟踪的可读性取决于累积的类内分散度与初始类间分离度的相对大小。4. 跟踪崩溃的点是可预测的，且能预测下游准确率失效的时间。

结论: 健壮的状态跟踪不仅取决于架构的理论表达能力，更关键地由其误差控制能力决定。

翻译: 递归架构中状态跟踪的理论主要关注表达能力：即固定架构是否能理论上实现一组符号转换规则。我们认为同样重要的是误差控制，即支配区分符号状态的隐藏状态漂移方向的动力学。我们证明了仿射递归网络（包含状态空间模型和线性注意力的一类模型）一旦保持状态表示，就无法沿着状态分离子空间修正误差。因此，实际的仿射跟踪器并没有学习到健壮的状态跟踪，而是学习到由累积的相关状态误差支配的有限时间解。我们描述了这种失效的机制，表明只有当累积的类内分散度相对于初始类间分离度保持较小时，跟踪才保持可读性。我们在分组状态跟踪任务中通过实验证明这种崩溃是可预测的：当可区分性比率超过训练解码器的可读性阈值时，跟踪就会崩溃。在训练好的模型中，这个交叉点预测了下游准确率失效的时间范围。这些结果表明，健壮的状态跟踪不仅由架构的理论表达能力决定，更关键地由其误差控制决定。
