item.title: Tracking the Truth: Object-Centric Spatio-Temporal Monitoring for Video Large Language Models
item.author: Tri Cao, Khoi Le, Thong Nguyen, Cong-Duy Nguyen, Quynh Vo, Anh Tuan Luu, Chunyan Miao, See-Kiong Ng, Shuicheng Yan, Bryan Hooi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对多模态大语言模型在视频理解中易产生幻觉的问题，提出了 STEMO-Bench 基准测试和 STEMO-Track 框架，旨在提升模型的时空监控能力。

背景: 多模态大语言模型在视频理解领域虽有进展，但在动态场景中仍高度容易产生幻觉。现有基准测试往往掩盖了这一缺陷，因为它们依赖单一最终答案，而查询往往可以通过局部视觉线索或统计先验解决。

目的: 为了诊断时空监控能力的缺陷，并解决由此导致的幻觉问题，本文引入了 STEMO-Bench 基准测试，并提出了 STEMO-Track 框架。

方法: 引入 STEMO-Bench 基准测试，通过分解查询来评估中间推理；提出 STEMO-Track 框架，通过分块状态提取和时间聚合显式构建和推理结构化对象轨迹。

主要发现: 实验表明，基于对象的框架显著减少了幻觉答案，并提高了时空推理的一致性。

结论: 本文提出的对象中心框架能有效降低幻觉，提升模型在动态场景下的时空推理能力。

翻译: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced video understanding, they remain highly prone to hallucinations in dynamic scenes. We argue this stems from a failure in spatio-temporal monitoring, the ability to persistently track object identities, states, and relations over time. Existing benchmarks obscure this deficit by relying on single final-answer evaluations for queries that can often be resolved via local visual cues or statistical priors. To rigorously diagnose this, we introduce STEMO-Bench (Spatio-TEmporal MOnitoring), a benchmark of human-verified object-centric facts that evaluates intermediate reasoning by decomposing queries into sub-questions, distinguishing genuine temporal understanding from coincidental correctness. To address failure modes exposed by STEMO, we propose STEMO-Track, a novel object-centric framework that explicitly constructs and reasons over structured object trajectories via chunk-wise state extraction and temporal aggregation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our object-centric framework significantly reduces hallucinated answers and improves spatio-temporal reasoning consistency over state-of-the-art MLLMs.

Abstract

While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced video understanding, they remain highly prone to hallucinations in dynamic scenes. We argue this stems from a failure in spatio-temporal monitoring, the ability to persistently track object identities, states, and relations over time. Existing benchmarks obscure this deficit by relying on single final-answer evaluations for queries that can often be resolved via local visual cues or statistical priors. To rigorously diagnose this, we introduce STEMO-Bench (Spatio-TEmporal MOnitoring), a benchmark of human-verified object-centric facts that evaluates intermediate reasoning by decomposing queries into sub-questions, distinguishing genuine temporal understanding from coincidental correctness. To address failure modes exposed by STEMO, we propose STEMO-Track, a novel object-centric framework that explicitly constructs and reasons over structured object trajectories via chunk-wise state extraction and temporal aggregation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our object-centric framework significantly reduces hallucinated answers and improves spatio-temporal reasoning consistency over state-of-the-art MLLMs.

item.title: LCGNav: Local Candidate-Aware Geometric Enhancement for General Topological Planning in Vision-Language Navigation
item.author: Jiankun Peng, Jianyuan Guo, Yiguang Yang, Yue Liu, Jiashuang Yan, Ying Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: LCGNav 是一种用于视觉语言导航的模块化局部几何增强框架，旨在解决现有在线拓扑规划方法中的局部深度信息冗余和前沿候选点关注减弱问题。

背景: 现有在线拓扑规划方法在连续环境下的视觉语言导航中，存在局部深度信息冗余以及随着拓扑图增长导致对当前前沿候选点关注减弱的局限性。

目的: 提出一种名为 LCGNav 的模块化局部几何增强框架，以解决上述两个局限性。

方法: 将候选深度视图显式转换为 3D 点云，基于智能体的可达范围进行物理截断以实现更紧凑的局部几何建模；引入保持维度的局部融合策略和瞬态状态退化机制，确保几何增强仅应用于当前相关的幽灵节点且不改变原始规划器接口。

主要发现: 在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 数据集上，LCGNav 显著提升了代表性在线拓扑基线的多个关键指标，且具有较低的训练成本；当与 ETP-R1 集成时，在 val-unseen 划分上表现最佳。

结论: LCGNav 是一种有效的跨架构增强模块，代码已开源。

翻译: Online topological planning has become an effective paradigm for Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE), but existing methods still suffer from two limitations: redundant local depth information and weakened focus on current frontier candidates as the topological graph grows. To address this, we propose LCGNav, a modular local geometric enhancement framework for topological VLN. LCGNav explicitly converts candidate depth views into 3D point clouds and applies physical truncation based on the agent's reachable range, enabling more compact local geometric modeling. It further introduces a dimension-preserving local fusion strategy with transient state degradation, so that geometric enhancement is applied only to the currently relevant ghost nodes without changing the original planner interface. Experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE show that LCGNav serves as an effective cross-architecture enhancement module, consistently improving multiple key metrics of representative online topological baselines with low additional training cost. When integrated with ETP-R1, LCGNav achieves the best performance among the compared online topological methods on the val-unseen splits of the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/shannanshouyin/LCGNav.

Abstract

Online topological planning has become an effective paradigm for Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE), but existing methods still suffer from two limitations: redundant local depth information and weakened focus on current frontier candidates as the topological graph grows. To address this, we propose LCGNav, a modular local geometric enhancement framework for topological VLN. LCGNav explicitly converts candidate depth views into 3D point clouds and applies physical truncation based on the agent's reachable range, enabling more compact local geometric modeling. It further introduces a dimension-preserving local fusion strategy with transient state degradation, so that geometric enhancement is applied only to the currently relevant ghost nodes without changing the original planner interface. Experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE show that LCGNav serves as an effective cross-architecture enhancement module, consistently improving multiple key metrics of representative online topological baselines with low additional training cost. When integrated with ETP-R1, LCGNav achieves the best performance among the compared online topological methods on the val-unseen splits of the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/shannanshouyin/LCGNav.

item.title: FactoryNet: A Large-Scale Dataset toward Industrial Time-Series Foundation Models
item.author: Karim Othman, Jonas Petersen, Matei Ignuta-Ciuncanu, Riccardo Maggioni, Camilla Mazzoleni, Federico Martelli, Philipp Petersen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 介绍首个面向工业时序数据的通用预训练语料库 FactoryNet，包含 5100 万数据点，支持跨本体零样本迁移和高效异常检测。

背景: 工业时序数据领域缺乏通用的预训练语料库，现有数据难以实现跨设备的高效迁移。

目的: 构建一个通用的工业时序数据预训练语料库，以实现跨本体的零样本迁移和高效的异常检测。

方法: 提出了 FactoryNet 语料库，包含 5100 万数据点、23k 任务执行（13300 真实，9800 合成），覆盖 6 种本体。引入了 S-E-F-C 模式（设定点、努力、反馈、上下文）将受控系统映射到通用表示框架。数据涵盖 27 种异常类型、健康基线和反事实对，涉及机器人操作和机械加工领域。

主要发现: 跨本体迁移实验显示积极结果；在考虑偏见的度量下，模型在评估的源-目标对上表现出公平的跨本体迁移能力；24 个对齐信号在异常检测方面表现具有竞争力，优于高维基线。

结论: 发布 FactoryNet 作为不断增长的多本体数据集，以推动工业基础模型的发展。

翻译: 我们介绍了首个用于工业时序数据的通用预训练语料库：FactoryNet。该语料库包含 5100 万数据点，跨越 23k 端到端任务执行（13300 真实，9800 合成），涉及 6 种本体，通过共享模式实现了鲁棒的零样本跨本体迁移和高度参数高效的异常检测。我们引入了一种新颖的模式：设定点、努力、反馈、上下文（S-E-F-C），贯穿整个流程，将任何受控系统映射到共同的表示框架。该语料库涵盖了 27 种标注的异常类型，以及机器人操作和机械加工领域的健康基线和反事实对。跨本体迁移实验结果积极：在有偏度量下，我们的模型在评估的源-目标对上表现出公平的跨本体迁移能力，而 24 个对齐信号在异常检测方面表现具有竞争力，优于高维基线。我们将 FactoryNet 作为不断增长的多本体数据集发布，以推动工业基础模型的发展。

Abstract

We introduce the first universal pretraining corpus for industrial time-series data: FactoryNet. 51M datapoints across 23k end-to-end task executions (13.3k real, 9.8k synthetic) on six embodiments, unified by a shared schema that enables robust zero-shot cross-embodiment transfer and highly parameter-efficient anomaly detection. We introduce a novel schema: Setpoint, Effort, Feedback, Context (S-E-F-C) underlying the whole pipeline that maps any actuated system into a common representational frame. The corpus spans 27 annotated anomaly types alongside healthy baselines and counterfactual pairs across robotic manipulation and machining domains. Cross-embodiment transfer experiments yield positive results: under bias-aware metrics our model demonstrates fair cross-embodiment transfer capabilities on the evaluated source-target pair, while 24 schema-aligned signals achieves competitive anomaly detection performance compared to high-dimensional baselines. We release FactoryNet as a growing, multi-embodiment dataset to drive progress toward industrial foundation models.

item.title: Contextual Plackett-Luce: An Efficient Neural Model for Probabilistic Sequence Selection under Ambiguity
item.author: Noam Mizrachi, Nadav Har-Tuv, Shai Shalev-Shwartz
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 Contextual Plackett-Luce (CPL) 的结构化概率模型，用于解决序列选择问题，结合了自回归和并行方法的优点。

背景: 在检测、轨迹预测等任务中，目标具有内在模糊性，导致多模态目标分布与观察到的训练信号之间存在不匹配。

目的: 解决模糊监督下多模态目标分布与训练信号不匹配的问题，同时兼顾模型的表达能力和计算效率。

方法: 提出 Contextual Plackett-Luce (CPL) 模型，通过并行方式构建参数，随后进行轻量级自回归选择，解耦了并行评分和顺序选择。

主要发现: 在多模态路径预测和代表性子集选择任务上，CPL 相比强并行基线，在模糊监督下表现出更好的结构一致性和鲁棒性。

结论: CPL 能够在不牺牲表达能力的情况下实现高效计算，在处理模糊监督的结构化选择任务中表现优于并行基线。

翻译: 选择连贯的序列或子集是结构化预测中的一个基本问题，出现在检测、轨迹预测和代表性子集选择等任务中。在许多此类设置中，目标本质上是模糊的：每个输入都允许多个有效输出，而监督只提供单个采样实例。这导致底层的多模态目标分布与观察到的训练信号之间存在不匹配。我们提出了上下文 Plackett-Luce (CPL)，这是一种用于序列选择的结构化概率模型，它通过遵循具有一元和成对交互项的 Ising 风格参数化，将经典的 Plackett-Luce 模型扩展到上下文相关设置。CPL 可以被视为完全自回归预测和并行序列选择的混合体：自回归模型有效地捕捉不确定性，但在现代并行硬件（如 GPU）上计算昂贵，而并行方法高效但难以表示多模态依赖。CPL 通过以完全并行的方式构建概率选择模型的参数，随后进行轻量级自回归选择过程，其中每一步都对上下文对数几率应用增量更新，从而结合了两者的优势。这种并行评分和顺序选择的解耦实现了高效计算，而不会牺牲表达能力。我们在两个结构化选择任务上评估了 CPL：多模态路径预测和代表性子集选择。与强并行基线相比，CPL 在模糊监督下实现了更好的结构一致性和鲁棒性。

Abstract

Selecting a coherent sequence or subset of elements is a fundamental problem in structured prediction, arising in tasks such as detection, trajectory forecasting, and representative subset selection. In many such settings, the target is inherently ambiguous: each input admits multiple valid outputs, while supervision provides only a single sampled instance. This induces a mismatch between the underlying multi-modal target distribution and the observed training signal. We propose Contextual Plackett-Luce (CPL), a structured probabilistic model for sequence selection that extends the classical Plackett-Luce model to a context-dependent setting following an Ising-style parameterization with unary and pairwise interaction terms. CPL can be viewed as a hybrid between fully autoregressive prediction and parallel sequence selection: autoregressive models effectively capture uncertainty but are computationally expensive on modern parallel hardware such as GPUs, while parallel methods are efficient but struggle to represent multi-modal dependencies. CPL combines the strengths of both by constructing the parameters of a probabilistic selection model in a fully parallel manner, followed by a lightweight autoregressive selection process in which each step applies incremental updates to contextual logits. This decoupling of parallel scoring and sequential selection enables efficient computation without sacrificing expressivity. We evaluate CPL on two structured selection tasks: multi-modal path prediction and representative subset selection. CPL achieves improved structural consistency and robustness under ambiguous supervision compared to strong parallel baselines.

item.title: Smart Contract Security Beyond Detection
item.author: Tamer Abdelaziz
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 智能合约安全研究已从漏洞检测扩展到语义推理、自动修复、对抗鲁棒性和实时漏洞检测等领域。本文围绕四个方向构建了一个以毕业设计为导向的研究框架，旨在帮助学生制定技术扎实、可实证测量且与当代研究一致的毕业设计项目。

背景: 智能合约安全研究议程的扩展，涵盖了语义推理、自动修复、对抗鲁棒性和实时漏洞检测。

目的: 帮助学生制定技术扎实、可实证测量且与当代智能合约安全研究一致的毕业设计项目。

方法: 围绕四个方向构建研究框架：基于基础模型的语义和漏洞推理、具有形式化保证的自动修复、用于恶意合约和交易检测的对抗学习、以及区块链规模下的实时交易级漏洞检测。并将这些方向与两项研究联系起来：智能合约安全分析器的诊断分析以及恶意以太坊交易检测的可扩展实时系统。

主要发现: unknown

结论: 该框架旨在指导学生制定毕业设计项目。

翻译: 智能合约安全已从漏洞检测进展到更广泛的研究议程，包括语义推理、自动修复、对抗鲁棒性和实时漏洞检测。本文围绕四个方向构建了一个以毕业设计为导向的研究框架：基于基础模型的智能合约语义和漏洞推理、具有形式化保证的自动智能合约修复、用于鲁棒恶意合约和交易检测的对抗学习，以及区块链规模下的实时交易级漏洞检测。我们将这些方向与两项描述当前前沿的研究联系起来：对智能合约安全分析器不足之处的诊断分析，以及用于恶意以太坊交易检测的可扩展实时系统。由此产生的框架旨在帮助学生制定技术扎实、可实证测量且与当代智能合约安全研究一致的毕业设计项目。

Abstract

Smart contract security has progressed from vulnerability detection toward a broader research agenda that includes semantic reasoning, automated repair, adversarial robustness, and real-time exploit detection. This paper develops a capstone-oriented research narrative around four directions: foundation-model-based smart contract semantics and vulnerability reasoning [1], automated smart contract repair with formal guarantees [2], adversarial learning for robust malicious contract and transaction detection [3], and real-time transaction-level exploit detection at blockchain scale [4]. We connect these directions to two recent studies that characterize the current frontier: a diagnostic analysis of where smart contract security analyzers fall short [5] and a scalable real-time system for malicious Ethereum transaction detection [6]. The resulting framework is intended to help students formulate capstone projects that are technically grounded, empirically measurable, and aligned with contemporary smart contract security research.

item.title: MultiMedVision: Multi-Modal Medical Vision Framework
item.author: Frank Li, Bardia Khosravi, Mohammadreza Chavoshi, Young Seok Jeon, Theo Dapamede, Hari Trivedi, Janice Newsome, Judy Gichoya
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MultiMedVision 是一个基于稀疏 Vision Transformer 的统一框架，用于联合 2D 和 3D 医学影像的表示学习。

背景: 现有的基础模型使用分开的架构分别处理 2D 和 3D 数据。

目的: 提出一种无需模态特定适配器、在共享潜在空间内原生处理混合模态批次的统一框架。

方法: 使用 3D 旋转位置嵌入和可变长度序列打包，采用单个共享编码器进行自监督训练。

主要发现: 在数据量减少五倍的情况下，模型在 2D 和 3D 基准测试中均取得了有竞争力的性能；学习到的特征包含共存的特征子空间。

结论: 统一的跨维度表示学习是可行的，且不会牺牲模态特定性能。

翻译: 多模态医学成像能够实现全面诊断，然而当前的基础模型使用分开的、特定维度的架构来处理 2D（如 X 光）和 3D（如 CT）数据。我们提出了 MultiMedVision，这是一个基于稀疏 Vision Transformer 的统一框架，用于联合 2D/3D 表示学习。我们的模型使用 3D 旋转位置嵌入和可变长度序列打包，在共享潜在空间内原生处理混合模态批次，无需模态特定适配器或将 3D 体视为 2D 切片序列。该模型在胸部 X 光片和 CT 扫描上使用自监督目标进行训练，使用单个共享编码器且数据量减少五倍，MultiMedVision 在 2D 基准测试和 3D 任务上均取得了有竞争力的性能。对学习到的表示的分析揭示了共存的特征子空间，证明了统一的跨维度表示学习是可行的，且不会牺牲模态特定性能。

Abstract

Multi-modal medical imaging enables comprehensive diagnostics, yet current foundation models process 2D (e.g. X-ray) and 3D (e.g. CT) data with separate, dimensionality-specific architectures. We present MultiMedVision, a unified framework for joint 2D/3D representation learning built on a Sparse Vision Transformer. Our model uses 3D Rotary Positional Embeddings and variable-length sequence packing to process mixed-modality batches natively within a shared latent space, without modality-specific adapters or treating 3D volumes as 2D slice sequences. Trained with a self-supervised objective on chest X-rays (MIMIC-CXR) and CT scans (CT-RATE), and using a single shared encoder with 5x less data, MultiMedVision achieves competitive performance on both 2D benchmarks (Macro AUROC 0.82 on MIMIC, 0.84 on CheXpert) and 3D tasks (0.85 on CT-RATE). Analysis of the learned representations reveals coexisting modality-specific and shared feature subspaces, demonstrating that unified cross-dimensional representation learning is feasible without sacrificing modality-specific performance.

item.title: Meow-Omni 1: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Feline Ethology
item.author: Jucheng Hu, Zhangquan Chen, Yulin Chen, Chengjie Hong, Liang Zhou, Tairan Wang, Sifei Li, Giulio Zhu, Feng Zhou, Yiheng Zeng, Suorong Yang, Dongzhan Zhou
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了 Meow-Omni 1，首个专为计算行为学设计的开源四模态大语言模型，旨在解决动物意图解码中的语义别名问题。

背景: 动物意图解码面临语义别名挑战，即相同的外部信号可能对应完全不同的内部状态。现有多模态大语言模型无法处理高频生物时间序列数据，导致只能进行浅层的模式匹配而非深层推理。

目的: 为了解决现有模型无法处理生物时间序列数据的问题，弥合计算行为学中的差距，并建立跨物种意图理解的范式。

方法: 提出了 Meow-Omni 1，通过架构调整将专用科学编码器集成到统一骨干网络中，利用生理学基础跨模态对齐来形式化意图推理。模型原生融合了视频、音频、生理时间序列流和文本推理。

主要发现: 在 MeowBench 基准测试上，Meow-Omni 1 达到了最先进的意图识别准确率，显著优于现有的视觉语言和多模态基线模型。

结论: 发布了包含模型权重、训练框架和 Meow-10K 数据集的开源流程，旨在推动基础模型在兽医诊断和野生动物保护等现实场景中的应用。

翻译: This paper introduces Meow-Omni 1, the first open-source quad-modal Large Language Model purpose-built for computational ethology, aiming to solve the semantic aliasing problem in decoding animal intent. Decoding animal intent faces the challenge of semantic aliasing, where identical external signals can correspond to completely different internal states. Existing Multimodal Large Language Models cannot process high-frequency biological time-series data, limiting them to superficial pattern matching rather than deep reasoning. To address the inability of existing models to process biological time-series data and bridge the gap in computational ethology, we propose Meow-Omni 1. Through architectural adaptation, we integrate specialized scientific encoders into a unified backbone and utilize physiologically grounded cross-modal alignment to formalize intent inference, fusing video, audio, physiological time-series streams, and textual reasoning natively. On the MeowBench benchmark, Meow-Omni 1 achieves state-of-the-art intent recognition accuracy, significantly outperforming leading vision-language and omni-modal baselines. The complete open-source pipeline, including model weights, training framework, and the Meow-10K dataset, is released to advance foundation models towards real-world applications in veterinary diagnostics and wildlife conservation.

Abstract

Deciphering animal intent is a fundamental challenge in computational ethology, largely because of semantic aliasing, the phenomenon where identical external signals (e.g., a cat's purr) correspond to radically different internal states depending on physiological context. Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are blind to high-frequency biological time-series data, restricting them to superficial behavioural pattern matching rather than genuine latent-state reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce Meow-Omni 1, the first open-source, quad-modal MLLM purpose-built for computational ethology. It natively fuses video, audio, and physiological time-series streams with textual reasoning. Through targeted architectural adaptation, we integrate specialized scientific encoders into a unified backbone and formalize intent inference via physiologically grounded cross-modal alignment. Evaluated on MeowBench, a novel, expert-verified quad-modal benchmark, Meow-Omni 1 achieves state-of-the-art intent-recognition accuracy (71.16%), substantially outperforming leading vision-language and omni-modal baselines. We release the complete open-source pipeline including model weights, training framework, and the Meow-10K dataset, to establish a scalable paradigm for inter-species intent understanding and to advance foundation models toward real-world veterinary diagnostics and wildlife conservation.

item.title: Objective-Specific Privileged Bases via Full-Prefix Matryoshka Learning
item.author: Arghamitra Talukder, Philippe Chlenski, Itsik Pe'er
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对学习到的表示在旋转变换下维度不可识别的问题，本文研究了 Matryoshka 表示学习（MRL）。在理论证明和实验中，发现 MRL 能够诱导出与任务对齐的特权基，恢复有序的主方向，且计算高效，其坐标幅度反映了信息量。

背景: 学习到的表示通常对旋转变换具有不变性，导致单个维度无法识别且可互换。

目的: 研究如何通过 Matryoshka 表示学习（MRL）诱导出与任务对齐的特权基，且该基不同于基于方差或正则化器诱导的排序。

方法: 在线性设置下，利用全前缀 MRL 恢复有序的主方向，并使用共享统计量进行高效计算。

主要发现: 实验表明，MRL 产生了一致的与任务信号对齐的逐维结构，其中坐标幅度反映了信息量。

结论: 在线性设置下，证明了全前缀 MRL 能够恢复有序的主方向，且计算高效。

翻译: 学习到的表示通常对旋转变换具有不变性，导致单个维度无法识别且可互换。我们研究了 Matryoshka 表示学习（MRL）如何诱导出与任务对齐的特权基，且该基不同于基于方差或正则化器诱导的排序。在线性设置下，我们证明了全前缀 MRL 恢复了有序的主方向，并且可以使用共享统计量高效计算。实验上，我们证明了 MRL 产生了一致的与任务信号对齐的逐维结构，其中坐标幅度反映了信息量。

Abstract

Learned representations are often invariant to rotational transformations, leaving individual dimensions non-identifiable and interchangeable. We study how Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) induces a task-aligned privileged basis distinct from variance-based or regularizer-induced orderings. In the linear setting, we prove that full-prefix MRL recovers the ordered principal directions, and can be computed efficiently using shared statistics. Empirically, we demonstrate that MRL yields consistent per-dimension structure aligned with task signal, where coordinate magnitude reflects informativeness.

item.title: RigidFormer: Learning Rigid Dynamics using Transformers
item.author: Zhiyang Dou, Minghao Guo, Haixu Wu, Doug Roble, Tuur Stuyck, Wojciech Matusik
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于Transformer的物体级模型RigidFormer，用于从点云等无网格输入中高效学习刚体动力学模拟。

背景: 基于学习的多物体刚体动力学模拟面临接触不连续和误差累积的挑战。现有方法受限于网格连接性和顶点级消息传递，导致计算成本高且难以处理点云等无网格输入。

目的: 高效地从无网格表示中建模高保真度的刚体动力学。

方法: 引入RigidFormer，一种基于Transformer的物体级模型。使用紧凑的锚点推进物体，通过锚点-顶点池化丰富锚点特征。提出基于锚点的RoPE机制注入锚点几何信息。使用可微分的Kabsch对齐将更新投影到刚体流形上以强制保持刚性。

主要发现: 在标准基准测试中，RigidFormer使用点输入优于或匹配基于网格的基线，运行速度更快，能够泛化到未见过的点分辨率和数据集，并扩展到200多个物体；还展示了初步扩展到受命令控制的关节体。

结论: RigidFormer成功实现了基于点云的刚体动力学模拟，具有高效性和泛化能力。

翻译: 基于学习的多物体刚体动力学模拟仍然很难，因为接触是不连续的，且误差会随长时间累积。大多数现有方法仍受限于网格连接性和顶点级消息传递，这限制了它们在点云等无网格输入上的适用性，并导致高昂的计算成本。因此，高效地从无网格表示中建模高保真度的刚体动力学仍然具有挑战性。我们介绍了RigidFormer，一种基于Transformer的物体级模型，它使用可控的积分步长学习无网格刚体动力学。RigidFormer在物体级别进行推理，并通过紧凑的锚点推进每个物体；锚点-顶点池化利用局部顶点特征丰富这些锚点，在不需要密集顶点级交互的情况下保留了接触相关的几何信息。我们提出了基于锚点的RoPE，在尊重物体和锚点无序性质的同时将锚点几何信息注入注意力机制：物体令牌处理是排列等变的，而平均池化的锚点描述符对锚点重新索引具有不变性，同时保持形状范围。RigidFormer还通过使用可微分的Kabsch对齐将更新投影到刚体流形上，进一步强制保持刚性。在标准基准测试中，RigidFormer使用点输入优于或匹配基于网格的基线，运行速度更快，能够泛化到未见过的点分辨率和跨数据集，并扩展到200多个物体；我们还通过将身体部位视为相互作用的物体级组件，展示了初步扩展到受命令控制的关节体。

深度解读

Abstract

Learning-based simulation of multi-object rigid-body dynamics remains difficult because contact is discontinuous and errors compound over long horizons. Most existing methods remain tied to mesh connectivity and vertex-level message passing, which limits their applicability to mesh-free inputs such as point clouds and leads to high computational cost. Efficiently modeling high-fidelity rigid-body dynamics from mesh-free representations, therefore, remains challenging. We introduce RigidFormer, an object-centric Transformer-based model that learns mesh-free rigid-body dynamics with controllable integration step sizes. RigidFormer reasons at the object level and advances each object through compact anchors; Anchor-Vertex Pooling enriches these anchors with local vertex features, retaining contact-relevant geometry without dense vertex-level interaction. We propose Anchor-based RoPE to inject anchor geometry into attention while respecting the unordered nature of objects and anchors: object-token processing is permutation-equivariant, and the mean-pooled anchor descriptor is invariant to anchor reindexing while preserving shape extent. RigidFormer further enforces rigidity by projecting updates onto the rigid-body manifold using differentiable Kabsch alignment. On standard benchmarks, RigidFormer outperforms or matches mesh-based baselines using point inputs, runs faster, generalizes to unseen point resolutions and across datasets, and scales to 200+ objects; we also show a preliminary extension to command-conditioned articulated bodies by treating body parts as interacting object-level components.

item.title: Flame3D: Zero-shot Compositional Reasoning of 3D Scenes with Agentic Language Models
item.author: Sagar Bharadwaj, Ziyong Ma, Anurag Ghosh, Srinivasan Seshan, Anthony Rowe
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Flame3D 是一个无需 3D 特定训练的框架，通过可编辑的视觉文本 3D 记忆和可组合的空间工具，使智能体能够在推理时合成空间程序，实现开放式的 3D 场景理解。

背景: 3D 场景理解涉及对自由空间、物体定位、假设物体插入、复杂几何关系以及与外部工具数据集成的推理。现有方法通常依赖大规模 3D 语言训练或仅关注简单的空间关系。

目的: 提出一种无需 3D 特定训练即可实现广泛泛化的方法，并研究多跳 3D 推理能力。

方法: 提出名为 Flame3D 的训练无关框架。它将场景表示为可编辑的视觉文本 3D 记忆，通过可组合的空间工具将场景暴露给现成的多模态大语言模型。智能体可以在推理时合成自定义的空间程序。

主要发现: 在 ScanQA 上性能具有竞争力；在 Compose3D 基准测试中，发现固定工具效果不足，智能体在推理时合成空间操作的能力至关重要。

结论: 未来 3D 场景理解的发展应关注更丰富的场景记忆和表达性组合抽象。

翻译: 3D 场景理解涵盖了关于自由空间、物体定位、假设物体插入、复杂几何关系以及将所有这些与外部工具和数据源集成的推理。现有的 3D 理解方法通常依赖大规模的 3D 语言训练，或专注于物体定位和简单的空间关系。我们认为，推动 3D 语言训练的广泛泛化可以在推理时实现，而无需 3D 特定的训练。我们提出了 Flame3D，这是一个无需训练的框架，它将场景表示为可编辑的视觉文本 3D 记忆，并通过可组合的空间工具将其暴露给现成的多模态大语言模型。Flame3D 还允许智能体在推理时合成自定义的空间程序，从而实现对布局、空白空间和场景中尚未存在的物体的开放式推理。外部数据和修正可以添加到记忆中而无需重新训练。除了在 ScanQA 上展示与微调的 3D LMM 方法具有竞争力的性能外，我们还通过在精选的组合空间推理基准 Compose3D 上评估 Flame3D 来研究其多跳 3D 推理能力。我们发现固定工具是不够的，智能体在推理时合成空间操作的能力是必不可少的。这些结果提出了一个问题：3D 场景理解的未来进展是否应关注更丰富的场景记忆和表达性组合抽象？

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了Flame3D系统，利用智能语言模型实现了对三维场景的零样本组合推理。

Abstract

3D scene understanding spans reasoning about free space, object grounding, hypothetical object insertions, complex geometric relationships, and integrating all of these with external tools and data sources. Existing 3D understanding methods typically rely on large-scale 3D-language training or focus on object grounding and simple spatial relationships. We argue that the broad generalization that motivates 3D-language training can be achieved at inference time, without 3D-specific training. We propose Flame3D, a training-free framework that represents scenes as editable visual-textual 3D memories and exposes them to an off-the-shelf MLLM through composable spatial tools. Flame3D also lets the agent synthesize custom spatial programs at inference time, enabling open-ended reasoning over layouts, empty space, and objects not yet present in the scene. External data and corrections can be added to the memory without retraining. In addition to showing competitive performance to finetuned 3D-LMM methods on ScanQA, we study multi-hop 3D reasoning capabilities of Flame3D by evaluating it on a curated compositional spatial-reasoning benchmark, Compose3D. We find that fixed tools fall short and that the agent's ability to synthesize spatial operations at inference time is essential. These results invite the question: should future progress in 3D scene understanding focus on richer scene memories and expressive compositional abstractions?

item.title: CATS: Curvature Aware Temporal Selection for efficient long video understanding
item.author: Mehrajul Abadin Miraj, Abdul Mohaimen Al Radi, Shariful Islam Rayhan, Md. Tanvir Alam, Ismat Rahman, Yu Tian, Md Mosaddek Khan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为CATS的曲率感知帧选择方法，用于长视频理解，在效率和准确性之间取得了良好的平衡。

背景: 使用多模态大语言模型理解长视频需要在严格的计算预算下选择少量信息帧，穷举处理不可行，且最优选择是组合问题。

目的: 提出CATS方法，通过显式建模查询帧与视频帧之间相关性的时间几何结构，来识别显著事件及其周围上下文。

方法: 利用时间曲率来调整选择密度，捕捉突变的过渡和逐渐演变的内容，同时抑制冗余帧。

主要发现: 在固定骨干网络和帧预算下，CATS在LongVideoBench和VideoMME上持续优于AKS等轻量级方法；在保持约93到95的MIRA性能的同时，仅需3到4的预处理成本；生成的描述更连贯且信息量更大，表明在视觉证据方面有更好的基础。

结论: CATS是一种计算高效且具有原则性的长视频理解方法。

翻译: 使用多模态大语言模型理解长视频需要在严格的计算预算下选择少量信息帧，穷举处理不可行且最优选择是组合问题。我们提出了CATS，一种曲率感知的帧选择方法，显式建模查询帧相关性的时间几何结构以识别显著事件及其周围上下文。通过利用时间曲率调整选择密度，CATS在捕捉突变过渡和逐渐演变内容的同时抑制冗余帧。在固定骨干网络和帧预算下，CATS在LongVideoBench和VideoMME上持续优于AKS等轻量级方法。虽然MIRA等多阶段方法实现了更高的绝对准确率，但计算开销巨大；相比之下，CATS保留了约93到95的MIRA性能，仅需3到4的预处理成本，实现了良好的效率-准确率权衡。除了回答准确率外，我们还使用LLM-as-a-judge协议评估描述生成，结果表明CATS产生更连贯和丰富的输出，表明在视觉证据方面有更好的基础。这些结果将CATS定位为一种计算高效且具有原则性的长视频理解方法。

Abstract

Understanding long videos with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) requires selecting a small subset of informative frames under strict computational budgets, where exhaustive processing is infeasible and optimal selection is combinatorial. We propose CATS, a curvature-aware frame selection method that explicitly models the temporal geometry of query-frame relevance to identify salient events and their surrounding context. By leveraging temporal curvature to adapt selection density, CATS captures both abrupt transitions and gradually evolving content while suppressing redundant frames. Under a fixed backbone and frame budget, CATS consistently outperforms prior lightweight approaches such as AKS on LongVideoBench and VideoMME. While multi-stage methods such as MIRA achieve higher absolute accuracy, they incur substantial computational overhead; in contrast, CATS retains approximately 93-95% of MIRA's performance while requiring only 3-4% of its preprocessing cost, yielding a favorable efficiency-accuracy trade-off. Beyond answer accuracy, we evaluate description generation using an LLM-as-a-judge protocol, and the obtained results show that CATS produces more coherent and informative outputs, indicating improved grounding in visual evidence. These results position CATS as a computationally efficient and principled approach to long-video understanding.

item.title: Monocular Biomechanical Tracking of Fingers with Inverse Kinematics to Foundation Models
item.author: R. James Cotton, Pouyan Firouzabadi, Wendy Murray
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种结合SAM 3D Body模型与逆运动学优化的方法，用于从单目视频中提取受解剖学约束的手指关节角度。

背景: 准确的手部和手指视频追踪在监测日常生活活动和测量活动范围方面具有重大临床应用，但用于获取手部生物力学的单目视频方法仍不成熟。

目的: 从单目视频中提取受解剖学约束的手指关节角度。

方法: 将SAM 3D Body从PyTorch移植到JAX以集成到MuJoCo-MJX中，实现了GPU加速优化，并开发了Momentum Human Rig输出与生物力学模型标记点之间的新映射。

主要发现: 在验证中，手指关节角度误差约为10度，手部位置误差约为6毫米。结果在不同摄像机视角下保持一致，并且对从多视图视频生成参考值的不同方法具有鲁棒性。

结论: 该工作将单目生物力学分析扩展到详细的手指追踪，扩大了从可用视频中对手部运动进行定量表征的获取范围。

翻译: 准确的手部和手指视频追踪在监测日常生活活动和测量活动范围方面具有重大临床应用，但用于获取手部生物力学的单目视频方法仍不成熟。我们提出了一种方法，该方法结合了SAM 3D Body基础模型和全身生物力学模型中的逆运动学优化，以从单视图视频中提取受解剖学约束的手指关节角度。我们将SAM 3D Body从PyTorch移植到JAX以集成到MuJoCo-MJX中，实现了GPU加速优化，并开发了Momentum Human Rig输出与生物力学模型标记点之间的新映射。与7名参与者执行各种手部姿势和物体操作任务的4,590帧的8摄像机多视图重建进行验证，在Procrustes对齐后，手指关节角度误差约为10度，手部位置误差约为6毫米。结果在不同摄像机视角下保持一致，并且对从多视图视频生成参考值的不同方法具有鲁棒性。这项工作将单目生物力学分析扩展到详细的手指追踪，扩大了从可用视频中对手部运动进行定量表征的获取范围。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法利用单目摄像头来追踪手指，结合生物力学模型和逆运动学技术，将结果输入到基础模型中。整体流程是通过单目视觉获取数据，利用生物力学模型和逆运动学计算手指姿态，最后连接到基础模型进行处理。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Accurate hand and finger tracking from video has significant clinical applications for monitoring activities of daily living and measuring range of motion, yet monocular video approaches for obtaining hand biomechanics remain under-developed. We present a method that combines the SAM 3D Body foundation model with inverse kinematics optimization in a full-body biomechanical model to extract anatomically-constrained finger joint angles from single-view video. We port SAM 3D Body from PyTorch to JAX for integration with MuJoCo-MJX, enabling GPU-accelerated optimization, and develop a novel mapping between the Momentum Human Rig (MHR) outputs and biomechanical model markers. Validation against 8-camera multiview reconstruction on 4,590 frames from 7 participants performing a variety of hand poses and object manipulation tasks shows finger joint angle errors of approximately 10 degrees and hand position errors of approximately 6 mm, after Procrustes alignment. Results were consistent across camera viewpoints and robust to different methods for producing reference values from multiview video. This work extends monocular biomechanical analysis to detailed finger tracking, expanding access to quantitative characterization of hand movement from readily available video.

item.title: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Enhances In-Context Learning for LLM-Based Mobile Traffic Prediction
item.author: MohammadMahdi Ghadaksaz, Mohammad Farzanullah, Akram Bin Sediq, Ali Afana, Melike Erol-Kantarci
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于思维链的大语言模型移动流量预测框架，包含离线和在线两个阶段，通过PCoT生成演示并检索相关示例，显著提升了预测精度。

背景: 在5G和6G网络中，准确的短期移动流量预测对于主动资源分配和低延迟网络管理至关重要。虽然大语言模型可以进行上下文学习，但简单的提示在流量动态快速波动时可能存在数值不稳定和时序推理能力有限的问题。

目的: 解决简单上下文学习在流量波动时的数值不稳定和时序推理能力有限的问题，提高移动流量预测的准确性。

方法: 提出了一种两阶段的框架。离线阶段使用基于计划的思维链PCoT管道生成结构化的思维链演示。在线阶段使用相似性策略检索最相关的演示进行实时预测。

主要发现: 在真实5G数据集上，相比2-shot上下文学习LLM和经典基线，提出的2-shot CoT-LLM将平均绝对误差、均方根误差和R2分数分别提高了最多14.88%、15.03%和22.41%。优化上下文示例数量还能进一步分别提升4.58%、5.70%和4.85%。

结论: 该框架能有效提升移动流量预测的准确性，证明了思维链和演示检索策略的有效性。

翻译: 准确的短期移动流量预测对于第五代和第六代网络中的主动资源分配和低延迟网络管理至关重要。虽然大型语言模型可以在不需要特定任务重新训练的情况下执行上下文学习，但当流量动态迅速波动时，简单的上下文学习提示可能会遭受数值不稳定和时序推理能力有限的问题。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于思维链的LLM移动流量预测框架，该框架分两个阶段运行：(i) 离线阶段，通过基于计划的思维链管道生成推理过程，构建结构化的思维链演示；(ii) 在线阶段，使用同时考虑历史吞吐量模式及其短期变化的相似性策略检索最相关的演示，以进行接近实时的预测。我们使用包含各种应用中驾驶和静态场景的真实世界5G测量数据集评估了所提出的框架。我们的数值结果表明，与2-shot上下文学习LLM和经典基线相比，所提出的2-shot CoT-LLM可以将平均绝对误差、均方根误差和R2分数分别提高多达14.88%、15.03%和22.41%。此外，通过优化上下文示例的数量，我们在平均绝对误差、均方根误差和R2分数上分别实现了额外的4.58%、5.70%和4.85%的改进。

Abstract

Accurate short-term mobile traffic prediction is important for proactive resource allocation and low-latency network management in fifth generation (5G) and sixth generation (6G). While large language models (LLMs) can perform in-context learning (ICL) without task-specific retraining, naive ICL prompting may suffer from numerical instability and limited temporal reasoning when traffic dynamics fluctuate rapidly. In this paper, we propose a chain-of-thought (CoT)-enabled LLM-based mobile traffic prediction framework that operates in two phases: (i) an offline phase that constructs structured CoT demonstrations by generating rationales via a plan-based CoT (PCoT) pipeline (lecture, plan, and rationale), and (ii) an online phase that performs close to real-time prediction by retrieving the most relevant demonstrations using a similarity policy that considers both the historical throughput pattern and its short-term changes. We evaluate the proposed framework using a real-world 5G measurement dataset that includes both driving and static scenarios across diverse applications. Our numerical results reveal that the proposed 2-shot CoT-LLM can improve mean absolute error (MAE), root mean square error (RMSE) and R2-score by up to 14.88%, 15.03%, and 22.41%, respectively, compared to the 2-shot ICL-LLM and classical baselines. Furthermore, by optimizing the number of in-context examples, we achieve additional improvements of 4.58%, 5.70%, and 4.85% in MAE, RMSE, and R2-score, respectively.

item.title: Pacing Equilibria in Second-Price Auctions with Few Goods
item.author: Yiyang Huang, Yonglei Yan, Zihe Wang, Zhengyang Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了在线广告拍卖中第二价格 pacing 均衡的计算问题，提出了一种计算方法。

背景: 在线广告拍卖中的基础模型。

目的: 计算第二价格 pacing 均衡。

方法: 将买家 pacing 乘数映射到商品最高出价，将参数空间划分为几何单元格，通过枚举单元格固定出价顺序，并将均衡计算简化为线性可行性规划。

主要发现: 提出了在商品数量为常数时的多项式时间算法；证明了在商品数量任意但可聚合为常数个估值类型的大规模市场中，该方法依然有效。

结论: 该算法在特定条件下具有可扩展性。

翻译: 在本文中，我们研究了在线广告拍卖中第二价格 pacing 均衡的计算问题，这是在线广告拍卖中的一个基础模型。我们提出了一种多项式时间算法，用于计算商品数量为常数的实例中的精确 SPPE。我们的核心技术是将买家的 pacing 乘数映射到每个商品的最高出价，有效地将参数空间划分为一组不同的几何单元格。通过枚举这些单元格，我们固定了出价的相对顺序，并将均衡计算问题简化为线性可行性规划。最后，我们证明了只要商品可以聚合为常数个估值类型，这种可解性就可以扩展到商品数量任意的大规模市场。

Abstract

In this paper, we investigate the computation of second-price pacing equilibria (SPPEs), a foundational model in online advertising auctions. We present a polynomial-time algorithm for computing exact SPPEs in instances with a constant number of goods. Our core technique maps buyers' pacing multipliers to the highest bids on each good, effectively partitioning the parameter space into a set of distinct geometric cells. By enumerating these cells, we fix the relative ordering of the bids and reduce the problem of equilibrium computation to a linear feasibility program. Finally, we demonstrate that this tractability extends to large-scale markets with an arbitrary number of goods, provided the goods can be aggregated into a constant number of valuation types.

item.title: Empowering VLMs for Few-Shot Multimodal Time Series Classification via Tailored Agentic Reasoning
item.author: Lin Li, Jiawei Huang, Qihao Quan, Dan Li, Boxin Li, Xiao Zhang, Erli Meng, Wenjie Feng, Jian Lou, See-Kiong Ng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于少样本多模态时间序列分类的视觉语言模型代理推理框架MarsTSC。

背景: 针对少样本多模态时间序列分类任务。

目的: 引入自我进化的知识库，通过反思性代理推理迭代优化上下文，提升分类性能。

方法: 框架包含生成器、反思者和修改者三个协作角色。生成器负责推理分类，反思者诊断错误原因，修改者更新知识库。此外，还引入了测试时更新策略以缓解偏差和分布偏移。

主要发现: 在12个主流基准测试上，MarsTSC在6种VLM后端上均取得显著且一致的性能提升，优于经典和基础模型，并能提供可解释的推理依据。

结论: MarsTSC在少样本条件下表现优异，具有可解释性。

翻译: 本文提出了一种用于少样本多模态时间序列分类的视觉语言模型代理推理框架MarsTSC，该框架引入了通过反思性代理推理迭代优化的自我进化知识库作为动态上下文。框架包含三个协作角色：生成器通过推理进行可靠分类，反思者诊断推理错误的根本原因以提供针对生成器遗漏的时间特征的判别性见解，修改者将验证后的更新应用于知识库以防止上下文坍塌。此外，本文还引入了测试时更新策略，以实现谨慎、连续的知识库优化，从而缓解少样本偏差和分布偏移。在12个主流时间序列基准测试上的广泛实验表明，MarsTSC在6种视觉语言模型后端上均实现了显著且一致的性能提升，在少样本条件下优于经典和基于基础模型的时间序列基线，同时生成了可解释的推理依据，将每个分类决策建立在人类可读的特征证据上。

Abstract

In this paper, we propose the first VL$\underline{\textbf{M}}$ $\underline{\textbf{a}}$gentic $\underline{\textbf{r}}$easoning framework for few-$\underline{\textbf{s}}$hot multimodal $\underline{\textbf{T}}$ime $\underline{\textbf{S}}$eries $\underline{\textbf{C}}$lassification ($\textbf{MarsTSC}$), which introduces a self-evolving knowledge bank as a dynamic context iteratively refined via reflective agentic reasoning. The framework comprises three collaborative roles: i) Generator conducts reliable classification via reasoning; ii) Reflector diagnoses the root causes of reasoning errors to yield discriminative insights targeting the temporal features overlooked by Generator; iii) Modifier applies verified updates to the knowledge bank to prevent context collapse. We further introduce a test-time update strategy to enable cautious, continuous knowledge bank refinement to mitigate few-shot bias and distribution shift. Extensive experiments across 12 mainstream time series benchmarks demonstrate that $\textbf{MarsTSC}$ delivers substantial and consistent performance gains across 6 VLM backbones, outperforming both classical and foundation model-based time series baselines under few-shot conditions, while producing interpretable rationales that ground each classification decision in human-readable feature evidence.

item.title: SAMOFT: Robust Multi-Object Tracking via Region and Flow
item.author: Yanchao Wang, Dawei Zhang, Chengzhuan Yang, Wei Liu, Minglu Li, Hua Wang, Zhonglong Zheng, Ming-Hsuan Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为SAMOFT的鲁棒多目标跟踪方法，通过利用像素级线索来提升在复杂运动场景下的性能。

背景: 多目标跟踪是计算机视觉的基础任务。现有方法主要依赖实例级特征进行轨迹关联，在物体变形、非线性运动和遮挡等挑战条件下性能往往较差。

目的: 提出一种利用像素级线索的跟踪器，以改善复杂运动场景下的鲁棒性。

方法: 提出了SAMOFT跟踪器，包含四个核心模块：像素运动匹配模块，结合分割一切模型和光流优化运动预测；质心距离匹配模块，处理低置信度或部分遮挡观测；基于分布的校正模块，利用历史光流统计在线校正轨迹状态；以及聚类感知重识别策略，提升外观特征性能。

主要发现: 在DanceTrack和MOTChallenge数据集上的实验表明，SAMOFT持续改进了基准跟踪器，并与最新的最先进方法取得了竞争性的性能。

结论: 验证了利用像素级线索进行鲁棒多目标跟踪的有效性。

翻译: 多目标跟踪是计算机视觉中的一个基础任务，要求在帧间持续跟踪多个目标并保持一致的身份。然而，大多数现有方法主要依赖实例级对象特征进行轨迹关联，这往往导致在物体变形、非线性运动和遮挡等挑战条件下性能下降。在这项工作中，我们提出了SAMOFT，一种利用像素级线索来提高复杂运动场景下鲁棒性的跟踪器。具体而言，我们引入了一个像素运动匹配模块，将分割一切模型与密集光流相结合，利用瞬时前景像素运动来优化基于卡尔曼滤波的运动预测。为了进一步提高在不可靠检测下的鲁棒性，我们设计了一个质心距离匹配模块，对低置信度或部分遮挡的观测执行灵活的基于掩码的质心匹配。此外，一个基于分布的校正模块以无训练的方式利用历史光流统计建模长尾运动模式，并在线动态校正轨迹状态。我们还结合了聚类感知重识别策略，以提高轨迹外观特征的稳定性和判别力。在DanceTrack和MOTChallenge基准测试上的大量实验表明，SAMOFT持续改进了基准跟踪器，并与最新的最先进方法相比取得了竞争性的性能，验证了利用像素级线索进行鲁棒多目标跟踪的有效性。

Abstract

Multi-object tracking (MOT) is a fundamental task in computer vision that requires continuously tracking multiple targets while maintaining consistent identities across frames. However, most existing approaches primarily rely on instance-level object features for trajectory association, which often leads to degraded performance under challenging conditions such as object deformation, nonlinear motion, and occlusion. In this work, we propose SAMOFT, a robust tracker that leverages pixel-level cues to improve robustness under complex motion scenarios. Specifically, we introduce a Pixel Motion Matching (PMM) module that integrates the Segment Anything Model (SAM) with dense optical flow to refine Kalman filter-based motion prediction using instantaneous foreground pixel motion. To further enhance robustness under unreliable detections, we design a Centroid Distance Matching (CDM) module that performs flexible mask-based centroid matching for low-confidence or partially occluded observations. Moreover, a Distribution-Based Correction (DBC) module models long-tailed motion patterns in a training-free manner using historical optical flow statistics and dynamically corrects trajectory states online. We also incorporate a Cluster-Aware ReID (CA-ReID) strategy to improve the stability and discriminative power of trajectory appearance features. Extensive experiments on the DanceTrack and MOTChallenge benchmarks demonstrate that SAMOFT consistently improves baseline trackers and achieves competitive performance compared with recent state-of-the-art methods, validating the effectiveness of leveraging pixel-level cues for robust multi-object tracking.

item.title: MAG-VLAQ: Multi-modal Aerial-Ground Query Aggregation for Cross-View Place Recognition
item.author: Zhengyi Xu, Yuhang Ming, Zhihao Zhan, Hanyu Zhu, Javier Civera, Wanzeng Kong
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于基础模型增强的查询聚合框架MAG-VLAQ，用于解决多模态空地跨视角地点识别问题。

背景: 多模态跨视角地点识别在计算机视觉和机器人领域面临挑战，主要源于地面观测与空中参考之间在视角、模态和空间结构上的严重差异。

目的: 提出MAG-VLAQ框架，旨在通过基础模型增强和查询聚合机制，提高多模态空地跨视角地点识别的性能。

方法: 利用预训练基础模型提取地面和空中图像的视觉标记以及地面LiDAR的几何标记，并将异构标记投影到共享嵌入空间。主要贡献是提出ODE条件化的VLAQ，将基于神经常微分方程的RGB-LiDAR融合与向量局部聚合查询紧密耦合，根据融合状态动态调整查询中心。

主要发现: 在KITTI360-AG数据集上，MAG-VLAQ的性能几乎翻倍，在卫星设置下达到61.1的Recall@1，而最佳竞争方法为34.5。

结论: 实验验证了MAG-VLAQ的有效性，显著改善了空地匹配性能。

翻译: 多模态跨视角地点识别在计算机视觉和机器人领域仍然是一个基础挑战，这是由于地面观测和空中参考之间在视角、模态和空间结构上存在严重差异。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了MAG-VLAQ，这是一个用于多模态空地跨视角地点识别的基础模型增强查询聚合框架。具体而言，我们的方法利用预训练的基础模型从地面和空中图像中提取密集视觉标记，以及从地面LiDAR观测中提取表达性几何标记。然后将这些异构标记投影到共享嵌入空间中进行跨模态对齐和融合。作为我们的主要贡献，我们提出了ODE条件化的VLAQ，它将基于神经常微分方程的RGB-LiDAR融合与向量局部聚合查询紧密耦合。在这个设计中，VLAQ查询中心根据融合的多模态状态进行动态调整。这种机制允许最终的全球描述符保留全局学习的检索原型，同时对场景特定的视觉和几何证据保持响应，显著改善了空地匹配。在KITTI360-AG和nuScenes-AG上的广泛实验验证了我们提出的MAG-VLAQ的有效性。值得注意的是，在KITTI360-AG上，我们的MAG-VLAQ几乎将最先进的性能翻倍，在卫星设置下达到61.1的Recall@1，而最佳竞争方法为34.5。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Multi-modal cross-view place recognition remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision and robotics due to the severe viewpoint, modality, and spatial-structure discrepancies between ground observations and aerial references. To address this challenge, we present MAG-VLAQ, a foundation-model-enhanced query aggregation framework for multi-modal aerial-ground cross-view place recognition. Specifically, our approach leverages pre-trained foundation models to extract dense visual tokens from both ground and aerial images, as well as expressive geometric tokens from ground LiDAR observations. These heterogeneous tokens are then projected into a shared embedding space for cross-modal alignment and fusion. As our main contribution, we propose ODE-conditioned VLAQ, which tightly couples neural ordinary differential equations (ODE)-based RGB-LiDAR fusion with vectors of locally aggregated queries (VLAQ). In this design, the VLAQ query centers are dynamically adapted according to the fused multi-modal state. This mechanism allows the final global descriptor to preserve globally learned retrieval prototypes while remaining responsive to scene-specific visual and geometric evidence, significantly improving aerial-ground matching. Extensive experiments on KITTI360-AG and nuScenes-AG validate the effectiveness of our proposed MAG-VLAQ. Notably, on KITTI360-AG, our MAG-VLAQ nearly doubles the state-of-the-art performance, achieving 61.1 Recall@1 in the satellite setting, compared with 34.5 from the closest competing approach.

item.title: Perception Without Engagement: Dissecting the Causal Discovery Deficit in LMMs
item.author: Jiafeng Liang, Zhihao Zhu, Zihan Zhang, Baoqi Ren, Shixin Jiang, Runxuan Liu, Tao Ren, Ming Liu, See-Kiong Ng, Bing Qin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对大型多模态模型在因果发现中过度依赖文本先验的问题，提出了基于扰动的评估协议 ProCauEval 和强化学习框架 ADPO。研究发现模型在因果推理中未充分利用视觉内容，且更强的后训练反而加剧了这一问题。实验证明 ADPO 能有效引导模型基于视觉证据进行推理，提升了视觉参与度。

背景: 大型多模态模型在通用视频理解方面表现良好，但在因果发现过程中对文本先验捷径的敏感性是一个关键缺陷。

目的: 为了理解文本先验捷径的潜在机制，并解决模型过度依赖文本先验的问题，提出了一种新的评估协议和优化方法。

方法: 提出了 ProCauEval，一种基于扰动的评估协议，通过五种受控配置来诊断机制。提出了 ADPO，一种基于负教师对齐的强化学习框架，通过最大化原始输入和视觉受损输入之间的策略分布差异，将策略推向远离视觉受损诱导的仅先验教师的方向。

主要发现: 评估了17个主流模型，发现模型虽然忠实地感知视频内容，但在因果推理中系统性地未充分利用。更强的后训练反而放大了文本先验依赖，且更高的基线性能与扰动下的脆弱性相关。

结论: 实验表明 ADPO 在不牺牲基本理解能力的情况下提高了视觉参与度，为可靠的因果发现迈出了初步的一步。

翻译: 尽管大型多模态模型在通用视频理解方面取得了强劲的表现，但在因果发现过程中对文本先验捷径的敏感性已被视为一个关键缺陷。这一现象的潜在机制尚未被完全理解，因为现有的基准测试仅测量响应准确性，而没有揭示缺陷的来源和程度。我们介绍了 ProCauEval，一种基于扰动的评估协议，它从结果评估转向机制诊断，通过五种受控配置系统地操纵视觉和文本模态，以分解它们对模型行为的各自贡献并剖析失败模式。评估了17个主流 LMM 后，我们发现模型忠实地感知视频内容，但在因果推理过程中系统性地未充分利用它。我们进一步观察到，更强的后训练反而放大而非减轻了对文本先验的依赖，且更高的基线性能与扰动下的脆弱性相关。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了反蒸馏策略优化 ADPO，这是一种基于负教师对齐的强化学习框架，它通过 GRPO 增强了显式地将策略推向远离由视觉损坏诱导的仅先验反事实教师的能力。具体而言，ADPO 最大化了在原始输入和视觉受损输入上条件化的策略分布之间的差异，从而迫使模型将推理建立在视觉证据上而不是文本捷径上。大量实验表明，ADPO 提高了视觉参与度，而没有牺牲基本理解能力，从而为可靠的因果发现提供了初步步骤。

Abstract

Although Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have achieved strong performance on general video understanding, their susceptibility to textual prior shortcuts during causal discovery has been recognized as a critical deficit. The underlying mechanisms of this phenomenon remain incompletely understood, as existing benchmarks only measure response accuracy without revealing the sources and extent of the deficit. We introduce ProCauEval, a perturbation-based evaluation protocol that shifts from outcome assessment to mechanism diagnosis, probing causal discovery through five controlled configurations that systematically manipulate visual and textual modalities to decompose their respective contributions to model behavior and dissect the failure modes. Evaluating 17 mainstream LMMs, we find that models faithfully perceive video content yet systematically underexploit it during causal reasoning. We further observe that stronger post-training amplifies rather than mitigates textual prior reliance, and that higher baseline performance correlates with greater fragility under perturbation. To address these, we propose Anti-Distillation Policy Optimization (ADPO), a reinforcement learning framework built on negative teacher alignment, which augments GRPO by explicitly pushing the policy away from a prior-only counterfactual teacher induced by visual corruption. Specifically, ADPO maximizes the divergence between the policy distributions conditioned on the original and visually corrupted inputs, thereby forcing the model to ground its reasoning in visual evidence rather than textual shortcuts. Extensive experiments show that ADPO improves visual engagement without sacrificing fundamental comprehension, thus offering a preliminary step toward reliable causal discovery.

item.title: Tabular Foundation Model for Generative Modelling
item.author: Xiangjian Jiang, Mingxuan Liu, Nikola Simidjievski, Tassilo Klein, Mateja Jamnik
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为 TabFORGE 的新型表格基础模型，旨在解决现有生成式表格基础模型在合成数据质量上与特定数据集生成器存在的差距。

背景: 生成式建模是检验基础模型的关键，但生成式表格基础模型研究较少。现有生成器往往无法匹配特定数据集生成器的数据质量，主要原因是它们与异构表格数据的因果结构先验不匹配。

目的: 引入 TabFORGE 模型，利用预训练的因果感知特征编码器在统一潜在空间中隐式学习因果信息，以生成高质量的合成表格数据。

方法: TabFORGE 基于预训练的表格基础表示，采用两阶段设计：首先预训练基于分数的扩散 Transformer，然后使用去噪后的潜在嵌入预训练去噪对齐解码器，从而解耦潜在建模与解码。

主要发现: 在 45 个真实世界数据集上与 22 种基准方法进行评估，结果表明 TabFORGE 能够有效学习和利用可泛化的表格表示，生成高质量的合成表格数据，特别是具有强大的结构保真度。

结论: TabFORGE 能够生成高质量的合成表格数据，有效解决了现有生成器与异构表格数据因果结构不匹配的问题。

翻译: 生成式建模是对基础模型的一项严苛考验，因为它需要对给定数据模态进行鲁棒、整体性的表示学习，而不仅仅是针对监督预测目标的优化。尽管最近在表格基础模型方面的工作在预测建模上取得了显著进展，但生成式表格基础模型仍然探索不足。特别是现有的表格基础生成器，在合成数据质量上尚未 consistently 匹配强大的特定数据集生成器。一个关键原因是它们与异构表格数据的独特因果结构先验不匹配。在本文中，我们通过引入一种新的表格基础模型 TabFORGE 来解决这一差距，该模型建立在用于生成的预训练表格基础表示之上。TabFORGE 设计用于利用由预训练的因果感知特征编码器诱导的统一潜在空间中，隐式学习多样化表格数据集背后的因果信息。它通过两阶段设计进一步解耦潜在建模与解码：我们首先预训练一个基于分数的扩散 Transformer，然后使用去噪后的潜在嵌入预训练去噪对齐解码器。这种设计优雅地缓解了潜在嵌入中通常在训练和推理之间出现的分布偏移。我们在 45 个真实世界数据集上全面评估了 TabFORGE，与 22 种基准方法进行比较。结果表明，TabFORGE 有效地学习和利用了可泛化的表格表示，能够高效生成高质量的合成表格数据，特别是具有强大的结构保真度。

Abstract

Generative modelling is a demanding test of foundation models, because it requires robust, holistic representation learning for a given data modality, rather than optimisation for a supervised prediction target alone. While recent work on tabular foundation models has achieved remarkable progress in predictive modelling, generative tabular foundation models remain underexplored. Existing tabular foundation generators, in particular, have not yet consistently matched strong dataset-specific generators in synthetic data quality. A key reason is their misalignment with the distinctive causal structural prior of heterogeneous tabular data. In this paper, we address this gap by introducing a novel tabular foundation model, \textbf{TabFORGE}, built on pretrained \textbf{Tab}ular \textbf{FO}undational \textbf{R}epresentations for \textbf{GE}neration. TabFORGE is designed to utilise the implicitly learned causal information underlying diverse tabular datasets in a unified latent space induced by a pretrained causality-aware feature encoder. It further decouples latent modelling from decoding through a two-stage design: we first pretrain a score-based diffusion transformer, and then pretrain a denoising-aligned decoder using the denoised latent embeddings. This design elegantly mitigates the distribution shifts in latent embeddings that typically arise between training and inference. We evaluate TabFORGE comprehensively against 22 benchmark methods on 45 real-world datasets. Our results show that TabFORGE effectively learns and leverages generalisable tabular representations, enabling efficient generation of high-quality synthetic tabular data, particularly with strong structural fidelity.

item.title: TIDE-Bench: Task-Aware and Diagnostic Evaluation of Tool-Integrated Reasoning
item.author: Yize Li, Junzhi Li, Jason Song, Chuxiong Sun, Rui Wang, Changwen Zheng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TIDE-Bench 是一个用于评估工具集成推理方法的综合且高效的基准测试。

背景: 工具集成推理是增强大语言模型能力的范式，但缺乏高质量且统一的评估基准，现有评估在数据集质量、任务多样性等方面存在局限。

目的: 引入 TIDE-Bench 基准，以解决现有评估的不足，全面评估 TIR 方法。

方法: 提供多样化的任务设置，包含数学推理、知识密集型问答以及新设计的工具落地实验设计和动态交互任务；采用全面的评估协议，同时测量最终答案质量、过程可靠性、工具使用效率和推理成本；通过筛选现有数据集中的低区分度实例来构建高质量且具有区分性的评估集，降低评估成本。

主要发现: 在多个基础模型和 TIR 方法上的实验揭示了工具落地方面存在的持续瓶颈。

结论: 为未来的 TIR 研究提供了见解。

翻译: TIDE-Bench is a comprehensive and efficient benchmark for evaluating tool-integrated reasoning methods. It addresses the lack of high-quality and unified evaluation benchmarks in the field. The benchmark features diverse task settings including mathematical reasoning and knowledge-intensive QA, along with two new tasks for complex tool invocation. It employs a comprehensive evaluation protocol measuring answer quality, process reliability, tool-use efficiency, and inference cost. It constructs high-quality evaluation sets by filtering low-discrimination instances to reduce cost. Experiments reveal persistent bottlenecks in tool grounding, offering insights for future research.

Abstract

Tool-integrated reasoning has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing large language models with external computation, retrieval, and execution capabilities. However, the field still lacks a high-quality and unified evaluation benchmark, and existing TIR evaluations remain limited in dataset quality, task diversity, diagnostic comprehensiveness, and evaluation efficiency. In this work, we introduce TIDE-Bench, a holistic and efficient benchmark for evaluating TIR methods, featuring three key advantages. First, it provides diverse task settings, combining widely used mathematical reasoning and knowledge-intensive QA tasks with two newly designed tasks, namely the tool-grounded experimental design task and the dynamic interactive task, to probe models' abilities in complex tool invocation and multi-tool coordination. Second, TIDE-Bench adopts a comprehensive yet task-aware evaluation protocol, jointly measuring final answer quality, process reliability, tool-use efficiency, and inference cost across heterogeneous task settings. Third, TIDE-Bench constructs high-quality and discriminative evaluation sets by filtering low-discrimination instances from existing datasets, substantially reducing evaluation cost while focusing on more challenging samples. Extensive experiments on multiple foundation models and TIR methods reveal persistent bottlenecks in tool grounding, offering insights for future TIR research.

item.title: SoccerLens: Grounded Soccer Video Understanding Beyond Accuracy
item.author: Ismael Elsharkawi, Ahmed Sait, Silvio Giancola, Bernard Ghanem, Hossam Sharara, Abdelrahman Eldesokey
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 视觉-语言模型在足球视频理解中展现出潜力，但存在依赖虚假关联而非真实视觉证据的问题。

背景: 足球视频具有视角变化大、镜头切换快和场景杂乱等高复杂性特征。现有的评估协议主要关注分类准确率，缺乏视觉定位评估。

目的: 为了解决现有评估协议的局限性，引入一个用于足球视频理解定位的基准数据集。

方法: 提出了SoccerLens基准数据集，包含13个常见足球事件的标注视频片段，并按语义相关性分为三个层级。同时，扩展了Chefer的归因方法以联合建模空间和时间注意力，并引入了评估指标来衡量模型注意力是否与标注线索对齐。

主要发现: 尽管现有模型分类准确率高，但在最宽松的线索定义下，其视觉定位性能仍无法超过50%，且始终未能充分利用时间信息。

结论: 预测性能与真实视觉定位之间存在巨大差距，突显了在足球等复杂时空领域进行定位评估的必要性。

翻译: Vision-language models (VLMs) have recently shown strong potential in soccer video understanding. However, given the high complexity of soccer videos due to large viewpoint variations, rapid shot transitions, and cluttered scenes, it remains unclear on whether VLMs rely on meaningful visual evidence or exploit spurious correlations and shortcut learning. Existing evaluation protocols focus primarily on classification accuracy and do not assess visual grounding. To address this limitation, we introduce SoccerLens, a benchmark for grounded soccer video understanding. The benchmark contains annotated video segments spanning 13 common soccer events, with structured visual cues organized into three levels of semantic relevance. We further extend the attribution method of Chefer [arXiv:2103.15679] to jointly model spatial and temporal attention, and introduce evaluation metrics that measure whether model attention aligns with annotated cues or drifts toward spurious regions. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art soccer VLMs shows that, despite strong classification accuracy, current models fail to exceed 50% grounding performance even under the loosest cue definitions and consistently underutilize temporal information. These results reveal a substantial gap between predictive performance and true visual grounding, highlighting the need for grounded evaluation in complex spatio-temporal domains such as soccer.

Abstract

Vision-language models (VLMs) have recently shown strong potential in soccer video understanding. However, given the high complexity of soccer videos due to large viewpoint variations, rapid shot transitions, and cluttered scenes, it remains unclear on whether VLMs rely on meaningful visual evidence or exploit spurious correlations and shortcut learning. Existing evaluation protocols focus primarily on classification accuracy and do not assess visual grounding. To address this limitation, we introduce SoccerLens, a benchmark for grounded soccer video understanding. The benchmark contains annotated video segments spanning $13$ common soccer events, with structured visual cues organized into three levels of semantic relevance. We further extend the attribution method of Chefer [arXiv:2103.15679] to jointly model spatial and temporal attention, and introduce evaluation metrics that measure whether model attention aligns with annotated cues or drifts toward spurious regions. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art soccer VLMs shows that, despite strong classification accuracy, current models fail to exceed $50\%$ grounding performance even under the loosest cue definitions and consistently underutilize temporal information. These results reveal a substantial gap between predictive performance and true visual grounding, highlighting the need for grounded evaluation in complex spatio-temporal domains such as soccer.

item.title: SABER: A Scalable Action-Based Embodied Dataset for Real-World VLA Adaptation
item.author: Narsimha Menga, Parikshit Sakurikar, Amirreza Rouhi, Satya Sai Reddy, Anirudh Govil, Sri Harsha Chittajallu, Rajat Aggarwal, Anoop Namboodiri, Sashi Reddi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一个名为SABER的高保真零售机器人动作数据集，旨在解决通用机器人模型在零售领域表现不佳的问题。

背景: 通用机器人基础模型在复杂的零售操作任务中表现不佳，原因是零售环境在通用预训练分布中缺失，且通过遥操作填补数据缺口成本高昂且难以扩展。

目的: 介绍SABER数据集，以提供高质量的零售机器人动作数据，从而提升机器人在零售环境中的表现。

方法: SABER数据集通过在多个真实杂货店内进行超过100小时的自然捕捉获得。结合了头戴式摄像机的主观视角（记录手部活动）和360度场景摄像机（观察整体空间），捕捉了手部活动、全身运动和场景动态，无需排练、脚本或遥操作。数据集包含44.8K训练样本，涵盖潜在动作序列、手部姿态轨迹和全身同步动作序列。

主要发现: 将SABER应用于GR00T N1.6模型后，在十个零售操作任务上的平均成功率达到了29.3%，比微调基线高出2.19倍。

结论: 机器人能力的提升依赖于更好的数据，SABER证明了无需机器人参与即可大规模收集高质量数据是可行的。

翻译: 通用机器人部署在现实环境中，既依赖于强大的模型架构，也依赖于丰富的领域特定动作数据。通用机器人基础模型在应用于零售领域的复杂未见任务时表现平平。根本原因在于数据缺口：零售环境在通用机器人预训练分布中结构上缺失，而通过遥操作填补这一缺口成本高昂、受后勤限制且难以扩展。我们介绍了SABER，这是一个高保真零售机器人动作数据集，由多个真实杂货店内超过100小时的自然店内捕捉构建而成。头戴式摄像机的主观视角记录了交互点的精细手部活动，而来自DreamVu的ALIA摄像机的360度场景视角同时观察了整个空间内的所有演员和活动。这种结合提供了人类零售行为的独特完整画面：灵巧的手部活动、全身运动和场景动态，所有这些都是在没有排练、脚本或遥操作开销的情况下捕捉的。SABER语料库包含44.8K训练样本，涵盖三种动作表示流：通过LAPA风格编码的25K潜在动作序列，重定向到机器人关节空间的18.6K灵巧手部姿态轨迹，以及重定向到人形形态的1.2K全身同步动作序列。当通过共享骨干多任务后训练配方应用于GR00T N1.6时，SABER在十个零售操作任务上的平均成功率达到29.3%，比微调基线高出2.19倍。SABER证明，具备能力的零售机器人之路在于更好的数据，这些数据今天就可以收集，无需机器人参与。

Abstract

Robotic deployment in real-world environments depends on rich, domain-specific action data as much as on strong model architecture. General-purpose robot foundation models show modest performance in complex unseen tasks such as manipulation in a retail domain when applied out of the box. The root cause is a data gap: retail environments are structurally absent from general robot pretraining distributions, and the path to filling that gap through teleoperation is prohibitively expensive, logistically constrained, and difficult to scale. We introduce SABER, a high-fidelity retail robotics action dataset built from over 100 hours of natural in-store capture across multiple real grocery environments. Egocentric footage from head-mounted cameras records fine-grained hand activity at the point of interaction, while exocentric 360-degree scene footage from DreamVu's ALIA camera simultaneously observes all actors and activities across the entire space. This combination yields a uniquely complete picture of human retail behavior: dexterous hand activity, whole-body motion, and scene dynamics, all captured without staging, scripting, or teleoperation overhead. The SABER corpus contains 44.8K training samples across three action representation streams: 25K latent action sequences via LAPA-style encoding, 18.6K dexterous hand-pose trajectories retargeted to robot joint space, and 1.2K whole-body synchronized motion sequences retargeted to a humanoid embodiment. When applied to GR00T N1.6 via a shared-backbone multi-task post-training recipe, SABER yields a mean success rate of 29.3% across ten retail manipulation tasks -- more than 2.19x over fine-tuning baselines (13.4%). SABER demonstrates that the path to capable retail robots runs through better data, which can be collected today, at scale, without a robot in the loop. The dataset and code are available at https://dreamvu.ai/saber

item.title: VFM-SDM: A vision foundation model-based framework for training-free, marker-free, and calibration-free structural displacement measurement
item.author: Qingyu Xian, Hao Cheng, Berend Jan van der Zwaag, Rolands Kromanis, Ozlem Durmaz Incel
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于视觉基础模型的结构位移测量框架，无需特定任务训练或现场准备即可实现多方向位移重建。

背景: 可靠的位移测量是结构健康监测和数字工程的基础。基于视觉的测量具有低成本和非接触的优势，但受限于特定任务训练或现场准备工作（如标记安装、手动标定）。

目的: 开发一种无需特定任务训练或现场准备的高效非接触式部署框架，用于重建多方向结构位移。

方法: 提出了VFM-SDM框架，集成视觉基础模型推断的相机参数估计和点跟踪，利用三角测量重建位移。引入结构几何约束以抑制物理上不合理的偏差并提高估计一致性。引入了来自服役人行桥的多模态现场数据集和统一基准协议。

主要发现: 在垂直和横向位移上表现出低幅度误差、强时间一致性和小的峰峰值幅度误差，表明在真实条件下性能稳健。

结论: 该框架推进了自动化、可扩展的位移监测，并为数字孪生和数据驱动建筑工作流中的视觉基础模型结构响应测量奠定了基础。

翻译: 可靠的位移测量是结构健康监测和数字工程工作流的基础，因为它提供了直接的结构响应信息。基于视觉的测量已成为一种有前景的低成本、非接触式位移监测方法。然而，其部署往往受限于特定任务的模型训练或现场准备工作，例如标记安装或手动相机标定。本研究提出了一种基于视觉基础模型的结构位移测量框架（VFM-SDM），该框架集成了由视觉基础模型推断的相机参数估计和点跟踪，通过三角测量重建多方向结构位移，无需特定任务训练或现场准备工作，从而能够在现实应用中实现高效的非接触式部署。引入了结构几何约束以抑制物理上不合理的偏差并提高估计一致性。介绍了一个从服役人行桥收集的多模态现场数据集以及一个统一的基准协议，以支持可重复的评估。代表性结果显示垂直和横向位移的低幅度误差、强时间一致性以及小的峰峰值幅度误差，表明在真实条件下性能稳健。所提出的框架推进了自动化、可扩展的位移监测，并为数字孪生和数据驱动建筑工作流中的视觉基础模型结构响应测量奠定了基础。

Abstract

Reliable displacement measurement is fundamental for structural health monitoring and digital engineering workflows, as it provides direct structural response information. Vision-based measurement has emerged as a promising approach for low-cost, non-contact displacement monitoring. However, its deployment often remains constrained by task-specific model training or on-site preparation, such as marker installation or manual camera calibration. This study presents a Vision Foundation Model-based framework for Structural Displacement Measurement (VFM-SDM) that integrates VFM-inferred camera parameter estimation and point tracking to reconstruct multi-directional structural displacements via triangulation without task-specific training or on-site preparation, enabling efficient non-contact deployment in real-world applications. Structural geometry constraints are incorporated to suppress physically implausible deviations and improve estimation consistency. A multi-modal field dataset collected from an in-service pedestrian bridge is introduced alongside a unified benchmarking protocol to support reproducible evaluation. Representative results show low amplitude errors (NRMSE$_{\text{range}}$: 0.11/0.12), strong temporal agreement (correlation coefficient: 0.86/0.88), and small peak-to-peak amplitude errors (RPPAE: 0.01/0.02) for vertical and lateral displacements, indicating robust performance under real-world conditions. The proposed framework advances automated, scalable displacement monitoring and lays the groundwork for VFM-enabled structural response measurements in digital twin and data-centric construction workflows.

item.title: Discriminative Span as a Predictor of Synthetic Data Utility via Classifier Reconstruction
item.author: Radhika Amar Desai, Modigari Narendra
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对计算机视觉中正样本稀缺的问题，本文提出了一种无需训练即可评估合成数据效用的几何驱动指标。该方法通过分析预训练模型嵌入空间中的差分向量与线性分类器权重向量的关系，发现该指标与下游模型性能高度相关，可作为评估合成数据质量的实用工具。

背景: 在计算机视觉应用（如医学成像和工业检测）中，二分类任务面临正样本严重稀缺的问题。一种常见的解决方案是利用负样本生成合成正样本。

目的: 解决如何可靠评估合成数据是否能提高下游模型性能这一根本性挑战。

方法: 提出了一种几何驱动的指标，无需模型训练即可预测合成数据的效用。该方法在预训练基础模型的嵌入空间中运行，通过样本间的差分向量表示数据集，并测量相对投影误差来评估线性分类器的权重向量是否位于这些变化构成的子空间内。

主要发现: 在多个数据集和架构上，该指标与在真实负样本和合成正样本混合数据上训练的 CNN 的下游分类性能表现出强烈的相关性。

结论: 该指标可以作为评估数据稀缺情况下合成数据质量的实用且信息丰富的工具。

翻译: 在许多现实世界的计算机视觉应用中，包括医学成像和工业检测，二分类任务的特点是正样本严重稀缺。一种广泛采用的解决方案是使用应用于负样本的图像到图像变换来生成合成正样本。然而，一个根本性的挑战仍然存在：如何可靠地评估此类合成数据是否会提高下游模型的性能？在这项工作中，我们提出了一种几何驱动的指标，用于预测合成数据的效用，而无需模型训练。我们的方法在预训练基础模型的嵌入空间中运行，并通过样本之间的差分向量来表示数据集。我们通过测量相对投影误差来评估线性分类器的权重向量是否可以表示在这些变化构成的子空间内。直观地说，如果合成数据引起的变体捕获了与任务相关的方向，它们的张成空间可以近似于分类器，从而导致低投影误差。相反，质量差的合成数据无法张成这些方向，导致更高的误差。在多个数据集和架构上，我们表明该指标与在真实负样本和合成正样本混合数据上训练的 CNN 的下游分类性能表现出强烈的相关性。这些发现表明，所提出的指标作为在数据稀缺情况下评估合成数据质量的实用且信息丰富的工具。

Abstract

In many real-world computer vision applications, including medical imaging and industrial inspection, binary classification tasks are characterized by a severe scarcity of positive samples. A widely adopted solution is to generate synthetic positive data using image-to-image transformations applied to negative samples. However, a fundamental challenge remains: how can we reliably assess whether such synthetic data will improve downstream model performance? In this work, we propose a geometry-driven metric that predicts the utility of synthetic data without requiring model training. Our approach operates in the embedding space of a pre-trained foundation model and represents the dataset through difference vectors between samples. We evaluate whether the weight vector of a linear classifier can be expressed within the subspace spanned by these variations by measuring the relative projection error. Intuitively, if the variations induced by synthetic data capture task-relevant directions, their span can approximate the classifier, resulting in low projection error. Conversely, poor synthetic data fails to span these directions, leading to higher error. Across multiple datasets and architectures, we show that this metric exhibits strong correlation with downstream classification performance of CNNs trained on mixtures of real negative and synthetic positive data. These findings suggest that the proposed metric serves as a practical and informative tool for evaluating synthetic data quality in data-scarce settings.

item.title: Quantifying the Risk-Return Tradeoff in Forecasting
item.author: Philippe Goulet Coulombe
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该文提出了一种评估预测可靠性的框架，通过将预测损失差异视为基准收益，利用金融领域的风险调整后绩效指标和边缘比率进行分析，并将其应用于美国宏观经济预测。

背景: 预测平均准确性与预测可靠性不同。专业预测者通常具有高可靠性，但机器学习模型可能在平均准确性上胜过它们，但在风险调整后表现上可能较难。

目的: 评估预测模型的风险调整后绩效，引入边缘比率，并比较基准模型、机器学习模型、基础模型和专业预测者之间的表现。

方法: 将预测损失差异视为基准收益，使用金融领域的风险调整后绩效指标（如夏普比率、索提诺比率、Omega比率、回撤指标），引入边缘比率，应用于美国宏观经济预测。

主要发现: 专业预测者在风险调整后表现上很难被超越，很少出现灾难性失败，且边缘比率较高。选定的机器学习方法在特定目标上能提供有吸引力的风险概况。该框架可扩展到跨目标和样本的元分析。

结论: 该框架为评估预测可靠性提供了自然扩展，适用于密度预测评估和M4竞赛等场景。

翻译: 预测平均准确性与预测可靠性不同。我将相对于基准的预测损失差异视为收益序列。然后，我使用金融领域的风险调整后绩效指标评估这些收益，包括夏普比率、索提诺比率、Omega比率和基于回撤的指标。我还引入了边缘比率，以捕捉模型相对于预测前沿提供独特信息预测的倾向。我将此框架应用于美国宏观经济预测，比较了计量经济学基准、机器学习模型、基础模型和职业预测者调查。虽然通常可以在平均准确性方面击败专业预测者，但在风险调整后基础上击败他们要困难得多。他们很少出现灾难性失败，并且经常获得较高的边缘比率，这可能是对情境判断价值的反映。尽管如此，选定的机器学习方法为特定目标提供了有吸引力的风险概况。该框架自然地扩展到跨目标、跨时间跨度和跨样本的元分析，密度预测评估和M4竞赛对此进行了说明。

Abstract

Average forecast accuracy is not the same as forecast reliability. I treat forecast loss differentials relative to a benchmark as a return series. I then evaluate these returns using risk-adjusted performance measures from finance, including the Sharpe ratio, Sortino ratio, Omega ratio, and drawdown-based metrics. I also introduce the Edge Ratio capturing a model's propensity to deliver uniquely informative predictions relative to the forecasting frontier. I apply this framework to U.S. macroeconomic forecasting, comparing econometric benchmarks, machine learning models, a foundation model (TabPFN), and the Survey of Professional Forecasters. While it is often feasible to beat professional forecasters in terms of average accuracy, it is much harder to beat them on a risk-adjusted basis. They rarely exhibit catastrophic failures and often achieve high Edge Ratios, plausibly reflecting the value of contextual judgment. Nonetheless, selected machine learning methods deliver attractive risk profiles for specific targets. The framework naturally extends to meta-analyses across targets, horizons, and samples, illustrated with a density forecast evaluation and the M4 competition.

item.title: Distilling 3D Spatial Reasoning into a Lightweight Vision-Language Model with CoT
item.author: Alaa Asfour, Christopher Indris, Leihan Chen, Tejas Vyas, Guanghui Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种知识蒸馏框架，将大型3D视觉语言模型的知识转移到小型学生模型中，以实现高效部署。

背景: 大型3D视觉语言模型虽然具备强大的空间推理能力，但由于计算成本高，难以部署。

目的: 设计一个知识蒸馏框架，将空间推理能力从7B教师模型转移到2.29B学生模型，降低计算成本。

方法: 使用VGGT作为视觉编码器，采用多任务蒸馏管道和不确定性感知损失加权；引入“隐藏思维链”作为内部草稿板；学生模型联合执行空间描述、深度估计和目标检测。

主要发现: 该方法实现了8.7倍的推理延迟降低和3倍的模型大小减少，同时保留了教师性能的54-72%；在ScanNet和3D-FRONT数据集上，模型在邻近和接触任务上达到68-72%的准确率。

结论: 该框架使得在资源受限平台上进行高效的3D场景问答成为可能。

We propose a knowledge distillation framework that transfers spatial reasoning from a 7B teacher to a 2.29B student model. Our approach achieves 8.7x lower inference latency and a 3x reduction in model size while retaining 54-72% of the teacher's performance. The framework utilizes VGGT as the vision encoder and a multi-task distillation pipeline with uncertainty-aware loss weighting. To improve reasoning without chain-of-thought (CoT) data, we introduce
